jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Electrical Engineer  
**FLSA:** Exempt  
**Clearance:** Secret  
**Location:** Huntsville, AL  
**Job Type:** Full-time  
  
NTA, Inc. is a locally recognized Best Place to Work and Best Place for Working Parents specializing in technical services centered on research, development, integration, demonstration and evaluation of various missile and aviation system technologies with a focus in Position, Navigation, and Timing (PNT) and Guidance and Control (G&C) technologies. Our engineering expertise and leading-edge technology foster strong customer relationships, a challenging work environment, and limitless employee opportunities in the realm of supporting the Warfighter. Join the NTA family that fosters a healthy work-life balance, facilitates teamwork, welcomes inquisitive thinkers, and promotes excellence. Take the first step towards an enriching career journey with NTA and apply today!
  
  
NTA, Inc. is seeking a skilled and motivated Electrical Engineer to support the design and fabrication of advanced instrumentation and data acquisition systems used in U.S. Army fire control applications. This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys hands-on work, solving complex problems, and contributing across the full product lifecycle.  
  
Key responsibilities include working as part of a small, agile engineering team to develop mission-critical U.S. Army instrumentation systems, while contributing to the design, development, and testing of electronics hardware, including custom PCBs. You will support software and firmware development for embedded systems and collaborate on system integration, troubleshooting, and performance validation. Responsibilities also include contributing to the full product lifecycle, from initial design and fabrication through fielding and long-term sustainment.
  
  
**Education and Experience:**

* Minimum of a Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering from an ABET accredited institution
* 5 + years of experience

  
**Travel Requirements:** This position requires approximately 50% travel to NTA's Mesa, Arizona, location to support engineering activities, program coordination, and collaboration with the Mesa-based team.  
  
**Required:**

* Experience with digital and analog electronics design and fabrication
* Ability to read schematics and trouble-shoot hardware
* Experience integrating hardware, firmware and software in complex systems
* Strong understanding of engineering principles and processes
* A high level of computer skills and experience with Microsoft Office Suite
* Willingness to travel

  
**Desired:**

* Experience with micro-controller based embedded designs
* Understanding of embedded software as it relates to hardware design
* Familiarity with schematic capture and PCB layout design tools
* Familiarity with FPGA designs
* Ability to produce engineering drawings (e.g., schematics and part lists)

  
A high level of computer skills and experience with Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word are required, along with organizational, managerial, written, and verbal communication skills. Applicant should be detail oriented with good analytical skills, a team player, and able to handle multiple deadlines and priorities.  
Applicant must have a current security clearance or be able to obtain a security clearance through a government security investigation. U.S. Citizenship is required.  
  
**What We Offer**  
NTA attributes company success to our ability to attract and retain talented individuals. This ability is accomplished by offering challenging technical work in a supportive work environment combined with an excellent total compensation package as outlined below.

* Company Paid Blue Cross Blue Shield Health and Dental Employee Coverage

* Company Paid Long-Term & Short-Term Disability, Life Insurance, Supplemental Insurance

* 401(k) Plan with Generous Matching and Company Contributions

* Financial Advising with Morgan Stanley

* Health And Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts

* Paid Time Off (11 Paid Holidays, Parental, Vacation, Sick, Jury Duty, and Military Leave)

* Access to Employee Paid VSP Vision Coverage

* Flexible Work Schedules

* Professional Development and Educational Assistance

  

NTA, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. NTA, Inc. affords equal opportunity to all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, sex, religion, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identification, protected veteran status or national origin.  
If you require special assistance applying for one of our positions, please contact Human Resources at (256) 327- 4107

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Huntsville Alabama
jobs.description:
Davidson has distinguished itself in the aerospace and missile defense industry with an outstanding reputation for excellence. Specifically, we're recognized for hiring noted experts, experienced engineers and scientists dedicated to designing and delivering advanced, intelligent technology solutions in defense of our Nation.

Davidson Technologies Inc. is seeking a **Senior Software** **Engineer** onsite in Huntsville Alabama.

Davidson will be supporting the Air Force's development, production, sustainment and deployment of software systems for the Sentinel Ground and Airborne Launch Control Systems, Launch Facilities and associated infrastructure.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Analyzes customer requirements, concept of operations, system architectures, and technical specifications to define and develop software solutions that meet mission and system objectives.
* Leads the design, development, integration, testing, and maintenance of complex software applications and embedded software systems.
* Translates system-level and software requirements into software architecture, detailed designs, technical solutions, and implementable work products.
* Evaluates alternative software approaches, technologies, and design solutions to address technical challenges, performance requirements, and mission needs.
* Provides technical leadership for software development activities, including architecture, design, coding, integration, testing, troubleshooting, and deployment.
* Develops and maintains software technical documentation, including software architecture, design descriptions, interface specifications, test documentation, and other engineering artifacts.
* Collaborates with Systems Engineers, Software Architects, Product Owners, and other technical stakeholders to resolve software-related technical issues, risks, dependencies, and design conflicts.
* Supports software integration and verification activities, including development of test strategies, automated tests, defect resolution, and system-level integration.
* Contributes to the implementation and continuous improvement of Agile and DevSecOps development practices, including continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD), automated testing, and software configuration management.
* Ensures software solutions meet applicable quality, cybersecurity, safety, performance, and customer requirements.
* Provides technical mentorship and guidance to software engineers and contributes to the development of software engineering processes, standards, and best practices.
* Holds technical accountability for the quality, integrity, and successful execution of software engineering deliverables within the assigned area of responsibility.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Strong, hands-on experience across the software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, software architecture and design, implementation, integration, testing, debugging, and deployment.
* Demonstrated experience developing software using one or more object-oriented programming languages, such as C++, Java, or Python.
* Demonstrated experience developing and integrating software for complex, mission-critical, embedded, or distributed systems.
* Experience with software architecture and design principles, including object-oriented design, software interfaces, modularity, and system integration.
* Solid understanding of Agile software development methodologies, including Scrum and/or Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe).
* Experience with software development tools and environments, including version control, issue tracking, automated testing, and build/deployment tools.
* Experience with continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) and/or DevSecOps development environments.
* Experience developing and maintaining technical software documentation and engineering artifacts.
* Ability to troubleshoot complex software issues and work collaboratively with systems, hardware, test, cybersecurity, and other engineering disciplines.
* Minimum of **Fifteen (15)** years of relevant software engineering experience on programs and contracts of similar scope, type, and complexity.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Four (4) years of additional relevant software engineering experience may be substituted for a bachelor's degree.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience developing safety-critical, mission-critical, or high-reliability software, including familiarity with applicable standards such as DO-178C, DO-330, or related development and verification standards.
* Experience developing software for DoD, aerospace, defense, or other complex system-of-systems environments.
* Familiarity with DoD software cybersecurity requirements, including Risk Management Framework (RMF) and Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF) principles.
* Experience with software development and collaboration tools such as Git, Jira, Confluence, Jenkins, GitLab, or similar tools.
* Experience with embedded software, real-time systems, distributed systems, or hardware/software integration.
* Experience with software performance analysis, debugging, automated testing, and defect resolution.
* Prior experience supporting strategic missile, weapons, aerospace, or other mission-critical systems.
* Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

**Clearance Requirements:**

* Active DoD Security Clearance at the **Secret** level or above.

The selected candidate will provide Systems Engineering and Integration (SE&I) expertise to Marshall Space Flight Center (MSFC) in support of the Integrated Avionics Test Facility (IATF) systems engineering team. Responsibilities for this position include, but are not limited to, the following:

* Provide electrical engineering support of development for design, requirements, test, and verification, validation, and accreditation (VV&A) of IATF hardware in the loop (HWIL) systems.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* US Citizenship required.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer - Performance Analyst
jobs.description:
At Boeing, we innovate and collaborate to make the world a better place. We’re committed to fostering an environment for every teammate that’s welcoming, respectful and inclusive, with great opportunity for professional growth. Find your future with us.

**Systems Engineer - Performance Analyst**

**Why This is an Exciting Role:**

As a Systems Engineer at Boeing Intelligence & Analytics (BI&A), this position will be responsible for analyzing the performance of the Ground-based Midcourse Defense system in system-level simulations, supporting the assessment of performance capabilities and opportunities for potential system performance improvements. Efforts will include coordinating with other analysts and resident Subject Matter Experts to determine root cause of performance observations, supporting the development of analysis reports/briefings to be briefed to customers/leadership, and developing Python and Bash tools that support simulation data processing and analysis.

**Experience and Qualifications:**

To be eligible for this demanding position, the ideal candidate should demonstrate the following experience and qualifications:

**Required Education and Years of Experience:**

* Education/experience typically acquired through advanced technical education from an accredited course of study in engineering, computer science, mathematics, physics or chemistry (e.g. Bachelor) and typically 2 or more years' related work experience or an equivalent combination of technical education and experience (e.g. Masters). In the USA, ABET accreditation is the preferred, although not required, accreditation standard.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Active Secret Clearance
* Experience in systems engineering, systems analysis, or performance analysis.
* Experience applying statistical analysis, probability distributions, sampling methods, or Monte Carlo simulation techniques
* Experience reviewing system performance metrics and identifying potential root causes of performance issues
* Experience working in an aerospace, defense, or related engineering environment
* Demonstrated strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present technical information to diverse audiences
* Demonstrated organizational, collaboration, and leadership skills through professional, academic, or civic activities
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a dynamic, cross-functional environment

**Desired Qualifications:**

* Experience supporting the Ground-based Midcourse Defense program or other missile defense programs
* Experience evaluating system performance under multiple operational scenarios, architectures, or threat conditions
* Experience analyzing system quality factors, such as affordability, safety, reliability, survivability, vulnerability, susceptability, and systems integration
* Experience performing risk assessments and developing mitigation plans related to system requirements, technical performance, and customer capabilities
* Experience supporting software development, software integration, and test integration
* Experience developing, maintaining, or using modeling and simulation tools of varying fidelity to assess system performance

----------------------------

Join Our Team as an Avionics Electronics Engineer where you will work on developing the new Long Range Hypersonic Weapon (LRHW), leveraging our decades of hypersonic experience and expertise.  
Location: This position does not support teleworking; you will be located near our Lockheed Martin Space facility in: Huntsville AL and be expected to work a flexible 9x80 schedule in the office full-time.

Ready for a challenge at the speed of Hypersonic?

Come join Lockheed Martin's Long Range Hypersonic Weapon team. Our system will travel at Mach 5 (over a mile per second)! Helping us create a system that goes that fast means overcoming several difficult physics and engineering challenges. You will be integrating hypersonic missile technology into an Army battery on a highly accelerated schedule to deliver a hypersonic operational prototype system to the Soldier.

What does this role look like?  
The role focuses on designing and developing electrical interfaces for tactical vehicle subsystems and components, translating both formal requirements and lessons learned into reliable solutions. It involves troubleshooting and fault isolation of electrical hardware to maintain operational readiness, as well as applying core electrical engineering principles to create and validate schematics and cable connector assemblies (CCA) that meet performance and integration standards.

* Support electrical design trade studies

jobs.title: Instrumentation and Controls Engineer II
jobs.description:
Application close date:

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

This role is part of Blue Origin Operations, which is comprised of Integrated Supply Chain, Test Operations, Safety, Quality, and Mission Assurance. This includes Manufacturing and Supply Chain support across all Blue Origin facilities.

We are a team of collaborators, doers, and problem-solvers who are relentlessly committed to a culture of safety. Join us in lowering the cost of access to space and enabling Blue Origin’s vision of millions of people living and working in space to benefit Earth.

We are a small, passionate and accomplished team, that supports the development, construction, operation and maintenance of liquid rocket engine test facilities for various liquid rocket engine propulsion systems, focusing on instrumentation and data acquisition and control hardware. You will contribute to the team’s progress by participating in all aspects of hands-on engineering and project management. This position will directly impact the history of space exploration and will require your dedication and detailed attention towards safe and repeatable test operations and spaceflight! This position is based in Huntsville, AL.

We are looking for someone to apply their technical expertise, leadership skills, and commitment to quality to positively impact safe human spaceflight. Passion for our mission and vision is required!

**Responsibilities:**

* Provide technical support for instrumentation on test stands; provide and update drawings of harnesses/interfaces, electrical power, and data/control systems; provide mentorship/training and troubleshooting support for technicians and engineers
* Design, upgrade, and modify PLC programs for test stands
* Design electrical panels to accommodate new instrumentation and controls infrastructure at test facilities across Blue Origin

SmartRent (NYSE: SMRT) is revolutionizing how people live and work with the industry's only end-to-end platform designed for the rental housing industry. You own the mobile platform layer: the native module boundary, the build and release pipeline, and the performance and stability budgets. Feature engineers ship on top of what you build, and your work is measured by how fast they can do that without writing one-off bridge code.

This is a hands-on IC role. You will work in Swift and Kotlin for native code and in JavaScript most days. You decide when a device integration becomes a shared native module instead of a one-off, and you say no when it should stay in JS.

*Candidate based in Phoenix, AZ is preferred to come to our headquarters in North Phoenix on a hybrid schedule.*

  

**Responsibilities**

* Design and maintain the shared native modules that power device control and other hardware-specific features across our apps

* Set code review standards, mentor other mobile engineers, and document technical decisions so they outlast the conversation

**Required Qualifications**

* 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 5+ years shipping mobile apps on both the App Store and Google Play
* 3+ years of production React Native experience, including building and maintaining native modules
* Deep expertise in Swift or Kotlin with working fluency in the other, and comfort reading platform SDK source when documentation falls short
* Experience leading at least one significant platform migration or major React Native upgrade from planning through delivery
* Backend experience (Node, Elixir, or similar) sufficient to collaborate on API design as a peer

**ABOUT HEAVISIDE INDUSTRIES**

Heaviside Industries builds multi-domain autonomous precision munitions for U.S. and allied special operations and conventional forces. While modern warfare has rapidly evolved with the proliferation of unmanned systems, hyper-precise munitions in contested environments are the future of the battlefield. Economical precision strike capabilities are critical to U.S. and allied war efforts, enabling successful defeat of enemy military assets and infrastructure. Heaviside builds precision munitions designed to operate in GPS-denied and spectrum-jammed battlefields—where traditional systems degrade or fail—without inflated prices or sacrifice to performance.

All engineering and manufacturing is conducted in-house in Heaviside's Los Angeles, CA headquarters and Oslo, Norway office.

Heaviside is backed by Felicis, Hedosophia, Interlagos, Friends & Family Capital, Menlo Ventures, Flume Ventures, Cantos, and others.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

* Design, write, and debug firmware for microcontrollers and embedded Linux platforms (including Raspberry Pi) that control sensors, actuators, and other production-floor hardware
* Translate systems-level requirements from hardware, controls, and manufacturing engineering into embedded software architecture and code
* Build and maintain integrations with our Manufacturing Execution System (MES) API — pushing machine and process data up, and pulling work orders, recipes, and routing instructions down
* Write unit and integration tests, and build validation fixtures to verify firmware behavior against requirements
* Debug field issues across the stack, from hardware/electrical faults up through firmware and network communication
* Document architecture, interfaces, and requirements traceability so systems and software stay in sync
* Collaborate with hardware, systems, and manufacturing engineering teams throughout the product lifecycle, from prototype to production deployment

* Experience designing and debugging firmware for microcontrollers and/or embedded Linux platforms

* Experience integrating with APIs or external systems (e.g., MES, ERP, or similar production/data systems)
* Strong testing discipline — comfortable writing unit/integration tests and building validation fixtures
* Full-stack debugging skills spanning hardware/electrical, firmware, and network layers

* Proficiency in Embedded C and/or C++
* U.S. Person as defined by ITAR (22 CFR §120.62)

**NICE TO HAVE**

* Experience with C# and/or Python
* Prior work in a manufacturing or production-floor environment
* Familiarity with Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) specifically

The contractor will be responsible for accelerating critical computational workloads (such as signal processing or array arithmetic) using ARM NEON SIMD instructions and interfacing custom C/C++ applications with hardware IP blocks in the FPGA logic. Scope of Work & Deliverables
  
High-Performance Multi-Threading: Architect and implement efficient C/C++ userspace applications utilizing POSIX threads (pthreads), thread isolation, CPU affinity, and lock-free synchronization routines to handle real-time streaming data on embedded Linux.
  
ARM NEON Optimization: Vectorize and optimize critical algorithmic loops using ARM NEON intrinsics and assembly to maximize SIMD throughput on ARM Cortex-A processor cores.
  
FPGA Hardware Integration: Develop robust software drivers/interfaces (e.g., Linux UIO, AXI DMA, memory-mapped registers) to exchange data between Linux software applications and custom IP blocks in the Xilinx Programmable Logic (PL).
  
Profiling & Performance Tuning: Utilize Linux profiling tools (perf, Valgrind, custom execution benchmarks) to diagnose bottlenecks, optimize cache usage, and ensure deterministic performance.
  
Technical Documentation & Code Hand-off: Deliver well-commented, productiongrade source code along with architectural notes, integration build scripts, and test procedures for internal engineering hand-off.

**Required Technical Expertise:**  
Core Programming: Expert-level C for embedded Linux environments.
  
Vector Acceleration: Hands-on proficiency with ARM NEON SIMD intrinsics and assembly-level optimization techniques.
  
Xilinx SoC Platform: Demonstrated experience with Xilinx Zynq UltraScale+ MPSoC/RFSoC platforms (PetaLinux).
  
Hardware Interfacing: Deep understanding of AXI4, PCIe, AXI DMA engines, and Linux memory management (DMA-BUF, /dev/mem, UIO).
  
Multi-Threaded Systems: Solid background in concurrent programming, memory synchronization, and real-time POSIX scheduling.
  
Tooling: Expertise with GCC/Clang cross-compilation toolchains, GDB, Vivado / Vitis, CMake, and Git.

jobs.description:
#### **Who are we?**

Longshot Space Technologies is at the cutting edge of low-cost space access and hypersonics. We are developing a novel space launch system that accelerates mass over a long distance. Using our technology, we plan to provide affordable launch services for satellites, cargo, and future space infrastructure. Our mission is to enable a future where humans can reach for the stars.

#### **Position Overview**

We are hiring a Staff Electrical Engineer to own electrical engineering across Longshot, including the people, the architecture and the hardware. You will provide leadership and expertise in defining system architecture and electronics platforms for high-voltage pulsed ignition, firing and sequencing control, instrumentation and data acquisition, safety interlocks, vehicle avionics and power, and test site power. Deliverables include circuit card assemblies (CCAs), FPGA and microprocessor designs, harnesses, and the test procedures and scripts that verify them.

The electrical team is small and works across every program. You will set its technical direction, grow it, and be the accountable owner for electrical design at design reviews and test readiness. This is a hands-on lead role: you will design and review schematics, be in the bunker on test day, and sign your name to what goes on the launcher.

#### **Job Details**

* Role Type: Full-time
* Compensation: $180,000 to $220,000 per year
* Location: Alameda, CA Onsite with 25%-30% travel for campaigns

#### **Key Responsibilities** **Architecture and design**

* Own the electrical architecture for gun systems and test vehicles: HV pulsed-power ignition, control and sequencing, instrumentation, interlocks and abort chains, power distribution and grounding.
* Derive and document engineering requirements, specifications and interface definition drawings for electrical assemblies.
* Define and control interfaces with mechanical, software, test and facilities teams.
* Define requirements for, and guide the design and implementation of, FPGAs, microcontrollers and embedded electronics for control and test systems.
* Plan CCA, chassis, rack and harness implementations, and oversee build and delivery to users and stakeholders.
* Review design analyses for accuracy and completeness and coordinate engineers into an integrated design.

**Team leadership**

* Lead, mentor and hire electrical engineers and technicians.
* Set design standards, review practices and documentation expectations, and delegate effectively.
* Lead team communication on technical issues and drive problem resolution and root cause on electrical anomalies.

**Test, verification and documentation**

* Develop test and verification plans from requirements.
* Plan and execute qualification and acceptance testing of electrical hardware.
* Produce comprehensive documentation: test procedures, results, training guides and issue reports.

**Safety and reviews**

* Drive design for safety in high-energy systems: energy storage, safe/arm, fault tolerance, isolation, discharge and lockout/tagout.
* Act as electrical authority on hazard analyses.
* Act as electrical authority at design reviews (PDR/CDR/TRR), and write and defend the electrical sections of design, interface and safety documentation.
* Participate in development of contract technical documentation for government-funded programs.
Provide technical insight and oversight of subcontracts and key suppliers.  

#### **Required Qualifications**

* BS in Electrical Engineering with 6+ years of related work experience, MS in a similar discipline with 4+ years, or PhD with 3+ years
* Strong background in design and/or analysis of analog, digital and power circuits, in one or more of pulsed power / high-voltage systems, ignition or initiation systems, test-stand control and instrumentation, or flight avionics and power
* Experience across the full design cycle from requirements through schematic, layout review, harness, build, test and field support
* Command of high-energy safety practice: energy storage hazards, interlocks, grounding and shielding, EMI in noisy high-current environments
* Proven ability as a team leader to deliver project results and manage performance standards, budgets and schedules
* Flexible and accountable: meets commitments and produces quality products within budget through effective prioritization
* Experience with configuration management tools (e.g., Git, Jira)
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Exceptional interpersonal skills, working effectively with internal and external program leadership and with every level of the team, from technicians to customers
* Comfort writing for review boards and customers, making a design decision legible to someone who was not in the room
Desire to be hands-on, on-site and at the test stand  

#### **Preferred Qualifications**

* FPGA-based embedded electronics or firmware-hardware co-design
* Power electronics and power-bus interfaces (battery, capacitor bank, high-current DC)
* High-speed DAQ: piezoelectric pressure, strain, accelerometers, high-speed video triggering; NI, Dewesoft or similar

**Endiatx, Inc. · Hayward, California · Full-time**

**About Endiatx**

Endiatx is a medical device company developing medical robotic systems for diagnostic use inside the human body. Our flagship platforms include PillBot™, a propeller-driven endoscopic capsule designed to enable real-time visualization of the stomach, and PillVue™, a passive capsule endoscopy system designed to improve access to gastrointestinal diagnostics.  
We are a multidisciplinary team of engineers, clinicians, and operators building a new category of medical diagnostics at the intersection of robotics, imaging, and AI.

**Role Summary**

We are hiring an Electrical Engineer to design, prototype, and test compact, low-power electronic hardware for our medical device platforms. You will develop circuit boards and electrical subsystems with a focus on battery power management, motor drivers, and integration with imaging and communication interfaces.

This is a hands-on role spanning schematic design, PCB development, board bring-up, laboratory debugging, and system integration. You will work closely with Firmware, Software, Mechanical, Mechatronics, Manufacturing, and Quality teams to deliver reliable hardware and documented test results.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Translate system requirements into electrical specifications, circuit architectures, and component selections.

* Design analog, digital, and mixed-signal circuits, including power supplies, sensor interfaces, and motor-control circuitry as needed.

* Own schematic design and PCB development through release, including layout execution or direction and review of layout resources, grounding, signal integrity, thermal behavior, and test access.

* Perform board bring-up and debug circuits using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, multimeters, and laboratory power supplies.

* Develop power budgets and characterize battery behavior, startup, brownout response, noise, and electrical performance against defined requirements.

* Collaborate with Firmware and Software engineers on hardware interfaces, timing, communication protocols, and fault handling.

* Integrate electronics with mechanical packaging and mechatronic subsystems and resolve issues found during system testing.

* Develop electrical test procedures and fixtures, investigate hardware faults, and verify corrective design changes with documented test results.

* Partner with Quality, specialist engineers, and external laboratories on electrical safety, electromagnetic compatibility, and applicable wireless testing.

* Maintain schematics, bills of materials, PCB fabrication and assembly files, and design revisions under change control.

* Support supplier reviews, component substitutions, manufacturing test development, design reviews, and hardware risk assessments.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

* Approximately 3-5 years of relevant electronic hardware design and development experience.

* Experience designing analog and digital circuits and taking PCB designs from schematics through layout review, board bring-up, and release using Altium, KiCad, OrCAD, or an equivalent platform.

* Experience designing low-power, battery-powered electronics, with strong understanding of circuit analysis, power management, grounding, signal integrity, and component selection.

* Ability to manage assigned projects and collaborate across engineering disciplines and with manufacturing partners.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience developing medical devices or other electronics within a regulated quality system.

Our goal is to empower U.S. ally nations to effectively deter aggressors — regardless of their defense budget — through innovative, cost-efficient technologies. We call this vision “democratized deterrence.” As a VC-backed company at the intersection of defense and Silicon Valley, we’re pioneering the development of mission-adaptable aerial vehicles that put power back into the hands of operators. By prioritizing operator effectiveness, we’re pioneering a new era of aerial vehicle design. jobs.title: Staff Technical Program Manager, Firmware Lifecycle and Release Management
jobs.description:
Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

**About the Role:**

Crusoe Cloud runs AI infrastructure at a scale where a single firmware or software baseline can determine whether thousands of GPUs deliver for our customers. As a Staff Technical Program Manager, you will own the end-to-end release lifecycle for versioned firmware and software baselines across our GPU fleet. That covers everything from scoping and qualification through phased rollout and production deployment. This is a builder role: you will run complex releases across Compute, Networking, Storage, Orchestration, and Operations, and you will design the release calendars, validation frameworks, and metrics that let Crusoe scale them predictably.

We’re looking for an engineer-rooted TPM who is comfortable in the white space between teams and who earns trust with engineers and vendors through technical depth and execution rigor. You’ll identify risks before they surface, drive alignment across engineering leads without direct authority, and give leadership clear, data-driven decision points. This is a full-time position.

**What You'll Be Working On:**

* **Own the Release Lifecycle End to End:** Lead versioned firmware and software baselines from scoping and definition through qualification, validation, phased rollout, and production deployment across a large GPU fleet.
* **Orchestrate Cross-Functional Releases:** Drive release programs across Compute, Networking, Storage, Orchestration, and Operations. Set entry and exit criteria, layered validation, domain sign-offs, and go/no-go decisions.
* **Lead Fleet-Wide Upgrade Campaigns:** Coordinate upgrades on live production clusters with Operations and customer-facing teams, including maintenance planning, rollback strategies, and risk mitigation.
* **Drive Security and CVE Response:** Partner with engineering leads to make fast, well-reasoned decisions on security patches and CVEs, and fold them into the release train.
* **Govern Vendor Relationships:** Work with OEMs, ODMs, and component and silicon suppliers on firmware fixes, validation timelines, and roadmaps. Escalate and resolve issues that put Crusoe’s schedule at risk.
* **Build the Machine:** Design lightweight, scalable release calendars, validation frameworks, Jira workflows, and metrics that make Crusoe’s release process predictable as the fleet grows.
* **Surface Risk and Drive Decisions:** Maintain real-time visibility into release health, map cross-team dependencies, and deliver crisp executive updates that spotlight decisions and trade-offs.
* **Improve Continuously:** Lead retrospectives after major releases and feed the learnings back into the process. Apply AI tools to improve tracking, risk detection, and communication across your programs.

**What You'll Bring to the Team:**

* **Program Leadership at Scale:** 10+ years as a Technical Program Manager in infrastructure, hardware, or platform engineering, including release or change management at fleet scale.
* **Server Firmware Expertise:** Working knowledge of the server firmware stack, including BMC, BIOS, GPU firmware and drivers, and NIC and switch firmware.
* **Influence Without Authority:** Proven experience running validation or qualification programs across many engineering teams without direct authority.
* **Risk and Dependency Management:** Ability to anticipate what will break before it does, then drive mitigation plans and rollback strategies for live production environments.
* **Process Builder’s Mindset:** Track record of creating fit-for-purpose frameworks, such as release calendars, validation gates, and metrics, rather than forcing programs into rigid templates.
* **Executive Communication:** Ability to translate complex technical status into clear, data-driven updates and decision-ready recommendations.
* **Educational Foundation:** Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.

**Bonus Points**

Job Title: Systems Hardware Design Engineer

**Experience:** 3+ years  
**Department:** Hardware Engineering / R&D  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Location:** On-site in Irvine, California  
**Salary Range:** $100,000 – $150,000 per year, based on experience

**About Omnitron**

Omnitron Systems Technology designs and manufactures fiber media converters, PoE switches, single pair Ethernet products, and network demarcation devices that keep critical networks running. Headquartered in Irvine, California, we design and manufacture all of our products in the United States, and they are trusted and used by government agencies, utilities, data centers, process automation, security surveillance, and service providers. As a focused, engineering-driven company, our hardware engineers see their designs through from concept to production, working closely with the various cross functional teams.

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a motivated and technically skilled Systems Hardware Design Engineer to design, develop, test, and validate electronic hardware systems. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in digital and analog circuit design, schematic capture, and supervising PCB layout. The engineer will be responsible for the complete hardware development lifecycle, from system-level requirements and circuit design through PCB layout, prototype bring-up, debugging, verification, and product release.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own hardware design from requirements to release. Define system architecture, design digital, analog, mixed-signal, and power supply circuits, and create schematics in industry-standard EDA tools.
* Select components such as microcontrollers, processors, interfaces, sensors, and power devices, using datasheet review and trade-off analysis.
* Supervise outsourced PCB layout. Set placement, stackup, routing, and impedance constraints; review layouts for grounding, power distribution, and signal integrity; and approve fabrication and assembly files.
* Lead board bring-up of prototype and production hardware using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and other lab equipment.
* Plan and run verification, validation, and qualification testing, including functional, electrical, and performance tests.
* Drive design-for-manufacturing and design-for-test (DFM/DFT), and support production through fabrication, assembly, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.
* Produce and maintain design documentation: schematics, BOMs, test reports, engineering change records, and production transition documents (assembly, test, and programming instructions).
* Work closely with firmware, FPGA, mechanical, systems, manufacturing, and test teams, including leading design reviews.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field.
* Strong fundamentals in analog and digital electronics, including circuit analysis, component behavior, signal conditioning, and power management.
* Experience with microcontroller-based designs and common interfaces such as SPI, I²C, UART, USB, and Ethernet.
* Hands-on schematic capture and a command of PCB layout principles (grounding, decoupling, impedance control, routing, EMI/EMC), plus experience managing external layout, fabrication, and assembly vendors.
* Proven hardware debugging skills with standard lab instruments, and the ability to own designs independently while working closely with a multidisciplinary team.
* Experience with EMC compliance testing, ESD protection, and electrical safety.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* FPGA development in Verilog or VHDL, including simulation, synthesis, and timing analysis.
* High-speed digital and mixed-signal design, including signal integrity, power integrity, DC-DC converters, LDOs, and power sequencing.
* Networking or ruggedized hardware, such as Ethernet PHYs and switches, fiber optic transceivers (SFP), PoE, or industrial-temperature electronics.
* EDA tools such as Altium Designer, Cadence Allegro/OrCAD, Siemens Xpedition, or KiCad.

* 401(k) with profit sharing and health benefits.
* Opportunities to work across the complete hardware product development lifecycle.
* Hands-on exposure to challenging electronic design and system integration projects.
* Collaboration with experienced engineers across hardware, firmware, FPGA, and systems disciplines.
* Opportunities for technical growth and increasing design ownership based on experience.

jobs.title: Senior/Staff Hardware Design Engineer
jobs.description:
**What to Expect**
==================

Heron Power is a startup company building cutting-edge power electronics for the 21st-century grid. We aim to debottleneck the growth of electricity generation and consumption with scalable, innovative, and less costly hardware solutions, accelerating the electrification of everything.

Our first goal is to build better converters (inverters & rectifiers) to connect large-scale renewables, storage, and loads like datacenters to the grid. Heron Power’s leadership team is made up of seasoned veterans who have designed and shipped gigawatts of power conversion products over the past decade.

We understand that no one individual knows everything. We will all learn *a lot* together and from each other. We strive to build a collaborative, enriching environment conducive to personal, technical, and career growth. You can expect to work in a dynamic and collaborative environment, driven by first principles engineering, solving difficult problems.

**Job Overview**
================

As an Senior/Staff Hardware Design Engineer, you will be responsible for architecting, designing, and integrating the low voltage electrical system within high-performance power converters to meet reliability, EMC, and safety requirements. You will define cabinet-level electrical architecture, manage harnessing and interconnects, and ensure proper distribution of power, signals, and control across subsystems. Your work will span the full product lifecycle—from concept development and component selection to schematic capture, validation, and support through production.

**How You Will Contribute**
===========================

* *Own the full hardware development lifecycle—from requirements definition and modeling through schematic capture, PCB layout, prototyping, testing, validation, and manufacturing support.*
* *Define and implement the low voltage electrical architecture for cabinet-based systems, including cabinet microprocessors, power supplies, power distribution, interconnects, and signal processing and routing.*
* *Select appropriate LV components such as microcontrollers, interface circuits, fuses, relays, contactors, terminal blocks, and power supplies based on system requirements and reliability targets.*
* *Create system block diagrams, schematics, and harness documentation to support cross-functional development and manufacturing.*
* *Ensure electrical interface integrity across PCBs, sensors, actuators, and communication buses (e.g., CAN, RS-485, Ethernet, LV analog/digital I/O).*
* *Collaborate with mechanical teams on enclosure layout, cable routing, shielding, and grounding strategies for EMI/EMC performance.*
* *Support validation and bring-up of LV systems during prototype and production builds, including DVT and integration testing.*
* *Ensure compliance with safety and regulatory standards such as UL, CE, and IEC for low voltage systems.*
* *Coordinate with firmware, test, and manufacturing teams to ensure proper system behavior, integration, and serviceability.*

**What You Will Bring**
=======================

By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

Maritime Digital Production (MDP) is the software and digital systems function within Anduril's Heavy Metal division. Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

Maritime Digital Production (MDP) is the software and digital systems function within Anduril's Heavy Metal division. We build and deploy the full technology stack that powers Anduril's shipbuilding factories: the data infrastructure that makes every machine and sensor visible in real time, the manufacturing execution system (ArsenalOS) that workers and planners use every shift, the scheduling engine that replans production in minutes instead of days, and the AI systems that eliminate manual toil from both the shop floor and business operations.  
  
MDP operates at the boundary between Operational Technology and Information Technology. Our systems live where factory-floor machines, edge compute, and OT networks meet enterprise platforms and cloud infrastructure. We incubate solutions close to the production line, validate them with real operators building real hardware, harden them for reliability and security, and then scale them across multiple sites. The environment is fast, physical, and consequential. When our systems go down, production stops. The output of our work is not a dashboard: it is a ship.  
  
This is not a support function. It is a strategic investment by Anduril in the premise that digitizing the manufacturing lifecycle end-to-end, from engineering definition through scheduling through execution through field feedback, is how Heavy Metal will out-build, out-adapt, and out-scale the traditional defense industrial base. MDP is scaling from a founding team to 70+ engineers across multiple U.S. sites. You will be joining early, working on hard problems with real operational stakes, and shaping how manufacturing software is built at Anduril from the ground up.

### **ABOUT THE JOB**

As a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer on the ArsenalOS Deployment initiative, you will build the full-stack web applications that power daily planning, work assignment, and team-lead dashboards on the factory floor. You will develop offline-capable, mobile-friendly interfaces that factory operators depend on in network-constrained environments where reliability and usability are non-negotiable.  
  
You will Own Maritime-specific manufacturing software requirements end to end. As well as the build-vs-extend decision for each ask. Today that's centered on shop-floor execution (scheduling capability in our MES); the mandate extends to whatever MES, ERP, and adjacent manufacturing capabilities Maritime needs next. Design, develop, deploy and operate across Maritime's factories.

  

### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Build full-stack web applications for daily production planning, work assignment, and team-lead operational dashboards that drive real-time factory execution.
* Develop offline-capable and mobile-friendly interfaces designed for the factory floor, ensuring operators can work seamlessly in network-constrained or intermittent connectivity environments.
* Partner with manufacturing engineers and factory operators to understand production workflows and translate them into software requirements.
* Write production-quality code with comprehensive tests, participating in code review and architectural discussions.
* Design and implement robust offline-first architectures using service workers, local storage, and background sync to ensure application functionality regardless of network conditions.
* Build responsive, touch-optimized mobile interfaces that work on tablets and mobile devices in harsh manufacturing environments (gloves, low light, vibration).
* Architect and implement data synchronization strategies that handle conflict resolution and maintain data integrity between edge devices and backend systems.
* Deploy and operate your systems in factory environments, including edge compute clusters and OT networks.
* Leverage AI tooling (coding assistants, automation) in your development workflow and contribute to team engineering practices.
* Join an on-call rotation supporting production factory systems.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with backend engineers, data engineers, factory systems teams, and operations to ensure seamless integration with MES, data pipelines, and enterprise systems.
* Set technical direction and mentor junior engineers on best practices for building resilient, user-centered manufacturing software.

### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* 8+ years of experience in a software engineering role building production systems, ideally in a fast-paced environment.
* Deep expertise in full-stack web development, with demonstrated mastery of both frontend and backend systems.
* Strong technical fluency in modern software architectures, APIs, distributed systems, CI/CD, and cloud or edge infrastructure.
* Proficiency with web-based technologies including JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, and modern web frameworks.
* Experience building offline-capable web applications using service workers, IndexedDB, local storage, and progressive web app (PWA) patterns.
* Experience building systems that must operate reliably under real-world operational constraints (high availability, low latency, or constrained environments).
* Experience working with large enterprise applications and platforms with high availability requirements.

jobs.title: Director, Electrical Engineering
jobs.description:
Atomic Machines is building the Matter Compiler™, the first in a new class of AI-native, all-digital manufacturing systems that build working machines directly from code. The Matter Compiler (MC) is aimed at micro-machines: motors and gears the size of a grain of sand, robots small enough to work inside the body, cooling built directly into the chips that run AI, and the many devices like them that have been waiting on a way to build them. Its first product is PrimeSwitch™, an electromechanical power relay the size of a button battery that carries 150 amps continuous current and opens in 50 microseconds, about a thousand times faster than a conventional contactor. Founded by Jeff Holden — serial entrepreneur, ex-Amazon SVP and Uber's first Chief Product Officer — the company has raised $250 million to date.

Atomic Machines is based in the San Francisco Bay Area, with offices in Emeryville and Santa Clara.

### **About The Role:**

Atomic Machines is building autonomous manufacturing systems that combine a core robotics platform with a diverse set of manufacturing processes. As Director of Electrical Engineering, you'll lead Electrical Engineering in developing electronics and electrical architectures spanning core motion control hardware, sensor/actuator interfaces, and specialized manufacturing systems. You will also lead an Electrical Integration team in defining interconnect strategy and driving interconnect diagrams (ICDs), harness design and procurement, system bring-up, and integration.

You'll organize development across the core robotics platform and manufacturing process portfolio while building a cohesive, scalable electrical architecture. Working proactively with cross-functional partners, the CTO, and EE technical leaders, you'll uncover needs, align priorities, and balance shared platforms with process-specific designs.

### **What You'll Do:**

* Shape electrical engineering strategy across the core robotics platform and manufacturing process portfolio. Proactively uncover cross-functional needs and translate them into a roadmap, priorities, resource plans, and clear commitments.
* Build a cohesive, scalable electrical architecture across robotics and process systems. Work with the CTO and technical leaders to establish shared platforms and interfaces, balancing reuse with specialized requirements.
* Drive end-to-end delivery. Lead electronics development and electrical integration, including interconnect strategy, interconnect diagrams (ICDs), harness design and procurement, system bring-up, and verification; manage dependencies and adapt plans as requirements evolve.
* Provide deep technical leadership. Lead rigorous design reviews, challenge assumptions, and guide engineers through consequential tradeoffs and difficult technical problems.
* Set and enforce organization-wide EE standards. Establish consistent practices for design review, documentation, verification, and release, including work outside the core EE team.
* Ensure robust electrical systems. Address safety, protection, reliability, manufacturability, and serviceability throughout development, including specialized and high-voltage hardware.
* Build and develop the organization. Hire and coach strong engineers and leaders, delegate ownership, and establish clear expectations for quality and execution.

### **What You'll Need:**

* Deep electrical engineering expertise, with the ability to reason from fundamentals, evaluate architecture and detailed designs, and provide credible technical guidance on complex problems.
* Experience delivering complex electromechanical systems from design through bring-up, integration, validation, and operation.
* A track record of organizing development across varied systems, balancing specialized requirements with shared architecture, reuse, and scalability.
* Proactive cross-functional leadership: uncovering needs, shaping requirements, developing technical roadmaps, and securing alignment through execution.
* Experience building and leading strong engineering organizations, including hiring, coaching, developing leaders, managing performance, and delegating ownership.
* Experience establishing engineering standards across distributed teams and driving accountability beyond direct reporting lines.
* A bachelor's or master's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

### **Additional Experience We Value:**

* Electrical engineering leadership in autonomous machinery, robotics, advanced manufacturing, or similarly complex equipment.
* Design and validation of specialized electrical systems for manufacturing or other physical processes, including high-voltage or precision power applications.

Atomic Machines is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity and does not discriminate based on characteristics protected by applicable law. We are committed to an inclusive interview experience, including for individuals with disabilities. To request an accommodation, contact rc@atomicmachines.com. To help our recruiting team manage application volume and respond to candidates more efficiently, Atomic Machines may use AI-assisted tools.

jobs.title: Senior AI Systems Engineer- Autonomous Driving
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

**We Are Bosch.**

At Bosch, we shape the future by inventing high-quality technologies and services that spark enthusiasm and enrich people’s lives. Our areas of activity are every bit as diverse as our outstanding Bosch teams around the world. Their creativity is the key to innovation through connected living, mobility, or industry.

Let’s grow together, enjoy more, and inspire each other. Work #LikeABosch

* **Reinvent yourself:** At Bosch, you will evolve.
* **Discover new directions:** At Bosch, you will find your place.
* **Balance your life:** At Bosch, your job matches your lifestyle.
* **Celebrate success:** At Bosch, we celebrate you.
* **Be yourself:** At Bosch, we value values.
* **Shape tomorrow:** At Bosch, you change lives.

At Bosch, “Invented for Life” is what drives us and our vision of global future mobility. Bosch has an outstanding track record on pioneering key technologies worldwide which shapes the way we move. The next big milestone in our sight is to make autonomous vehicles a reality, bringing its benefits to today's roads.

 **Job Description**

In this role, you will operate as a Senior AI Systems Engineer, setting technical direction across multiple teams, influencing architecture and engineering standards, and elevating technical capabilities across the organization.

We are seeking a Systems Engineer with strong leadership skills to build and enhance our AI-focused systems engineering and testing frameworks. In this role, you will guide the design, implementation, and evaluation of our Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) and Autonomous Driving (AD) technologies. You will serve as the technical lead for a cross-functional team, integrating modern software development practices to help realize safe, reliable self-driving vehicles and empower our global R&D teams.

**Responsibilities:**

* Architect and scale intelligent failure triaging and automated Root Cause Analysis (RCA) frameworks capable of processing petabyte-scale simulation and real-world vehicle logs.
* Apply modern AI/ML methods (e.g., LLMs/VLMs, time-series anomaly detection, statistical pattern recognition, and causal inference) to automatically isolate failure modes across perception, planning, control, and vehicle platform layers.
* Integrate automated triaging into continuous integration, regression testing, and cloud replay pipelines (SiL/HiL/ViL) to streamline software release cycles and raise validation standards across engineering groups.
* Establish best practices for log data structures, automated analytics workflows, vector search/embeddings for failure mode retrieval, and ML pipeline reliability.
* Partner directly with autonomy software leads, validation engineers, and cloud infrastructure teams to align toolsets and integrate automated diagnostics into day-to-day R&D workflows.

  
**Qualifications**  

* Master’s degree or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 5+ years of progressive engineering experience in software development, data analytics infrastructure, or automated testing for autonomous vehicles, robotics, or complex distributed systems.
* 2+ years of experience leading technical architecture, setting engineering strategy, or guiding technical direction across multiple engineering teams.
* Expert proficiency in Python and C++, with demonstrated experience building production-grade data pipelines, distributed execution frameworks, or testing infrastructure.
* Hands-on experience working with big data structures, robotics logging formats (e.g., ROS/ROS2, MCAP, Protobuf, CAN logs), and cloud data storage.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated experience applying LLMs/VLMs, sequence modeling, pattern recognition, or vector embeddings to log classification, failure mode retrieval, or automated root cause analysis.
* In-depth understanding of autonomous driving software architectures (perception, sensor fusion, localization, motion planning, vehicle control).
* Experience operating within SiL, HiL, or cloud-based replay and simulation testing setups at scale.
* Experience with distributed frameworks and data tools such as PySpark, Ray, Databricks/Snowflake, Vector DBs, Apache Airflow, Kubernetes, and AWS/GCP services.

  
**Additional Information**

We offer a competitive base salary for this position with a range in US-California of -$185,000 - $215,000 along with an annual corporate bonus, and a long-term incentive bonus designed to reward sustained impact and contribution over time. Within the salary range, the individual pay is determined based on several factors, including, but not limited to, work experience and job knowledge, complexity of the role, job location, etc.

Your well-being matters at Bosch! We offer a a benefits package designed to empower you in every area of your life. This includes premium health coverage, a 401(k) with generous matching, resources for financial planning and goal setting, ample paid time off, parental leave, and comprehensive life and disability protection. Your Recruiter can share more details for this position during the interview process.

Learn more about our full benefits offerings by visiting: https://www.myboschbenefits.com/public/welcome.

**Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability / veterans.**

* Bosch adheres to Federal, State, and Local laws regarding drug-testing. Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a drug screen and background check. Candidates who have been offered the position must pass both screenings before their start date.

jobs.title: Internal Tool Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Terranova**
-------------------

Terranova is a hard-tech company developing innovative systems to reshape the physical world. We combine mechanical engineering, robotics, automation, and real-world field operations to tackle complex engineering challenges.

We're looking for an **AI Tool Engineer** to help us build smarter, more efficient ways of working across our engineering, manufacturing, and field operations.

**About the Role**
------------------

As an AI Tool Engineer at Terranova, you'll develop practical AI-powered tools, software, and analytical models that improve how our team designs, builds, tests, and operates complex machinery.

This is a highly hands-on role focused on solving real engineering and operational problems. You'll work closely with mechanical, electrical, software, and field engineers to identify inefficiencies, automate repetitive workflows, and turn operational data into actionable insights.

We're looking for someone who can independently identify opportunities, rapidly prototype solutions, and deploy tools that make a measurable difference in how the company operates.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**AI Tools & Workflow Automation**

* Design and build internal AI-powered tools that streamline engineering, manufacturing, and operational workflows.
* Identify repetitive, manual, or cumbersome processes and develop software solutions to automate them.
* Integrate AI tools with existing engineering software, databases, documentation, and operational systems.
* Build internal applications that help engineers and operators access information, make decisions, and complete tasks more efficiently.

**Data Analysis & Process Optimization**

* Develop systems to collect, track, and analyze metrics across shop operations, equipment performance, and field activities.
* Analyze field injection data, including flow rates, pressures, material consumption, ground uplift, and operational efficiency.
* Build dashboards, reporting tools, and data pipelines to visualize performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Help quantify engineering and manufacturing processes to establish benchmarks, monitor performance, and reduce inefficiencies.
* Develop models to predict operational outcomes, improve process parameters, and support engineering decisions.

**Modeling & Applied AI**

* Build and deploy machine learning, statistical, and predictive models for engineering applications.
* Use LLMs, AI agents, and other emerging technologies to automate complex workflows and improve internal productivity.
* Develop tools for analyzing experimental results, identifying trends, and optimizing system performance.
* Explore new applications of AI across robotics, manufacturing, equipment monitoring, and field operations.

**Cross-Functional Engineering**

* Work directly with engineers, technicians, and operators to understand challenges and develop practical solutions.
* Take projects from problem identification through prototyping, implementation, and iteration.
* Build lightweight, maintainable tools that can be deployed quickly and improved based on real-world feedback.
* Proactively identify opportunities where software, data, or AI can improve the company's efficiency and capabilities.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* Strong proficiency in Python and experience building software tools, automation scripts, and data-processing pipelines.
* Experience working with LLM APIs, AI agents, machine learning frameworks, or applied AI systems.
* Ability to build end-to-end applications, from data ingestion and backend logic to simple user interfaces.
* Strong data analysis skills, including SQL, Pandas, and statistical modeling.
* Experience integrating APIs, databases, and third-party software platforms.
* Comfortable working with messy, incomplete, or unstructured real-world data.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to independently take loosely defined problems and turn them into working solutions.
* Interest in physical engineering systems, manufacturing, robotics, or industrial operations.
* Ability to work closely with multidisciplinary teams and communicate technical concepts clearly.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Experience with industrial automation, PLCs, sensors, or equipment telemetry.
* Familiarity with mechanical engineering, fluid systems, hydraulics, or manufacturing processes.
* Experience with time-series data, predictive modeling, or optimization algorithms.
* Experience developing computer vision applications for industrial monitoring or quality control.
* Familiarity with CAD software, engineering simulations, or engineering data pipelines.
* Experience deploying internal tools using modern web frameworks and cloud services.

**Why Terranova?**
------------------

At Terranova, you'll have the opportunity to apply AI to real-world engineering problems rather than building software in isolation. Your work will directly influence how physical systems are designed, manufactured, tested, and operated.

You'll have significant ownership over projects, the freedom to experiment with new technologies, and the ability to see your solutions implemented in the shop and in the field.

We're looking for a builder who enjoys moving quickly, solving ambiguous problems, and using AI and software to make complex engineering operations more efficient.

jobs.title: Staff Technical Program Manager, Firmware Lifecycle and Release Management
jobs.description:
Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

**About the Role:**

Crusoe Cloud runs AI infrastructure at a scale where a single firmware or software baseline can determine whether thousands of GPUs deliver for our customers. As a Staff Technical Program Manager, you will own the end-to-end release lifecycle for versioned firmware and software baselines across our GPU fleet. That covers everything from scoping and qualification through phased rollout and production deployment. This is a builder role: you will run complex releases across Compute, Networking, Storage, Orchestration, and Operations, and you will design the release calendars, validation frameworks, and metrics that let Crusoe scale them predictably.

We’re looking for an engineer-rooted TPM who is comfortable in the white space between teams and who earns trust with engineers and vendors through technical depth and execution rigor. You’ll identify risks before they surface, drive alignment across engineering leads without direct authority, and give leadership clear, data-driven decision points. This is a full-time position.

**What You'll Be Working On:**

* **Own the Release Lifecycle End to End:** Lead versioned firmware and software baselines from scoping and definition through qualification, validation, phased rollout, and production deployment across a large GPU fleet.
* **Orchestrate Cross-Functional Releases:** Drive release programs across Compute, Networking, Storage, Orchestration, and Operations. Set entry and exit criteria, layered validation, domain sign-offs, and go/no-go decisions.
* **Lead Fleet-Wide Upgrade Campaigns:** Coordinate upgrades on live production clusters with Operations and customer-facing teams, including maintenance planning, rollback strategies, and risk mitigation.
* **Drive Security and CVE Response:** Partner with engineering leads to make fast, well-reasoned decisions on security patches and CVEs, and fold them into the release train.
* **Govern Vendor Relationships:** Work with OEMs, ODMs, and component and silicon suppliers on firmware fixes, validation timelines, and roadmaps. Escalate and resolve issues that put Crusoe’s schedule at risk.
* **Build the Machine:** Design lightweight, scalable release calendars, validation frameworks, Jira workflows, and metrics that make Crusoe’s release process predictable as the fleet grows.
* **Surface Risk and Drive Decisions:** Maintain real-time visibility into release health, map cross-team dependencies, and deliver crisp executive updates that spotlight decisions and trade-offs.
* **Improve Continuously:** Lead retrospectives after major releases and feed the learnings back into the process. Apply AI tools to improve tracking, risk detection, and communication across your programs.

**What You'll Bring to the Team:**

* **Program Leadership at Scale:** 10+ years as a Technical Program Manager in infrastructure, hardware, or platform engineering, including release or change management at fleet scale.
* **Server Firmware Expertise:** Working knowledge of the server firmware stack, including BMC, BIOS, GPU firmware and drivers, and NIC and switch firmware.
* **Influence Without Authority:** Proven experience running validation or qualification programs across many engineering teams without direct authority.
* **Risk and Dependency Management:** Ability to anticipate what will break before it does, then drive mitigation plans and rollback strategies for live production environments.
* **Process Builder’s Mindset:** Track record of creating fit-for-purpose frameworks, such as release calendars, validation gates, and metrics, rather than forcing programs into rigid templates.
* **Executive Communication:** Ability to translate complex technical status into clear, data-driven updates and decision-ready recommendations.
* **Educational Foundation:** Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.

**Bonus Points**

* Experience at a GPU cloud provider or hyperscaler managing large-scale fleets (thousands of nodes).
* A track record of driving firmware currency and compliance programs across a production fleet.
* Hands-on experience with vendor escalation management, including driving OEM/ODM and silicon partners to fix and validate firmware on tight timelines.
* Familiarity with AI accelerator platforms and the dependencies between firmware, drivers, and cluster networking.
* A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

**Benefits:**

* Competitive compensation and equity packages
* Restricted Stock Units
* Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs
* Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance
* Employer contributions to HSA account
* Paid parental leave
* Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability
* Professional development & tuition reimbursement
* Mental health & wellness supp

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Platform CAM
jobs.description:
Atomic Machines is building the Matter Compiler™, the first in a new class of AI-native, all-digital manufacturing systems that build working machines directly from code. The Matter Compiler (MC) is aimed at micro-machines: motors and gears the size of a grain of sand, robots small enough to work inside the body, cooling built directly into the chips that run AI, and the many devices like them that have been waiting on a way to build them. Its first product is PrimeSwitch™, an electromechanical power relay the size of a button battery that carries 150 amps continuous current and opens in 50 microseconds, about a thousand times faster than a conventional contactor. Founded by Jeff Holden — serial entrepreneur, ex-Amazon SVP and Uber's first Chief Product Officer — the company has raised $250 million to date.

Atomic Machines is based in the San Francisco Bay Area, with offices in Emeryville and Santa Clara.

### **Why This Role Matters**

CAM connects geometric intent with physical processes. You'll build the software infrastructure that lets process experts express where an operation acts, what effect it should produce, and which constraints it must satisfy.

The challenge is to turn that knowledge into reusable representations, algorithms and interfaces. These must extend beyond familiar etching or 3D-printing workflows to support different ways of shaping, treating and assembling materials. Success means new processes can build on shared geometric capabilities while preserving the assumptions and behavior that make each process distinct.

You'll bring strong software engineering and deep interest in geometric reasoning, working with experts who bring the physics and process knowledge.

AI fluency is central: use agents throughout development while owning the decisions, code and results you accept.

### **What You'll Do**

* Build and evolve Go and Python software infrastructure for representing geometric intent and generating physical-process operations.
* Develop reusable geometric representations and algorithms for shapes, regions, coordinate frames, spatial relationships, and process planning.
* Work with process experts to turn their knowledge into explicit models, constraints, interfaces, and acceptance criteria, including effects that vary over space or time.
* Extend shared capabilities to new processes; keep process-specific behavior explicit and integrate with machine software and fab coordination.
* Test geometric and software correctness, make generated results reproducible, and validate assumptions with experts and physical measurements.
* Use AI throughout investigation, design, implementation, testing, and documentation; inspect changes and verify results.

### **What You'll Need**

* Production software ownership, typically 8+ years for the senior target; productive Python and strong in Go or C++, with readiness to work in Go. Level is based on demonstrated scope and ability.
* Experience in, or a demonstrated deep interest in, geometric reasoning: representing shapes and spatial relationships, choosing useful abstractions, and reasoning about their limits.
* Evidence of designing reusable software infrastructure, simplifying complexity, and testing and safely evolving systems with clear interfaces.
* Strong AI fluency: provide context, challenge proposals, inspect code and meaningfully test accepted work.
* Ability to work with domain experts, make assumptions explicit, and turn their knowledge into testable software behavior.
* Care with units, coordinate frames, tolerances and approximation; willingness to learn unfamiliar physical processes and work directly with fab equipment.
* BS in CS or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Atomic Machines is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity and does not discriminate based on characteristics protected by applicable law. We are committed to an inclusive interview experience, including for individuals with disabilities. To request an accommodation, contact rc@atomicmachines.com.
