We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

The Media Group at NBCU supports a powerhouse collection of consumer-first brands including Peacock, NBC, Bravo, NBC Sports, and NBCU International. We embrace authenticity and inspire people to thrive.

Roku is one of the largest surfaces in our streaming footprint, and it's also the most constrained: the same channel has to feel fast on a top-tier Roku Ultra and on a five-year-old Roku Express with a fraction of the memory.

This role is for someone who treats those constraints as the interesting part of the job. You'll be measuring texture memory and node counts, chasing down rebuffer events in HLS manifests, and working with backend teams to shape the microservice responses that make a channel launch in under two seconds instead of six.

* Profile and tune channel performance against real device constraints: memory ceilings on legacy hardware, render thread contention, task node usage, image and texture budgets, and cold-start latency.
* Instrument and act on QoE telemetry (startup time, rebuffer ratio, exit-before-video-start, bitrate distribution), and drive those numbers down over time.
* Partner with backend teams to define and refine the microservice and BFF APIs that power the channel: catalog, playback authorization, entitlement, continue-watching, recommendations, and search.
* Implement and maintain Roku platform integrations: deep linking, Roku Search and content feeds, Continue Watching, Roku Pay / Instant Signup, and the Roku Advertising Framework.

* Shepherd releases through Roku channel certification, including performance and memory requirements, and manage the beta-to-production promotion process.
* Establish and uphold engineering standards: code review, automated testing, static analysis, and clear documentation.

* Strong grounding in software engineering best practices: separation of concerns, testability, meaningful abstractions, code review discipline, and refactoring as a habit rather than a project.
* Hands-on experience with video playback and streaming formats: HLS and/or DASH, adaptive bitrate behavior, manifest structure, buffering strategy, and DRM (Widevine and PlayReady on Roku).

Urban Sky is a venture-backed aerospace startup on a mission to pioneer humanity’s routine, easy access to the stratosphere and the value locked within it. We design, build, operate, and sell stratospheric balloon systems. The data we collect supports a wide range of applications, from real-time wildfire monitoring to urban mapping. Our technology is also employed by government customers including the Department of War (DoW), NASA, and others. Urban Sky sends flight vehicles to the stratosphere on a weekly basis.

Our team consists of engineers, makers, developers, and doers who believe in the power of human potential when passion meets utility within a small, supportive team. At Urban Sky we strive to create a team culture grounded in candor, inclusion, respect and empowerment.

We aim to build the next chapter of stratospheric history in Denver and Texas and are seeking self-starting, open-minded, and hard-working team members.

**About the role**

This is a junior software engineering seat on Urban Sky's IT team. Most of the day is IT operations work: supporting employees, running the ticket queue, onboarding and offboarding, administering Microsoft 365, imaging devices, implementing CMMC 2.0 and NIST 800-171 controls. Alongside that, you will write the automations, scripts, dashboards, and internal tools that let a small IT team support an aerospace company launching to the stratosphere every day. IT works with every team in the company, from firmware engineers and mission control to atmospheric scientists and the manufacturing floor. You will know the whole company inside six months.

Loft Orbital is making space simple. We build and operate reliable, shareable satellites that give customers a faster, simpler path to orbit. By combining flight-proven spacecraft platforms with our own hardware and software, we make it easier to deploy missions in space.

As an **Embedded Software Engineer**, you'll develop the low-level software that brings our spacecraft hardware to life. You'll focus on hardware abstraction layers (HALs), device drivers, and hardware interfaces, working closely with hardware, FPGA, and systems engineers to integrate and debug complex electronics. This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys digging into the details, solving problems at the hardware/software boundary, and seeing their code fly in space.

* Develop unit and integration tests to validate software on target hardware.
* Collaborate with hardware, FPGA, and systems engineers to deliver robust, flight-ready solutions.

* ARM-based SoCs and FPGA integration.

We are looking for a **Test Infrastructure Engineer** to join the team building and maintaining Loft’s test infrastructure internationally across our Golden, CO, San Francisco, CA, and Toulouse, France sites.

As a **Test Infrastructure Engineer**, you will primarily help design, develop, and deploy our test infrastructure and the tools for automating both our hardware and software testing, which will help us scale as a company.Sitting between the spacecraft and all the other teams, you will have a big impact in ensuring that every element of our satellite works without any bugs.We are looking for engineers with a product mindset, who have a good understanding of embedded systems, networking, data exchange protocols, and experience with setting up software infrastructures. Additionally, we are looking for someone who is:

* Able to work independently with some guidance. People owning their work is important to us!

jobs.title: Senior Silicon Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
At Atom Computing, we build quantum computers using arrays of optically trapped neutral atoms that will empower customers to achieve unprecedented computational breakthroughs. Join a world-class team of scientists, engineers, and business professionals to advance the state-of-the-art in quantum computing.

We are seeking a Senior Silicon Systems Engineer to bridge the gap between custom silicon and highly complex hardware integration within Atom’s research and product development programs. This role would be responsible for defining system requirements, architecture design, and system level testing across the chip, PCBs, and auxiliary hardware subsystems.

The ideal candidate can translate requirements into a coherent system architecture and has experience applying systems engineering best practices to emerging technologies.

### **Job Responsibilities**

### **Architecture & Design Integration**

* Develop and document system architecture, including subsystem interactions
* Produce system-level design documentation and interface control documents (ICDs), including the chip–PCB–controller boundaries
* Lead chip-level system specs with ASIC designers, analyzing trade-offs across silicon, PCB, and software

### **System Definition & Requirements Management**

* Develop specifications for ASICs, PCBs, controllers, and supporting hardware based on research goals maintaining clear traceability to system-level requirements.
* Work with engineers to translate measured performance, limitations, and operational experience into requirements for PCBs, controllers, RF/analog electronics, and auxiliary hardware.
* Manage change control processes for evolving architectures and requirements.

### **Risk Management & Technical Planning**

* Identify, quantify, and track technical risks, opportunities, and mitigations
* Engage in ASIC architectural reviews and tape-out readiness milestones, evaluating system-level implications of engineering modifications alongside silicon risks including respins, IP integration, and schedule impact.

### **Integration, Verification, and Validation (IV&V)**

* Link pre-silicon verification coverage and post-silicon bring-up and characterization results back to system-level requirements
* Plan system-level integration of the ASIC into PCBs and auxiliary hardware, including bring-up sequencing

### **Collaboration & Communication**

* Act as technical liaison between Theory, Quantum Engineering, Hardware, Software, Controls, ASIC Design and Verification, and Optical Engineering
* Support customer interactions, including government program reviews, technical interchange meetings, and milestone reporting.

### **Experience & Education**

* BS or higher in Systems Engineering, Physics, Electrical Engineering, Optical Engineering or a related field
* 5+ years of systems engineering experience in complex, multidisciplinary R&D or production environments (quantum, aerospace, defense, advanced computing, or similar)

### **Required Qualifications**

* Proven ability to lead requirements development, interface control, and V&V planning across engineering and science disciplines
* Experience with system architecture, requirements management tools, and configuration management systems
* Demonstrated experience with risk management frameworks
Experience with silicon integration  

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced degree (MS or PhD) in engineering, physics, or a related discipline
* Familiarity with quantum computing, atomic and optical (AMO) physics, or control system integration
* Experience preparing and presenting SRR/PDR/CDR artifacts
* Experience supporting government-funded research or procurement programs (DoD, DoE, DoC)

Atom Computing provides a wide variety of perks and benefits, including fully paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for our employees and their dependents. Additionally, unlimited paid time off, 401K company matching, short- and long-term disability, FSA, dependent care benefits, and life insurance. We also offer drinks, snacks, and catered team lunches in our offices, every day!

The base salary range for this position is between $140,000 - $160,000, commensurate with experience. In addition to salary, we offer an annual bonus and equity in the company.

* Pawcatuck, CT

We are seeking an experienced Senior Electrical Engineer to lead the design and development of an advanced inductive power and data acquisition system for maritime applications.
  
This role will focus on developing a high-reliability, low-noise data acquisition system that operates through an air-gapped inductive power and communications interface.

The ideal candidate brings strong expertise in mixed-signal electronics, precision data acquisition, power electronics, magnetics, and embedded communications, with a proven ability to develop reliable hardware for harsh and mission-critical environments.

Working as part of a multidisciplinary engineering team, you will play a key technical role in advancing innovative technology targeted for U.S. Navy deployment.
  
This is an opportunity to take ownership of complex engineering challenges, influence system architecture, and work directly with engineers and customers in a collaborative, technically driven environment.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Lead the architecture, design, development, and validation of low-noise, high-reliability data acquisition systems operating through inductive power and communications links.
* Design analog front-end circuitry, including high-resolution ADC interfaces, filtering, clocking, signal conditioning, and noise reduction.
* Develop and optimize inductive power transfer systems, including coil and magnetic designs, driver circuits, rectification, voltage regulation, and DC/DC conversion.
* Design and validate digital communications over inductive interfaces, including modulation, encoding, error correction, and data integrity.
* Own analog and digital PCB development, including schematic design, component selection, layout reviews, and mixed-signal design practices.
* Integrate data acquisition, power, and communications subsystems into electromechanical assemblies for maritime and underwater applications.
* Conduct system-level testing, troubleshooting, and performance optimization using laboratory instrumentation and diagnostic tools.
* Collaborate with embedded software engineers to ensure proper firmware integration, timing, sequencing, configuration, and fault management.
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers while contributing to architecture discussions, design reviews, and prototype evaluations.
* Develop technical documentation, test plans, engineering analyses, and presentations for internal teams and customers.
* Support field testing and technology demonstrations, including occasional travel of up to 10%.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering with 5+ years of relevant experience; Master’s degree with 3+ years; or PhD with relevant academic experience.
* Strong background in mixed-signal design, power electronics, and/or precision data acquisition systems.
* Demonstrated expertise in low-noise analog circuit design, including sensor interfaces, ADC-based acquisition systems, grounding, and noise optimization.
* Experience designing high-efficiency power electronics, including DC/DC converters, magnetics, MOSFET/IGBT circuits, and power amplifiers.
* Proficiency in mixed-signal PCB design, component selection, schematic development, and layout considerations for noise-sensitive applications.
* Experience with microcontrollers, embedded processors, and digital communication protocols such as SPI, I2C, and RS-422.
* Understanding of EMI/EMC requirements and designing electronics for demanding environmental conditions.
* Strong hands-on laboratory skills, including troubleshooting complex electronic systems and validating hardware performance.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams and customers.
* Ability to obtain and maintain a Secret security clearance.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience developing electrical systems for underwater, maritime, defense, or other mission-critical applications.
* Background in inductive power transfer, magnetic coupling, or wireless power systems.
* Familiarity with Altium Designer for schematic capture and PCB layout.
* Experience with LTspice, MATLAB, or similar circuit simulation and engineering analysis tools.
* Previous experience providing technical mentorship or leading engineering design teams.
* Familiarity with electromechanical systems, acoustic sensors, or underwater transducer technology.

**Why This Opportunity?**

This is an opportunity for a technically strong electrical engineer to take ownership of sophisticated hardware development supporting advanced maritime and defense applications. You’ll work on challenging engineering problems, influence system architecture, collaborate across disciplines, and see your designs progress from concept through testing and deployment.

The position is particularly well suited for an engineer who enjoys hands-on design, solving complex mixed-signal and power electronics challenges, and contributing to technology with real-world mission impact.

Discover opportunities to make a difference at RTX.

**What You Will Do**

Control & Diagnostic Systems (CDS) is a discipline within P&W Engineering, responsible for control system architecture, safety and reliability, thermal management, dynamic analysis, software design and verification.

Within CDS, the Control System Engineering and Electrification (CSEE) is responsible for the end-to-end Control Systems Engineering and Electrical Propulsion Systems Engineering Value Stream.

Within CSEE, the Electric Propulsion System Engineering (EPSE) group is responsible for architecting, designing, and developing game-changing hybrid-electric propulsion systems. EPSE engineers work across all CDS subdisciplines to help achieve program objectives of the CDS CIPT.

EPSE engineers apply skills from across a wide range of PW Engineering disciplines such as Performance, Operability, Mechanical Disciplines, Aerothermal Management, to develop, integrate and certify subsystems and hardware for Civil and Military customers. EPSE engineers work the entire system life cycle from 1) control system technology development, 2) interpreting customer requirements, decomposing them to hardware and software, 3) technical and project oversight of hardware implementation, to 4) ensuring control system compliance across engine, flight and customer compliance testing, and finally, 5) leading system and hardware field issue triage and resolution.

EPSE engineers work collaboratively with industry partners, including key suppliers and customers, in a team environment, to advance the technology readiness level of emerging hybrid-electric systems and components. EPSE engineers support the concept design definition, system integration, prototype testing and product detail design development, certification and validation, both for systems and components. EPSE engineers support technical proposals, cost estimates, concept trade-off analysis and modeling, in support of advanced hybrid-electric projects.

jobs.title: Optical Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
TTM Technologies, Inc. – Publicly Traded US Company, NASDAQ (TTMI) – Top-5 Global Printed Circuit Board Manufacturer

**About TTM**
-------------

TTM Technologies, Inc. is a leading global manufacturer of technology products, including mission systems, radio frequency (“RF”) components, RF microwave/microelectronic assemblies, and technologically advanced printed circuit boards (“PCB”s). TTM stands for time-to-market, representing how TTM's time-critical, one-stop design, engineering and manufacturing services enable customers to reduce the time required to develop new products and bring them to market .

Additional information can be found at www.ttm.com

We are seeking an Optical Systems Engineer with strong optics and photonics fundamentals and a hands-on approach to designing, building, and evaluating optical systems. The right candidate can connect optical theory and modeling with experimental results, translate evolving technical needs into practical designs and measurement approaches, and collaborate effectively across mechanical, electrical, controls, and manufacturing disciplines.

This role provides optical engineering expertise for emerging technologies, experimental platforms, and manufacturing capabilities. Work spans feasibility studies and optical architecture through prototype integration, performance characterization, and support for manufacturing implementation.

Opportunities span early-career through senior technical levels. The scope of independent design ownership and technical leadership will reflect demonstrated capability, with experienced engineers serving as optical subject matter experts and guiding system-level technical decisions.

Key Responsibilities:

* **Optical Requirements & Architecture:** Translate functional objectives into optical requirements, system concepts, and verification approaches. Identify critical unknowns, evaluate alternative architectures, and define interfaces with mechanical, electrical, and control systems.
* **Optical Design & Modeling:** Develop and evaluate optical designs using analytical methods and appropriate simulation tools. Apply ray optics, wave optics, or coupled physical models as needed to understand propagation, coupling, imaging, interference, polarization, and other performance-driving effects.
* **Performance & Sensitivity Analysis:** Develop optical performance budgets and evaluate sensitivity to component variation, alignment, source and detector characteristics, and environmental conditions. Translate these findings into actionable requirements for component selection, mechanical design, positioning, and control.
* **Experimental System Development:** Design, assemble, align, and troubleshoot optical experiments and prototype systems. Select and integrate sources, detectors, optical components, positioning hardware, and instrumentation appropriate to the application.
* **Optical Test & Measurement:** Develop characterization methods that establish whether components and systems meet functional requirements. Define test configurations, reference measurements, calibration needs, and acceptance criteria while accounting for measurement uncertainty and potential artifacts.
* **Multidisciplinary Integration:** Collaborate with mechanical and controls engineers on mounting, stability, motion, sensing, and feedback requirements. Understand how subsystem behavior affects optical performance and help resolve integration issues without losing sight of the overall system objective.
* **Data Acquisition & Analysis:** Develop or support instrument control, automated measurements, signal processing, and data-analysis workflows. Compare experimental results with model predictions, investigate discrepancies, and refine designs or test methods accordingly.
* **Component & Vendor Evaluation:** Specify optical components and instruments, assess supplier capabilities and technical data, and support make-or-buy decisions. Work with vendors and external specialists to clarify requirements and resolve optical performance issues.
* **Manufacturing & Environmental Support:** Identify optical performance drivers that must be controlled during assembly, inspection, and operation. Work with process, opto-mechanical, and reliability engineers to translate development findings into practical manufacturing tests and evaluate performance under relevant environmental conditions.

* **Technical Documentation & Leadership:** Prepare optical specifications, design analyses, test procedures, and technical reports. Communicate assumptions, limitations, and recommendations clearly. More experienced engineers may establish optical development strategies, lead technical reviews, mentor others, and identify when additional specialist expertise is needed.

Qualifications:

Education & Experience:

* B.S. in Optical Engineering, Photonics, Physics, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related discipline, with substantial optics-related education or demonstrated practical experience. An advanced degree with relevant experimental or design work is valued but not required.
* Relevant experience may come from optical product development, instrumentation, research, manufacturing technology development, or comparable hands-on engineering work. Position level will reflect demonstrated technical depth, independence, and scope of responsibility rather than a fixed number of years.
* Strong understanding of optical fundamentals and the ability to apply them to practical design and measurement problems.
* Hands-on experience building, aligning, testing, or troubleshooting optical systems, supported by an understanding of the physical principles governing their operation.
* Experience using analytical methods, optical simulation, scientific programming, or experimental data analysis to inform engineering decisions.
* Working understanding of mechanical positioning and stability, sensors and actuators, data acquisition, and feedback concepts s

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Operations is at the heart of Amazon’s business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. The Reliability & Maintenance Engineering (RME) team are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it happen. We drive continuous improvement, and maintain all of the robotics and material handling equipment (MHE) to ensure our customers are met with the Amazon smile. Come join us on our journey!  
  
About the Role:  
As an Automation Engineer, you will play a crucial role in maximizing equipment reliability and operational performance in our fulfillment centers by providing proactive controls automation and technical support. Your expertise will be essential in troubleshooting complex control systems, analyzing performance metrics, and driving continuous improvement initiatives. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams to optimize material handling equipment (MHE) systems and implement innovative projects. You'll work with state-of-the-art technology, including conveyors, sortation systems, scanners, cameras, print and apply systems, and SCADA devices and programs. Through your efforts, you'll directly contribute to ensuring our customers receive their orders with Amazon's signature speed and accuracy.

But wait, there’s more: We provide lightweight fire-resistant daily wear and composite toe safety shoes for your safety!

* You will serve as the site expert for maintaining the automation systems that are critical for operations
* You will understand, maintain and troubleshoot material handling control systems, including PLC/PC controllers and industrial networks such as Ethernet, ControlNet, DeviceNet, Profibus, motor control systems, servo drives, frequency drives, and electrical distribution systems

**Job Summary**  
The DevOps & Systems Engineer is responsible for the reliability, security, automation, deployment, monitoring, and ongoing administration of the company's cloud and internal technology infrastructure.  
This position serves as the primary technical resource for **Microsoft Azure infrastructure and DevOps operations**, while also supporting internal servers, networking, hardware, identity, backups, and other systems-engineering responsibilities.  
The role works closely with software development, data engineering, security, and business technology teams to ensure applications and infrastructure are deployed consistently, monitored effectively, secured appropriately, and designed for scalability and high availability.  
The position should emphasize automation and repeatability rather than manual administration. SafePoint's existing technical direction already incorporates Azure PaaS services, PowerShell automation, Infrastructure as Code, Azure DevOps/Git-based CI/CD, Azure Monitor, and Application Insights.  
  
**Duties and responsibilities**

* **Azure Cloud Administration:** Manage and support Azure subscriptions, resource groups, App Services, Azure Functions, Storage Accounts, Azure SQL resources, Service Bus, networking, Key Vault, monitoring, backups, and related services. Maintain appropriate development, UAT, and production environments and ensure resources are configured according to company standards.
* **DevOps & CI/CD:** Build, maintain, and improve Azure DevOps pipelines for build, testing, deployment, and release management. Administer repositories, branching strategies, service connections, deployment approvals, environment variables, secrets, and release processes. Promote repeatable deployments and minimize manual production changes. SafePoint's cloud architecture already identifies Azure DevOps, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, release management, automated testing, and quality gates as core platform capabilities.
* **Infrastructure as Code & Automation:** Develop and maintain Bicep, ARM, Terraform, PowerShell, or similar automation for infrastructure provisioning and configuration. Automate repetitive administrative, deployment, monitoring, and maintenance tasks. Existing SafePoint role requirements similarly call for Bicep/ARM/Terraform and PowerShell-based cloud automation.
* **Monitoring & Production Support:** Configure Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics, alerts, dashboards, availability monitoring, and performance metrics. Investigate outages, performance degradation, failed deployments, service interruptions, and infrastructure-related application issues. Participate in root-cause analysis and document remediation actions.
* **Systems Engineering:** Administer and troubleshoot Windows servers, operating systems, DNS, DHCP, certificates, file services, authentication, scheduled services, service accounts, and other corporate infrastructure. Perform system upgrades, patching, configuration management, capacity planning, and lifecycle management.
* **Identity & Access Management:** Support Microsoft Entra ID, application registrations, managed identities, service principals, role-based access control, MFA, SSO, privileged access, and least-privilege security practices.
* **Networking:** Support Azure and internal networking, including VNets, subnets, NSGs, private endpoints, VPN connectivity, DNS, routing, firewall rules, IP restrictions, and connectivity troubleshooting between cloud, internal, and third-party systems.
* **Internal Hardware & Infrastructure:** Support internal servers, network equipment, switches, firewalls, wireless infrastructure, storage devices, conference-room or shared IT equipment, and other business-critical hardware. Coordinate hardware replacements, upgrades, warranties, and lifecycle planning.
* **Backup, Disaster Recovery & Business Continuity:** Maintain backup and recovery processes for cloud and internal systems. Periodically validate restoration procedures, point-in-time recovery, redundancy, failover, and disaster-recovery capabilities. SafePoint's current cloud architecture calls out Azure Backup, point-in-time recovery, geo-redundancy, high availability, and failover as platform requirements.
* **Security & Compliance:** Apply system hardening, patching, vulnerability remediation, encryption, secret management, logging, access controls, and security best practices. Work with security resources to address findings and maintain systems appropriate for a regulated insurance environment.
* **Cost & Capacity Management:** Monitor Azure resource utilization and cloud spending. Identify oversized, unused, or inefficient resources and recommend changes that improve performance or reduce cost. Maintain budgets and alerts where appropriate.
* **Technical Documentation:** Maintain infrastructure diagrams, inventories, configuration standards, deployment procedures, recovery procedures, support runbooks, architecture documentation, and troubleshooting guides. Documentation is also an established requirement in SafePoint's existing Azure technical roles.
* **Vendor & Third-Party Integration Support:** Assist with connectivity, certificates, SFTP, APIs, IP allowlists, VPNs, DNS, and other infrastructure requirements for third-party systems.
* **Operational Support:** Participate in scheduled maintenance and, when necessary, after-hours support for production deployments, outages, infrastructure failures, or critical business systems.

* Ability to clearly communicate verbally and in writing

* Ability to understand and document technical ideas and convey them to a non-technical audience

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

This role is part of the Lunar Permanence business unit, which develops Blue Origin’s Blue Moon landers and related products. To further Blue Origin's mission of millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth, we are building sustainable infrastructure for our transport of crew and cargo from Earth to the lunar surface.

This role is part of the Lunar Permanence business unit, which develops Blue Origin’s Blue Moon landers and related products. To further Blue Origin's mission of enabling millions of people to live and work in space for the benefit of Earth, we are building sustainable infrastructure to transport crew and cargo from Earth to the lunar surface.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our diverse team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

We are a diverse team of collaborators, doers, and problem-solvers who are relentlessly committed to a culture of safety. This position will directly impact the history of space exploration and require your commitment and detailed attention to safe, repeatable spaceflight. Join us in lowering the cost of access to space and enabling Blue Origin’s vision of millions of people living and working in space to benefit Earth.

We are looking for someone to apply their technical expertise, leadership skills, and commitment to quality to make a positive impact on safe human spaceflight. Passion for our mission and vision is required!

This role is part of the Lunar MK2 Avionics team focusing on design and development of the Crewed Landers avionics product line. We are building sustainable infrastructure for transporting crew and cargo from Earth to the lunar surface to advance our mission.

Reporting to the director of avionics, you will work within a large team responsible for the development of the avionics for the MK2 lander, including command and control, communications, power systems, as well as the integration and testing of the systems. You will share in the team’s impact on all aspects of spacecraft integration by collaborating with cross-disciplinary engineers, technicians, customers, Blue Origin teammates, partners, and facility operators across the USA. You will support overall subsystem execution as the team moves into design release, starts build, and delivers finished spacecraft to launch. This individual will be required to support design release planning and organization, supply chain integration, and collaboration across all subsystems to inform design trades and support overall timely build and program execution.

Responsibilities:

* Support design release planning, organization, and execution, including technical design team tasking, supply chain integration, and collaboration across other vehicle subsystems to develop and deliver avionics subsystems
* Manage key program metrics (and associated reporting tools) in areas such as: Budget, engineering schedules, equipment schedules, procurement schedules, production schedules, program management status reports, and resource plans
* Act as a focal point for the avionics director to interface with subsystem teams in the development and execution of our avionics development plan.
* Leverage your ability to influence working between the avionics teams, other subsystems, and the overall program team by coordinating the dependencies between teams to mature design, release drawings, and proucure/build avionics hardware for testing, certification, and flight.
* Track and manage engineering products to support production readiness and reduce execution risk
* Develop engineering-driven procurement packages, provide technical guidance for vendor/supplier selection, and maintain insight for key suppliers and critical hardware
* Write technical proposals, statements of work, and key decision tickets as needed to support program execution
* Interface with our NASA customer and other teams to provide schedule, insight, and customer deliverables.
Identify, manage, address, and close key risks and opportunities  

Min Qualifications:

* B.S. degree or equivalent experience in Engineering, Aerospace Sciences, Business, Operations Management, Mathematics, or related disciplines
* 2+ years of experience planning and managing projects/programs, including managing priorities, scope, schedule, integration, and cost.
* Experience with critical path scheduling, IMP/IMS, risk management, requirements management, and Cost Account Management

Are you ready to embark on an exciting career with a leading turbomachinery and jet engine aerospace engineering company? jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer
jobs.description:
The Lead Software Engineer applies advanced knowledge of software engineering principles, modern architectural patterns, and emerging delivery methodologies to drive the technical direction of complex, distributed software platforms at the Release Train level. Serving as an influential participant in solution discovery and architectural decision-making, this role leads milestone and epic-level technical solutioning across the value stream's product portfolio; defines reference implementations and engineering standards for the teams it supports; and partners across release trains to ensure architectural coherence as the platform evolves. This role applies effective influence and collaboration-without formal management authority-across Engineering, Product, Architecture, and SRE to drive decisions and unblock delivery throughout the software development lifecycle.  
  
The Lead Software Engineer takes the lead on difficult technical problem-solving and cross-team coordination, predicts and documents potential architectural risks and constraints, and leverages AI-assisted engineering tooling to compound their own and the broader engineering organization's productivity. As engineering teams increasingly rely on AI-generated code, the Lead Software Engineer serves as a thought leader in evolving solution discovery practices to meet this shift - defining how architectural intent, integration contracts, and implementation patterns are embedded into spec-driven development workflows and AI coding agent configurations, ensuring technical direction is established at the point of generation rather than discovered through downstream rework.  
  
**What You'll Do**  

* Owns milestone and epic-level solution discovery for the assigned value stream portfolio, producing implementation-ready technical specifications that AI Transformed and AI Enabled delivery teams can execute while reducing the need for iterative clarification.
* Defines technical standards and reference implementations for the value stream's product architectures, ensuring consistency across the portfolio and clear patterns for delivery teams to follow.
* Partners with Value Stream Architects, peer Release Train level engineers, and adjacent release trains to align technical direction, surface architectural risks, and drive cross-train decisions before they become delivery blockers.
* Identifies teams with architectural drift, technical debt, or capability gaps and embeds to lead remediation - coaching on patterns, driving solution design, and verifying technical readiness before delivery commitments are made.
* Drives adoption of spec-driven development across the value stream's delivery teams, embedding architectural intent and integration contracts into the artifacts AI coding agents and engineers consume - rather than relying on post-implementation correction.
* Serves as the right hand to the incident commander during production incidents, providing technical depth across the value stream's product surface, accelerating diagnosis, and driving decisive remediation.
* Remains the tip of the spear on emerging engineering technologies - including AI-assisted development, spec-driven workflows, and modern integration patterns - through hands-on adoption, then transfers that capability to delivery teams through structured mentorship and reference work.
* Identifies architectural risks within the value stream's technology footprint, defines mitigation strategies, and drives them to documented decisions that set forward-looking technical direction.

  
**Who You Are**  

* Bachelor's degree (list any requirements of discipline here) and 6 years' experience in a related field. The right candidate could also have a different combination, such as a master's degree and 4 years' experience; a Ph.D. and 1 year of experience; or 18 years' experience in a related field.
* Hands-on experience with full-stack development, including technologies such as StencilJS and C#, in addition to designing and delivering distributed software systems, including API design, integration patterns, and cloud-native architectures (AWS or equivalent).
* Hands-on experience leading technical solution discovery for complex initiatives, producing specifications and architectural artifacts that other engineers execute against.
* Experience with modern delivery methodologies including spec-driven development, Agile practices at scale, and AI-assisted engineering workflows.
* Reviews product requirements and system designs with an architectural lens, contributing technical direction during discovery and driving implementation patterns that support maintainability, scalability, and resilience.
* Skilled at building partnerships with Product, Architecture, and Engineering teams both inside and outside of the organization, and at driving decisions across organizational boundaries without formal authority.

We are proud to employ a team of dedicated professionals with expertise in electrical construction, mechanical fabrication and installation, engineering, and controls and automation fields who are leaders in their disciplines. We strive to be an excellent strategic partner for clients, providing solutions and adding value to their businesses.

**POSITION OVERVIEW**

The Controls Engineer IV must be able to use theoretical and practical knowledge of electrical engineering to design and implement electrical control systems for machines and industrial processes, utilizing knowledge of electricity, industrial hardware, and industrial software. They will confer with their supervisor and engineering department to develop and review functional requirements of machines and processes in order to specify, design, program, commission, and provide support on automation projects.

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Specify, design, configure, commission, and support new and existing control systems.
* Collaborate with senior and junior engineers in programming PLCs, HMIs, SCADA systems and related project tasks.
* Oversee the integration of complex controls systems and ensure adherence to industry standards.
* Troubleshoot and resolve control system issues for new and existing customers.

* Development and test software applications and interfaces, as necessary.
* Develop and meet project budgets and goals, according to project specifications.
* Conduct job walks, and meet with new and existing customers to generate projects.
* Develop project scope of work, proposal estimates, budgets and change orders.

* Adhere to industry standards and safety regulations.

* Interface with customers to determine their needs and keep them informed as projects progress.
* Manage control system projects from start to finish.

* Be able to work extra hours, including some weekends, according to project needs.

* Provide hands-on guidance and mentorship to team members.
* Monitor individual and team performance, offering constructive feedback. Ensure feedback is being shared with management
* Ensure adherence to quality standards and project timelines.
* Foster a collaborative and positive team environment.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for team-related issues.
* Communicate essential information to employees and management
* Review and approve time daily and timecards weekly or by deadlines for accuracy

* BS degree in Electrical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or Industrial Engineering.
* 5-10 Years of Controls Engineering experience.
* Good communication skills, which includes verbal skills, interpersonal skills, and technical writing.
* Effective communication and teamwork abilities.
* Customer care oriented.
* Demonstrated ability to guide technical discussions with customers and junior staff.
* Excellent computer skills and easily able to learn new technologies.
* Well organized, and able to manage time wisely.
* Ability to create, modify and improve PLC and HMI programs.

**AI Security Software Engineer**

The **AI Security Software Engineer** designs, develops, and implements AI-driven security solutions to assess enterprise applications, analyze source code, and identify vulnerabilities. This role combines software engineering, application security, DevSecOps, and large language model (LLM) technologies to strengthen security capabilities, automate assessments, and reduce enterprise risk.

**How You Will Make an Impact**
-------------------------------

* Design, develop, test, and maintain AI-enabled application security solutions and automated vulnerability assessment capabilities.
* Build and integrate security assessment pipelines that combine traditional security scanning tools with AI-assisted source code analysis and vulnerability identification.
* Develop integrations with source code repositories, security tools, vulnerability management platforms, enterprise workflows, and AI/LLM platforms.
* Lead the design and implementation of DevSecOps solutions, embedding security controls, automated testing, and secure coding practices into CI/CD pipelines.
* Define technical requirements, system architecture, and reusable integration frameworks supporting AI models, security tools, and assessment engines.
* Establish security guardrails for AI-generated code and AI-enabled applications, addressing risks such as prompt injection, insecure code, sensitive data exposure, and model misuse.
* Lead security risk assessments, vulnerability prioritization, and remediation strategies aligned with business, regulatory, and technical requirements.
* Develop security metrics and reporting to measure security posture, assessment coverage, and risk reduction.
* Collaborate with application security, penetration testing, software engineering, AI engineering, and platform teams to deliver scalable security solutions.
* Serve as a technical subject matter expert, providing guidance, troubleshooting complex issues, and supporting security incident response strategies.

**Minimum Requirements**
------------------------

Requires BS/BA in information Technology or related field of study and a minimum of 8 years experience in systems administration and security aspects of information systems, access management and network security technologies, network communications, computer networking, telecommunications, systems development and management, hardware, software, data, and people; experience with multiple technical and business disciplines required; or any combination of education and experience, which would provide an equivalent background.

**Preferred Skills, Experience, and Competencies**
--------------------------------------------------

* **Software Engineering:** Strong Python development skills, including experience building REST APIs using FastAPI, Flask, Django, or similar frameworks. Familiarity with asynchronous processing, concurrency, automated testing (pytest), and SQL databases.
* **AI/LLM Integration:** Experience developing AI-enabled or agent-based systems using commercial or open-source LLMs, prompt engineering, tool calling, structured outputs, context management, and enterprise AI platforms.
* **Application Security:** Strong knowledge of OWASP Top 10, CWE, SAST, DAST, SCA, API security, secrets detection, software supply chain security, and vulnerability assessment.
* **AI Security:** Experience securing AI/LLM applications and AI-assisted development workflows, including mitigating prompt injection, data leakage, insecure tool use, excessive agency, and untrusted code execution.
* **DevSecOps & CI/CD:** Hands-on experience integrating security into CI/CD pipelines using GitHub, GitLab, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, Bitbucket, or similar platforms.
* **Cloud & Container Security:** Knowledge of AWS, Azure, or GCP, container security, Kubernetes, and modern cloud deployment practices.
* **Security Tool Integration:** Experience integrating application security and vulnerability management platforms, including vulnerability correlation, deduplication, prioritization, risk scoring, and standardized formats such as SARIF.
* **AI Evaluation & Testing:** Familiarity with model evaluation techniques, including labeled datasets, precision/recall metrics, regression testing, and comparative model analysis.

**Infrastructure Solutions Group (ISG)**

ISG builds the products that power infrastructure, solutions, and data management our customers need most. Our teams design and develop the hardware and software that connect infrastructure, accelerate computational workloads, integrate across the stack, protect data continuity, and deliver the platforms, applications, and diagnostics our customers rely on every day at enterprise scale.

**Some product builders follow the rules. Ours rewrite them.**

Within ISG, innovation isn't just about creating new technology — it's about challenging assumptions and reimagining how work gets done. Engineers define intent, author precise specifications, and orchestrate AI agents that execute at speed and scale. AI is embedded throughout our development process, helping us move faster, learn quicker, and deliver greater impact. Yet the most important contribution remains uniquely human: deciding what to build, designing how it should work, and applying the judgment needed to earn our customers' trust. We move quickly toward the work that matters most. We reward experimentation, encourage bold thinking, and remove unnecessary barriers so great ideas can become reality faster. Our teams embrace a customer-first, first-to-market mindset, transforming rapid feedback into better products and better outcomes. We aren't looking for people who are content with the status quo — we look for builders who question it, improve it, and occasionally rewrite it.

If you're energized by solving complex systems challenges, excited to work alongside AI to amplify your impact, and motivated by the opportunity to shape what's next instead of simply maintaining what's been done before, you'll find your place here.

Role Summary

Specter Aerospace is seeking an Embedded Software Engineer III to develop and implement flight software for custom vehicle avionics and ground support systems. This position will provide technical ownership across the embedded software lifecycle, including architecture, requirements development, driver implementation, flight algorithm integration, testing, and vehicle integration.

A successful candidate will work closely with electrical, GNC, mechanical, and test engineers to deliver reliable embedded systems for Specter’s experimental and flight vehicle programs.

About Specter Aerospace

Specter Aerospace is building the next generation of hypersonic vehicles for U.S. Forces and Allies. With offices in Boston and Peabody, MA, Specter leverages its advanced propulsion technologies, manufacturing, and testing capabilities to rapidly develop supersonic and hypersonic systems. Our Embedded Software Engineer III will be based in our Boston (Seaport) office. Funded by a mix of government R&D organizations and private funding, Specter is expanding its team in preparation for flight testing and full-scale production.

Role Responsibilities

* Develop and maintain embedded software for custom flight avionics and ground support systems.
* Define software architecture, interfaces, and implementation approaches for assigned systems.
* Develop hardware drivers and communication interfaces for custom sensing and control hardware.
* Collaborate with GNC engineers to implement and validate flight control and navigation algorithms.
* Develop microcontroller software on bare metal and real-time operating systems such as QNX, VxWorks, or FreeRTOS.
* Integrate new sensors, actuators, communications interfaces, and flight capabilities into vehicle software.
* Develop hardware in the loop and software in the loop test systems.
* Lead assigned software through requirements, implementation, integration, testing, and documentation.
* Support vehicle integration, ground testing, flight testing, and post-test analysis.
* Mentor less experienced engineers and contribute to code reviews, technical meetings, and design discussions.

Required Qualifications

* Strong embedded C and C++ (C++17 and newer) skills
* Firm understanding of embedded debugging methodologies (e.g. in-circuit debugging, digital logic analyzer, oscilloscopes, etc.)
* Extensive experience with embedded Linux and RT-PREEMPT
* Understanding of common communication protocols (CAN, SPI, I2C, UART, layer-2 Ethernet)
* Extensive experience with real-time operating systems (e.g. FreeRTOS, QNX, VxWorks) and bare-metal development
* Ability to review circuit board schematics to inform firmware and driver development
* Experience writing test tooling/scripting to optimize test data analysis and build relevant workflows
* Available for up to 10% travel for off-site ground & flight test activities
* Ability to obtain a DoD security clearance (U.S. Citizenship required)

Preferred Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, or another related field
* 5+ years of experience in embedded/software engineering or 3+ years with further relevant degrees
* Understanding of containerization (e.g. Docker/Podman)
* Experience establishing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for embedded projects
* Experience with Yocto
* Familiarity with industry standards such as MIL-1553 or DO-178C
* Familiarity with flight software development, specifically using WOSA
* Experience developing/implementing motor control algorithms on microcontrollers

EEO Statement

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

Pay: $130,000.00 - $162,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

As the NWS Lead Software Engineer for General Dynamics Mission Systems, you will provide technical leadership for a frontend or backend software team supporting a complex, distributed tactical system. This role requires an engineer who can lead technical execution while remaining hands-on with architecture, implementation, reviews, planning, and mentoring. The selected candidate will help guide the team’s transition toward memory-safe and type-safe technologies, including **Go** for new development and **JavaScript** for existing applications.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as the technical lead for a software team, providing technical direction, mentoring, code reviews, and implementation support.
* Break down features into well-defined, testable tasks aligned with product and subsystem design boundaries.
* Partner with the Product Owner, Scrum Master, program leadership, systems engineering, and SC&I to plan work, manage priorities, and align with coding and development standards.
* Support Agile execution, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, technical estimation, retrospectives, and delivery tracking.
* Develop, review, and maintain technical artifacts, including test plans, user manuals, administrator manuals, design documentation, and software-development documentation.
* Support financial and program-planning activities, including COCOMO estimates, Basis of Estimate (BOE) inputs, and Software Bill of Materials (SW BOM) development.
* Conduct and oversee code reviews, ensuring changes meet quality, security, maintainability, testability, and Definition-of-Done expectations.
* Assess and improve team maturity, code maturity, codebase size and stabilization trends, development efficiency, and scalability across a distributed environment supporting 3,000+ endpoints.
* Help mature CI/CD and DevSecOps capabilities, including automated unit testing, code-quality analysis, configuration management, and repeatable production builds.
* Establish, maintain, or support test beds on SWFPAC.
* Identify technical risks, dependencies, and architectural concerns early; communicate options, tradeoffs, and recommendations to leadership.
* Mentor existing technical leadership and individual contributors, helping build sustainable team capability and knowledge transfer.

**Backend Lead Focus Areas**

The Backend Lead will additionally support:

* Backend architecture, database design, and data-model development.
* Middleware and Data Distribution Service (DDS) integration, including evaluation of Rust compatibility with RTI DDS.
* Embedded software and firmware-adjacent development, including FreeRTOS and TCP/IP interfaces, as applicable.
* Containerization, virtualization, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment architecture.
* Migration and adoption of memory-safe/type-safe technologies, particularly Go and Rust where appropriate.
* Build and release management, including Git-based merge, build, and configuration-management workflows.

**Frontend Lead Focus Areas**

The Frontend Lead will additionally support:

* Frontend architecture, legacy application knowledge, software licensing awareness, and full-system/subsystem interface understanding.
* Feature decomposition and planning based on encapsulation of product functions and subsystem design.
* Frontend development standards, component design, usability considerations, and integration with backend services.
* Product Owner responsibilities for an Agile team, including backlog prioritization, acceptance criteria, stakeholder coordination, and workforce oversight.
* Knowledge-management and training plans to help engineers develop lead-level capability and confirm understanding of assigned work.

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

We encourage you to apply if you have experience with:

* Leading, or serving as the deputy/backup lead for, delivery of a mature tactical, mission, or strategic software system.
* Software architecture, technical planning, feature decomposition, and system-level design.
* Frontend and/or backend development in distributed, multi-component systems.
* Go, Rust, JavaScript/TypeScript, C#, Java, C/C++, or other memory-safe/type-safe programming languages.

* Object-oriented software design and modern software-design principles.
* Data Distribution Service (DDS), middleware integration, and RTI DDS.
* Embedded software development, FreeRTOS, TCP/IP, and firmware-adjacent interfaces.
* Linux development or administration.
* Docker, Kubernetes, containerization, virtualization, and deployment automation.
* CI/CD, DevSecOps, automated testing, static analysis, production builds, and configuration management.
* Git, GitLab, source-control workflows, and merge/review practices.

* Factory, hardware, or integration-test environments.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
**The Role**
============

We’re looking for a Systems Engineer who lives where the subsystems meet. If you get excited about taking mechanical, electrical, and software pieces from different benches and making them work as one system, leading the bring-up campaigns that get it wet, and chasing down the cross-domain challenges that only show up at integration, this is your role.

**What You’ll Do**
==================

* Integrate maritime vehicles end-to-end: stand up new subsystems on the bench, wire them into the platform, and bring the full platform online
* Build and run hardware-in-the-loop rigs, test fixtures, and bench setups that let us shake out interfaces before we hit the water
* Lead test campaigns from bench to tank to sea trials: write the procedures, run the runs, capture the data, and close the loop with the team
* Debug across the stack; power, comms, sensors, mechanical, firmware, autonomy
* Work shoulder-to-shoulder with mechanical, electrical, and software engineers
* Own integration risk and readiness: know what’s tested and what we need to prove before each event
* Push the limits of what’s possible in subsea autonomy and robotics by getting things working, reliably in the real world

**What You Bring**
==================

* Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Aerospace, Robotics, Systems Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience
* 5+ years integrating real-world robotic, vehicle, or complex hardware/software systems
* Hands-on experience standing up subsystems on the bench: harnessing, power up, comms bring-up, sensor checkout
* Strong test instincts: you know how to design a test that and how to instrument it, so the data is useful
* Comfort moving across domains, reading a schematic, scoping a signal, sniffing a CAN/Ethernet bus, and reading enough firmware or autonomy code to find a bug
* Comfort working with a small team and wearing many hats
* U.S. citizen; eligible for DoD security clearance

**Nice To Haves**
=================

* Experience integrating and testing maritime systems other unmanned platforms
* Hands-on with lab and test gear: oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, bus sniffers, DAQs, environmental and pressure test setups
* Working knowledge of Python (or similar) for test automation, data capture, and log analysis
* Active DoD Secret clearance

**Who You Are**
===============

* You like to get your hands dirty, tracing a harness, scoping a signal, debugging on a boat, and you’d rather be in the lab than in a document
* Collaborative, but independent, driving your own workload but knowing when to pull the team together
* Passionate about robotics, autonomy, and building tech that matters

* Strong ability to work independently, communicate technical issues clearly, and influence cross-functional teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Experience in semiconductor inspection, metrology, lithography, process control, advanced packaging, optics, imaging, motion control, robotics, automation, and system-level calibration.
* Familiarity with formal requirements tools, ECO processes, issue tracking, reliability practices, customer acceptance procedures, and cleanroom environments is preferred.
* INCOSE, Six Sigma, PMP, or equivalent technical certifications are beneficial.

**Education Requirements**

  

* Minimum education: bachelor’s degree in systems engineering, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, physics, optics, computer engineering, robotics, or a related technical discipline.
* Preferred education: master’s degree in engineering or applied science.
* Equivalent experience may substitute for formal education when supported by demonstrated systems engineering capability.

**Success Characteristics**

  

* Successful candidates demonstrate strong communication, analytical problem solving, independent thinking, ownership, accountability, execution discipline, and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced customer-focused environment.
* First-year success includes improving requirements quality, supporting successful integrations, reducing open systems issues, accelerating customer technical responses, and strengthening cross-functional engineering alignment.

**Working Conditions and Travel**  
This role is primarily on-site in Wilmington, Massachusetts, with domestic and international travel up to 40%. Must be able to occasionally lift up to 25 pounds and work safely in laboratory, manufacturing, cleanroom, customer-site, and office environments. Must comply with company safety standards and customer-site requirements.

At Onto Innovation, we believe your work should matter—and so should your well-being. That’s why we offer competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package designed to support you and your family. From health, dental, and vision coverage to life and disability insurance, PTO, and a 401(k) with employer match, we’ve got you covered. You’ll also enjoy access to our Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP), wellness initiatives, and cutting-edge tools—all within a collaborative, inclusive culture where your contributions are valued and recognized.

**Compensation & Growth**

* Base Salary Range:

$115,200.00 - $172,800.00, offered in good faith and based on experience, location, and qualifications.

* Additional Rewards: Annual bonus opportunities and potential long-term incentives tied to both company and individual success.

Empowering Every Voice to Shape the Future:

Onto Innovation is committed to creating a workplace where every qualified candidate has an equal opportunity to succeed. We evaluate applicants based on skills, experience, and potential - without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We believe diversity of thought and background drives innovation and strengthens our team.

Important Note on Export Compliance

For certain positions requiring access to technical data, U.S. export licensing review may be necessary for applicants who are not U.S. Citizens, Permanent Residents, or other protected persons under 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3).

jobs.title: Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Paperless Parts is the SaaS-based intelligence layer for modern manufacturing, enabling our customers to innovate faster in the physical world. From rockets to medical devices, we power the parts that move the world forward.

### **About the Role**

Paperless Parts is looking for a motivated and curious Platform Engineer I to join our growing team. You'll be an active member of the team taking our SaaS platform to manufacturing shops. As a Platform Engineer I, you will help build and maintain a platform that is scalable, secure, and resilient. From day one, you'll contribute directly to our platform by taking ownership of well-defined tasks and projects, working alongside senior engineers who will review your work and guide your growth. You will play a crucial part in supporting the automation and tooling that makes our entire engineering team more efficient.

This is an entry-level position on our engineering career pathway. You'll participate fully in the life of the team — joining sprint ceremonies, completing assigned sprint work, and growing into the on-call rotation — while building the foundation to advance toward Platform Engineer II and beyond. This role is perfect for early-career engineers who are passionate about cloud technologies and eager to develop their skills in a collaborative environment.

### **Why You'll Love Working Here**

* **Customer-Centric Focus:** We put our customers at the center of everything we do. Your work will directly contribute to their success.
* **Meaningful Challenges:** We enable critical industries like medical devices, aerospace, and defense, which require robust, secure, and scalable solutions.
* **Collaborative and Inclusive Culture:** Our culture emphasizes collaboration, continuous learning, and mutual respect. We believe that diverse teams build better products.
* **Learning Opportunities:** You'll grow your skills through close mentorship from senior engineers and a clearly defined engineering career pathway.
* **Modern Technology:** Gain hands-on experience with modern web application stacks, cloud technologies like AWS, and observability and CI/CD tools.

### **What You'll Work On**

* Develop and maintain infrastructure as code, including writing, testing, and deploying new Terraform modules to manage production cloud resources on AWS, including EC2, S3, IAM, and VPC
* Enhance our CI/CD pipelines using industry-standard tools like Jenkins
* Build new dashboards and set up monitoring with Datadog to ensure the health and performance of key applications.
* Write and maintain automation scripts in Python or Bash to streamline routine operational tasks.
* Work with containerization technologies and concepts using Docker
* Use AI-assisted coding tools as part of your everyday workflow to write, test, and review code more effectively
* Participate in sprint ceremonies and deliver assigned sprint work, with code reviewed and supported by senior engineers
* Join the team's on-call rotation and learn to respond to alerts as you grow into the role

### **What You'll Bring**

* A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 0-1 years of professional experience in software, platform, or DevOps engineering; internship or co-op experience counts.
* Working knowledge of a programming or scripting language, with Python as a plus.
* Basic understanding of and comfort with Linux/Unix command-line tools.
* Familiarity with modern infrastructure tools, including cloud providers (e.g., AWS, Azure, or GCP), containerization (e.g., Docker), infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform), and CI/CD (e.g., Jenkins).
* A demonstrated, passionate desire to learn about cloud computing, DevOps principles, and infrastructure automation.
* Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, and a collaborative mindset — you ask clarifying questions and contribute to team discussions.
* A strong sense of reliability and ownership of your assigned work, with enthusiasm for learning and applying new technologies.

### **Why Join Us?**

* **Real-World Impact:** You will contribute to solutions that empower critical industries and drive innovation.
* **Learning and Development:** You will work with experienced professionals who will support your growth along a defined engineering career pathway.
* **Supportive Culture:** You will join a team that values your contributions and invests in your success.

If you're an ambitious early-career engineer eager to apply your knowledge of cloud infrastructure, gain hands-on experience, and build your career in platform engineering, we'd love to hear from you!

We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. jobs.title: Automation Engineer

In this role, you won’t just maintain systems—you’ll continuously improve them. You’ll apply your controls and automation knowledge to optimize preventive maintenance strategies, diagnose sophisticated issues, and enhance the performance of industry leading technologies such as conveyors, sortation systems, PLCs, scanners, vision systems, print-and‑apply equipment, and SCADA platforms. Your work will directly influence uptime, safety, and operational excellence across mission critical facilities.

* Promote a safe working environment by complying with all applicable codes, regulations, governmental agencies, and company directives related to system operations and work safety.
* Troubleshoot and modify software programs for material handling control systems, including PLC/PC controllers, Allen Bradley Controllogix/Compactlogix PLC platform and RSLogix 5000 software package.

* Engineer process solutions and reliability improvement from concept to network implementation.
* Monitor Industrial networks such as Ethernet, ControlNet, DeviceNet, Profibus, AS-I, motor control systems, servo drives, frequency drives, and electrical distribution systems.
* Monitor material handling equipment metrics and partner with site team to resolve equipment electrical problems that create performance deficiencies.
* Proactively and effectively communicate with multiple stakeholders including, but not limited to, leadership, operations and the maintenance team on technical issues and project timelines and production impacts.
* Facilitate analysis and reviews of failures and processes to provide recommendations to implement improvements or retraining to avoid future incidents.

* Cultivate positive working relationships with our Client and the Operations Maintenance team members.

* Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.
* Bachelor's Degree preferred with 2-5 years of relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, a combination of experience and education may be considered.
* Experience in at least two engineering design cycles including specification, component selection and programming.
* 2+ years of experience working with PLC programming, robotics system components and controls, and SCADA-based monitoring and control systems.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience supporting a range of different conveyors and sortation systems.
* Experience with robotic maintenance.
* In-depth knowledge of Microsoft Office products. Examples include Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.
* Extensive organizational skills with a strong inquisitive mindset.

You should be proficient in:

* PLC Programming Experience
* SCADA Experience

jobs.description:
At Emerson, we help the world run safer and smarter. As a global leader in automation, our Analytical Instruments organization develops advanced technologies and solutions that safeguard industries and keep critical systems running.

Join our Liquid Analysis team in Shakopee, MN, as a Senior Embedded Software Engineer — where you'll work on both new product development and sustaining engineering for process analytical equipment that protects water quality, supports life sciences, strengthens industrial safety, and serves industries worldwide.

If solving complex engineering problems with software excites you, this is an opportunity to build real embedded products, work closely with software, hardware, systems, and test engineers, and see your work come together in the complete product - become part of a team that’s growing, learning, and focused on delivering results!

**IN THIS ROLE, YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES WILL:**

* Design and develop embedded software solutions for new products and major product enhancements.
* Own significant software features and technical efforts, breaking down work and driving it through implementation, integration, and completion.
* Solve complex embedded software and hardware/software integration problems through hands-on development, debugging, and testing.
* Collaborate with global, cross-functional teams across software, test, systems, hardware, project management, and product management.
* Follow and strengthen engineering practices aligned with our SDLA and IEC 62443-4-1, including requirements, design, cybersecurity, implementation, testing, reviews, documentation, and release.
* Develop and maintain software requirements, architecture, interfaces, and traceability throughout the development lifecycle.
* Provide technical guidance and mentoring to other engineers and participate in meaningful technical and peer reviews.
Maintain and improve existing products while exploring new technologies, tools, and approaches that improve our products and engineering capabilities.  

**WHO YOU ARE** : You take on the challenge of unfamiliar tasks. You deal constructively with problems that do not have clear solutions or outcomes. You grow from hardships and negative experiences You partner with others to get work done. You admit mistakes and gain insight from experiences.

**FOR THIS ROLE, YOU WILL NEED:**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering or science from an engineering school
* 5+ years of applicable experience
* Experience developing using C/C++ for real-time, multi-threaded embedded systems and microcontroller-based products
* **Authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship now and in the future**
  + **Individuals with temporary visas such as E, F-1 (including those with OPT or CPT), H-1, H-2, L-1, B, J or TN, or who need sponsorship for work authorization now or in the future, are not eligible for hire.**

  

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS THAT SET YOU APART:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field; ABET-accredited engineering degree preferred
* Strong proficiency in C/C++, with experience in modular embedded software architecture, object-oriented design, design patterns, and UML
* Experience with embedded Ethernet and TCP/IP networking; industrial Ethernet protocols and stacks such as EtherNet/IP, Modbus TCP, and PROFINET are a plus
* Working knowledge of embedded communication interfaces and industrial protocols such as CAN, SPI, UART/SCI, I²C, HART, Modbus, and PROFIBUS
* Demonstrated ability to solve complex embedded software and system-level technical problems
* Experience with secure software development lifecycle practices; familiarity with IEC 62443-4-1 or similar product cybersecurity standards preferred
* Ability to communicate technical designs, decisions, and tradeoffs and work effectively with cross-functional teams
Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools to improve software development, testing, debugging, or engineering productivity  

  

**Our Culture & Commitment to You:**

At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where every employee is valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives because we know that great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe diverse teams, working together are key to driving growth and delivering business results.

We recognize the importance of employee wellbeing and know that to do your best you must have flexible, competitive benefits plans to meet you and your family’s physical, mental, financial, and social needs. We provide, a variety of medical insurance plans, with dental and vision coverage, Employee Assistance Program, profit sharing retirement, tuition reimbursement, employee resource groups, recognition, and much more. Our culture prioritizes work-life balance and offers flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave (maternal and paternal), vacation and holiday leave.

Our compensation philosophy is simple: we pay a competitive base salary, within the local market in which we operate, and reward performance during our annual merit review process. The salary range for this role is $110,000-$150,000 annually, commensurate with the skills, talent, capabilities, and experience each candidate brings to a role.
