jobs.description:
At U.S. Bank, we’re on a journey to do our best. Helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions and enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bank gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.

**Job Description**
-------------------

This position will be responsible for the analysis, design, testing, development and maintenance of best in class software experiences. The candidate is a self-motivated individual who can collaborate with a team and across the organization. The candidate takes responsibility of the software artifacts produced adhering to U.S. Bank standards in order to ensure minimal impact to the customer experience. The candidate will be adept with the agile software development lifecycle and DevOps principles.  
  
**Essential Responsibilities:**  

* Responsible for designing, developing, testing, operating and maintaining products
* Takes full stack ownership by consistently writing production-ready and testable code
* Consistently creates optimal design adhering to architectural best practices; considers scalability, reliability and performance of systems/contexts affected when defining technical designs
* Performs analysis on failures, propose design changes, and encourage operational improvements
* Makes sound design/coding decisions keeping customer experience in the forefront
* Takes feedback from code review and apply changes to meet standards
* Conducts code reviews to provide guidance on engineering best practices and compliance with development procedures
* Accountable for ensuring all aspects of product development follow compliance and security best practices
* Exhibits relentless focus in software reliability engineering standards embedded into development standards
* Embraces emerging technology opportunities and contributes to the best practices in support of the bank’s technology transformation
* Contributes to a culture of innovation, collaboration and continuous improvement
* Reviews tasks critically and ensures they are appropriately prioritized and sized for incremental delivery; anticipates and communicates blockers and delays before they require escalation

**Basic Qualifications**  

* Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent work experience
* Five to six years of relevant experience

  

**Required Skills**

* Strong experience with **Java 17+, Spring Boot, REST APIs, and Microservices**.
* Experience building modern applications using **React.js**.
* Hands-on expertise with **AWS**, including cloud-native application development.
* Proficiency with **Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions**, and CI/CD automation.
* Experience with **Generative AI, LLMs, Prompt Engineering, and AI application development**.
* Knowledge of **RAG, Vector Databases, Semantic Search, Embeddings, and Knowledge Retrieval**.
* Experience integrating **Azure OpenAI, OpenAI APIs, LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, and AI Agents**.
* Understanding of **AI Governance, Responsible AI, SRE, Agile, and DevOps best practices**.

**Location expectations**  
This role requires working from a U.S. Bank location three (3) or more days per week.

If there’s anything we can do to accommodate a disability during any portion of the application or hiring process, please refer to our disability accommodations for applicants.

Our approach to benefits and total rewards considers our team members’ whole selves and what may be needed to thrive in and outside work. That's why our benefits are designed to help you and your family boost your health, protect your financial security and give you peace of mind. Our benefits include the following:

* Healthcare (medical, dental, vision)
* Basic term and optional term life insurance

* Paid vacation (from two to five weeks depending on salary grade and tenure)

jobs.title: Staff Engineer, Systems Engineering
jobs.description:
**About Carrier**

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Through cutting-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure safe transport of food, lifesaving medicines and more. Since inventing modern air conditioning in 1902, we lead with purpose: enhancing the lives we live and the world we share. We continue to lead because of our world-class, inclusive workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do. For more information, visit corporate.carrier.com or follow on Carrier social media at @Carrier.

**Staff Engineer, Systems Engineering**

**About this role**

In this role, you will be developing 75F’s next-generation IoT applications for Smart Buildings. You will collaborate with an interdisciplinary team of cloud and firmware engineers to develop and improve software products deployed in commercial buildings which aim to cut down significantly on energy consumption due to HVAC infrastructure while maintaining the highest level of occupants’ comfort and productivity.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Architect, develop, and deliver high-quality software, code, and algorithms for full-stack Java and Android-based solutions, ensuring end-to-end code quality.
* Design, implement, test, and deliver new features for the Android gateway application that runs Smart Building algorithms and connects to the cloud.
* Develop and integrate embedded platform services, middleware, device interfaces, and hardware abstraction components across Android and Embedded Linux systems.
* Analyze system performance using benchmarking, profiling, and instrumentation, and implement optimizations.
* Incorporate software quality attributes into architecture, design, development, and delivery activities.
* Contribute to and review software methodologies, product designs, models, and technical documentation.
* Collaborate with developers and architects across time zones and international sites in a scaled agile environment.
* Partner with the product manager and test lead to develop user stories, refine acceptance criteria, and define test designs.
* Investigate and resolve field issues in existing products through thorough system impact analysis, diagnostics, and debugging.
* Ensure secure coding practices are followed throughout development.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or Electrical or Electronic Engineering
* 10+ years of hands-on professional experience designing and developing applications and algorithms in Java and Kotlin for Android/Linux platforms, including 5+ years of Kotlin experience.
* 10+ years of embedded software development and platform architecture experience.
* 10+ years of architecture and development experience with Embedded Linux and Android, including Android OS root/system-level development, device drivers, and Android tablet hardware integration.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in the HVAC domain and Internet of Things (IoT) applications.
* Experience with embedded platform services, middleware, device interfaces, hardware abstraction, and cross-platform libraries.
* Experience in system performance analysis, benchmarking, profiling, instrumentation, and optimization.
* Practical experience with SDLC tools such as Git and Azure DevOps.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills in a global team environment.
* Self-motivated, committed to continuous learning, and able to adapt to a fast-paced startup environment
* Experience with the Android platform, middleware, framework, native services, HAL, NDK, JNI, and AIDL; working knowledge of Android architecture layers (Linux Kernel, HAL, Runtime, Framework, Applications).
* Experience with Linux internals, including processes, threads, IPC, scheduling, memory, storage, networking, and system services.
* Experience with embedded-device observability, telemetry, health monitoring, diagnostics, logging, and remote debugging.
* Experience with embedded platform security, including secure boot, keys, certificates, signing, TPM/TEE, secure updates, and network security.
* Experience with the Android SDK, different Android versions, Android UI design principles, patterns, and best practices.
* Experience with the open-source Android ecosystem and common libraries; familiarity with RESTful APIs connecting Android applications to back-end services.
* Experience with offline storage, threading, and performance tuning.
* Experience with Java build and package management tools such as Gradle and Maven.
* Experience with testing libraries and automation frameworks such as JUnit, Espresso, and Robolectric, including hands-on application testing across multiple devices and form factors.
* Experience with continuous delivery for mobile applications, including test-driven or behavior-driven development, code reviews, static analysis, continuous integration, automation, and functional testing.

**Pay Range**

The annual salary for this position is between $96,000.00 - $192,000.00 annually. Factors which may affect pay within this range include, but are not limited to, skills, education, experience, and other unique qualifications of the successful candidate. The pay range will not be below the minimum wage applicable to the jurisdiction in which the applicant is to be employed.

**Other Compensation**

This position is entitled to short-term cash incentives, subject to plan requirements.

**Benefits**

Employees are eligible for benefits, including:

* **Health Care Benefits**: Medical, Dental, Vision; Wellness incentives
* **Retirement Benefits**
* **Time off and Leave**: Paid vacation days, up to 15 days; paid sick days, up to 5 days; paid personal leave, up to 5 days; paid holidays, up to 13 days; birth and adoption leave; parental leave; family

jobs.title: Sr Principal Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on - 7 Dec 2026  
  

Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

**A Day in the Life**
=====================

Medtronic’s Interventional Cardiac Therapies (ICT) Renal Denervation (formally CRDN) business is looking for a Lead Electrical Engineer motivated engineer to be part of a high-performing team that is revolutionizing the design and development of medical devices. In this role, you will leverage both your technical breadth and business acumen to accelerate the design and development of next generation medical devices. The work you do will impact patients globally and help support Medtronic’s mission of alleviating pain, restoring health, and extending life for millions.
  
  
At Medtronic, we bring bold ideas forward with speed and decisiveness to put patients first in everything we do. In-person exchanges are invaluable to our work. We’re working a minimum of 4 days a week onsite as part of our commitment to fostering a culture of professional growth and cross-functional collaboration as we work together to engineer the extraordinary.
  
  
This position will be based in Mounds View, MN.  

The **Senior Principal Electrical Engineer** leads the electrical engineering aspects of a new Capital equipment platform, with a primary focus on systems development, characterization, and integration testing for a next‑generation Renal Denervation RF ablation generator. This role serves within the team as the voice of electrical engineering for our new RF generator, providing deep electrical and systems engineering leadership across the full product lifecycle while driving disciplined execution, risk management, and quality compliance. The role operates with a high degree of autonomy and influence, acting as the electrical engineering lead and workstream owner, including project execution leadership and scrum facilitation, while partnering closely with systems, manufacturing, quality, and program leadership to deliver innovative, compliant medical technologies.

  

This engineering position requires strong technical and leadership skills to support the circuit card design and development of innovative, new products within the **Renal Denervation Group** . The **Senior Principal Electrical Engineer** will apply knowledge of Circuit card design, electrical engineering, and experience in working on complex multidisciplinary problems and will provide leadership of projects from early phase development to market release.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Principal Technical Leadership**

* Represents the electrical engineering team within the RF generator workstream.
* Lead end‑to‑end electrical engineering activities across concepts, architecture, circuit card design, fabrication, verification, validation, characterization, integration, and lifecycle support.
* Own the electrical systems development, integration, and electrical characterization for a next‑generation RF ablation generator.
* Ensure rigorous requirements coverage and decomposition from system and product levels to electrical hardware, including test and verification strategies.
* Partner with systems and functional architects to translate architecture, functionality, and fault‑mitigation strategies into executable electrical engineering solutions.
* Act as the primary technical spokesperson for all electrical engineering design decisions, trade studies, and technical reviews within the workstream.
* Plan and execute robust design, verification, and design characterization activities.

**Program and Workstream Leadership**

* Lead the electrical engineering workstream for major or moderately complex programs, including task planning, delegation, and technical review of work products.
* Serve as project execution lead and scrum master for electrical engineering activities.
* Develop and maintain execution plans ensuring all electrical deliverables are appropriately scoped, resourced, and scheduled.
* Manage schedules and dependencies in collaboration with R&D lead and Project Management Office partners.
* Perform day‑to‑day management of technical priorities, tradeoffs, and issue resolution within the workstream.
* Support planning for electrical engineering spend, resourcing, tools, and equipment.

**Risk, Quality, and Compliance Leadership**

* Lead and contribute to system and electrical risk management activities, including FMEAs, hazard analyses, and risk mitigation strategies.
* Serve as primary owner for identification, assessment, and communication of electrical and system‑level risks and emerging issues.
* Champion consistent application of the quality system, design controls, and best practices across electrical engineering activities.
* Ensure solutions comply with regulatory, safety, and reliability requirements for medical devices.

**Cross‑Functional Influence and Communication**

* Ensure strong cross‑functional alignment across systems, software, manufacturing, quality, and program teams.
* Translate electrical design intent and requirements to manufacturing partners to ensure producibility and design transfer readiness.
* Provide regular and ad‑hoc technical and program updates to functional and program leadership.
* Proactively communicate emerging issues, escalations, and risk status to CTM and other stakeholders.

**Technical Mentorship and Capability Building**

* Provide technical guidance, coaching, and mentorship to engineers across the organization.

jobs.description:
### **Overview**

Enterprise Mobility is a leading provider of mobility solutions, owning and operating the Enterprise Rent-A-Car, National Car Rental and Alamo Rent A Car brands through its integrated global network of independent regional subsidiaries. Enterprise Mobility and its affiliates offer extensive car rental, carsharing, truck rental, fleet management, retail car sales, as well as travel management and other transportation services, to make travel easier and more convenient for customers.

Privately held by the Taylor family of St. Louis, Enterprise Mobility together with its affiliate Enterprise Fleet Management manages a diverse fleet of 2.4 million vehicles and accounted for nearly $39 billion in revenue through a network of more than 9,500 fully-staffed neighborhood and airport rental locations in more than 90 countries and territories.

At the center of it all, our dedicated IT teams innovate, design and develop the technology that is redefining how customers rent, buy and share vehicles from our family of brands. Here, you will be part of a diverse and talented team that creates and delivers powerful technology solutions for our customers and employees across the world with the resources and support to develop in a variety of career paths.

As an Enterprise Mobility team member, we offer an excellent package with market-competitive pay, comprehensive healthcare packages, 401k matching & profit sharing, schedule flexibility, work from home opportunities, paid time off, and organizational growth potential.

This position is eligible for a hybrid work schedule, which includes the ability to work from home, while also requiring to be in person as needed at our Lakeside and/or Clayton Corporate HQ campus locations in St. Louis, Missouri.

We are committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. Candidates should expect identity verification, video interviews, technical validation of skills, and verification of employment, education, and work authorization. jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  
  
As part of the global controls team, you will work with highly motivated experts and innovators in the data center industry. You will be responsible for troubleshooting, project management, and maintaining the building management system (BMS) and electrical power monitoring system (EPMS). Using Amazon leadership principles, you will develop new processes and standards while innovating in the controls space. AWS Data centers have multiple components such as generators, uninterruptible power sources, diesel generators, electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic/static transfer switches, chillers [air-cooled and water-cooled], pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, CRAHs, air economizers, etc. All these components have local control systems that interact with each other via open and/or proprietary communications protocols. The BMS is the primary method of control of all mechanical systems within a data center. The EPMS is the primary method of monitoring all electrical systems within a data center.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Train and assist internal customers and stakeholders with the creation, design, configuration, validation, installation, commissioning and operation of BMS and EPMS systems.

• Provide technical assistance and support to operations during life cycle of the data center. • Review results and action items from the quarterly maintenances for BMS and EPMS and take actions to get them resolved.  

* Develop BMS & EPMS projects scope of work, schedule, budget, and level of efforts (LOE) to projects requested by customers and stakeholders.
* Manage scope, schedule, finance and execution of BMS and EPMS improvement projects in AWS data centers.
* Assist in procurement related activities including request for quotation/proposals, responding to request for information, review of vendors proposal and issuance of purchase orders.

• Participate in AWS global on-call schedule to provide immediate BMS and EPMS technical support to in-service data centers. • Attend project related meetings, coordinate with project leaders and regularly report status to Controls and stakeholder’s management.  

* Support Controls projects related commissioning activities in the data centers.
* Review, implement, troubleshoot and iterate on the controls sequence of operation (SOO) and provide necessary feedback to the design team.
* Develop and modify controls logic programming and graphical user interfaces.
* Manage multiple stakeholder deliverables, requirements and navigate challenging situations.
* Financially manage BMS and EPMS service contracts.
* Frequently visit (locally) assigned in-operation data centers to troubleshoot, meet customers, supervise vendor’s work to ensure compliance with the scope, design, SOO and applicable local codes.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
* Experience carrying new design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production
* Experience in MS Excel, Word, and Windows Operating Systems
* Experience with power management and power monitoring systems

* 5+ years of project management in data centers or comparable critical infrastructure experience
* Knowledge of critical data center equipment
* Knowledge of engineering documentation, electrical diagrams and standard operating procedures
* Knowledge of building codes and regulations including Life Safety, BOCA, NFPA, NEC, or OSHA
* Experience in project management in data centers or comparable critical infrastructure
* Experience in Data Center Engineering Operations, with a deep understanding of electrical and mechanical data center infrastructure
* Experience reading and interpreting construction specifications and drawings for all domains

jobs.title: Staff Embedded Firmware Engineer - Power Electronics
jobs.description:
**Job Title:****Staff Embedded Firmware Engineer - Power Electronics**
======================================================================

**Job Description**

Trystar’s team members are our most important asset. We are looking for a Staff Embedded Firmware Engineer – Power Electronics – to write, integrate, and verify the embedded real-time firmware of our power conversion products, including DC/DC converters, three-phase grid-tied inverters, and energy storage systems, from architecture through validation, certification, and production release. You will turn the control strategies that our controls engineers define and simulate into production-quality code on microcontroller- and FPGA-based control boards, and you will own the drivers, communications, memory, diagnostics, and update functions around that code. You will lead the firmware workstream of new product programs as a senior individual contributor, set the technical direction of the firmware code base, and mentor the engineers who build it with you.

**Location**

Merrimack, NH, or Pointe-Claire, QC, is preferred. Travel within North America up to 20%.

**In this role you will:**

* Develop, implement, test, and maintain embedded real-time firmware in C and C++ for power conversion systems, including DC/DC converters, three-phase grid-tied inverters, and energy storage systems.
* Implement in real-time code the control algorithms that controls engineers define and simulate, including current, voltage, and power regulation, pulse-width modulation, Clarke and Park transformations, phase-locked loops, protection, and grid-support functions, within sampling, timing, and computational-delay budgets.
* Integrate and verify code generated from MATLAB and Simulink models, and keep firmware behavior traceable to the control specification.
* Design the real-time software architecture of control boards, including task scheduling, interrupt service routines, bootloaders, board-support packages, and hardware abstraction layers.
* Develop low-level peripheral drivers and interface software for ADC, PWM, timers, GPIO, I2C, SPI, UART, CAN, and other microcontroller peripherals.
* Design and develop embedded communication software, including TCP/IP stack integration, Ethernet-based communication, CAN, Modbus, and protocol-level diagnostics for connected power electronics products.
* Implement and debug external memory interfaces, including EEPROM, Flash, MRAM, and SD card, for data logging, configuration storage, field firmware updates, and fault-record handling.
* Test and debug firmware in-system and on processor-in-the-loop and hardware-in-the-loop platforms, using debuggers, emulators, oscilloscopes, and embedded instrumentation, and confirm with controls engineers that the code reproduces the simulated control performance.
* Support IEEE 1547 and UL 1741 grid-support inverter certification testing with firmware builds, parameter configuration, diagnostics, and defect resolution.
* Apply disciplined software practices, including version control, code reviews, static code analysis, automated unit testing, and release management.
* Write firmware requirements, software design specifications, and user documentation for embedded control software.
* Collaborate with controls, hardware, systems, tests, compliance, and manufacturing engineers on new system architectures, from concept through validation and commercial-scale manufacturing.
* Develop and manage detailed schedules for the firmware workstream of your projects.
* Mentor junior firmware and software engineers.

### **Qualifications**

REQUIRED

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or a related technical field, with 10+ years of relevant industrial experience in embedded firmware for power conversion or other real-time control products.
* Expert proficiency in C, and working proficiency in C++, for real-time, microcontroller-based control systems.
* Demonstrated experience implementing power electronics control algorithms in production firmware, including regulators, pulse-width and space vector modulation, Clarke and Park transformations, and phase-locked loops, with attention to fixed-point scaling, sampling, timing, and computational delay.
* Working knowledge of power electronics control theory sufficient to read control specifications and MATLAB and Simulink models, and to diagnose differences between simulated and measured behavior.
* Extensive experience in digital design engineering for power and instrumentation systems.
* Experience with electrical hardware for power conversion and instrumentation, and the ability to read and understand mixed-signal electrical schematics.
* Experience in bootloaders, device drivers, interrupt service routines, real-time operating systems or bare-metal schedulers, and hardware abstraction layers for embedded control boards.
* Hands-on experience with embedded communication interfaces and protocols, including TCP/IP, Ethernet, I2C, SPI, UART, CAN, Modbus, or similar industrial protocols.
* Experience with external memory devices and data storage mechanisms, including Flash, EEPROM, FRAM, SD card, wear-leveling, memory partitioning, and field firmware update support.
* Strong background in microcontroller- and FPGA-based architectures.
* Proficiency with firmware debugging and verification tools, including JTAG debuggers, emulators, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and hardware-in-the-loop platforms.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor and develop junior engineers.
* Excellent documentation skills for firmware requirements, software design specifications, and user manuals.

PREFERRED

* Master’s degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or a related technical field.
* Experience with Texas Instruments C2000 or ARM microcontrollers.
* Proficiency in Verilog-based logic design.

jobs.title: Scientist, DSCS Digital Technologies–Laboratory Automation, Automation Systems Engineer (Hybrid)
jobs.description:
Job Description
  
  
We are a global biopharmaceutical leader with a portfolio of prescription medicines, oncology, vaccines and animal health products. We are driven by our purpose to develop and deliver innovative products that save and improve lives. With 69,000 employees operating in more than 140 countries, we offer state-of-the-art laboratories, plants and offices that are designed to inspire our employees as we learn, develop and grow in our careers. We are proud of our over 125 years of service to humanity and continue to be one of the world’s biggest investors in Research & Development.
  
  
In the Development Sciences and Clinical Supply (DSCS) organization, we believe digital is the force multiplier that enables faster experiments, smarter decisions, more robust supply chains, and is ultimately redefining how we bring medicines to patients.
  
  
Within DSCS, the DSCS Digital Technologies (DDT) team is building the next generation of data-rich, connected lab environments—where hardware, software, and AI-driven tools work together to accelerate pharmaceutical development. Our goal is simple but ambitious: embed advanced digital capabilities into the DNA of how we work. We believe this future starts with an effective foundation of laboratory tools: innovative robotics, process analytical technology (PAT), high-throughput technologies, reliable instrumentation, and integrated systems that seamlessly transition data from the physical labs to the digital world. We believe innovation is fueled by collaborative teams that come together to build technologies that truly impact how our scientists conduct research. We’re looking for a Scientist to help make this vision real.
  
  
In this role, you won’t just support experiments—you’ll transform how they happen. You’ll design and deploy cutting-edge automation solutions that enable scientists to move faster, generate higher-quality data, and focus on what matters most: discovery and innovation. You’ll work to augment the capabilities of our current laboratory systems, creating custom solutions that unlock new potential for our scientists. working closely with scientists, engineers, and digital technology specialists to build integrated systems that connect instruments, robotics, and data—turning complex workflows into seamless, intelligent processes. If you’re excited by the idea of combining science, engineering, and digital innovation— If you are a maker, a builder, a tinkerer —this is your opportunity to make a lasting impact and transform pharmaceutical research!
  
  
How You’ll Make an Impact
  
  

* Design the lab of the future by developing automation systems that integrate robotics, instrumentation, and software into cohesive, high-performing solutions
* Translate science into systems by partnering with researchers to understand experimental needs and convert them into scalable automated workflows
* Work at the intersection of disciplines, collaborating with experts in automation, data science, modeling, IT, and digital engineering
* Lead high-impact projects from concept through deployment, working across teams and stakeholders to deliver meaningful outcomes
* Continuously improve existing automation platforms to enhance performance, usability, and reliability
* Connect the ecosystem by integrating robotic platforms with laboratory equipment and data systems to enable end-to-end digital workflows
* Empower others by providing hands-on support, troubleshooting, and training to scientists using these systems

**Education Minimum Requirement:**  

* A M.S. in Engineering (i.e. Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical), Robotics, Mechatronics, Chemistry, Physics, Biology, Pharmaceutical Sciences or a closely related field
* A B.S. in in Engineering (i.e. Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical), Robotics, Mechatronics, Chemistry, Physics, Biology, Pharmaceutical Sciences or a closely related field with at least 2 years of relevant experience

**Required Experience and Skills:**  

* Experience in a lab-based setting, working with lab automation and equipment integration
* Experience with scripting/programming following accepted best practices (version control, design patterns, clean code)
* Understanding of (bio)pharmaceutical process research and development, drug product development, and/ or analytical development
* Demonstrated ability to work in an entrepreneurial and independent manner on cross-functional teams
* Efficient scientific collaboration and communication skills with the ability to navigate conversations with technicians and vendors

**Preferred Experience and Skills:**  

* Experience with scripting/programming in one or more of the following: Python, C#, VBA, JavaScript, R
* Experience with automation edge devices and controllers (PLC, microcontrollers, etc)
* Experience with industrial SCADA or orchestration software (DeltaV, Ignition, WinCC OA, etc)
* Experience with benchtop automated reactor systems such as Sartorius Ambr250
* Experience with laboratory automation software, firmware, hardware, and their integration into end-to-end solutions
* Experience in integrating laboratory instruments with custom or commercial software solutions
* Ability to recognize, design, prototype, and deploy innovative technologies in laboratory automation
* Understanding of data science and AI/ML concepts and their application to laboratory automation
* Wet lab experience in (bio)pharmaceutical drug substance, drug product, and analytical research and development
* Experience with commercial laboratory notebook software like Benchling or Signals
* Motivated to learn new skills, willingness to take on new challenges, and scientific curiosity
* Deep interest and desire to understand how systems work. Self-proclaimed maker, builder, tinkerer

#EligibleforERP
  
  
**Required Skills:**  
Analytical Chemistry, Automation Technology, Bioprocess Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, Data Analysis, Laboratory Automation, Laboratory Instrument

Our Controls Teamwork on everything from our PLCs, SCADA system development, process implementation, to optimization across multiple infrastructure systems.  
  
**What you’ll be responsible for**:

jobs.title: Embedded Firmware Engineer
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**

Ideal Vacuum is an established scientific and industrial vacuum equipment company whose products support universities, laboratories, research facilities, and aerospace customers. Its team manufactures environmental testing systems and contributes to research and technological advancement.

**Job Overview**

Ideal Vacuum Products is seeking an experienced embedded firmware engineer to develop and support firmware for vacuum, spectroscopy, and other scientific and industrial equipment. You will help build our next generation of products using 32-bit Arm-based microcontrollers, work closely with our electrical engineering team, and keep released products reliable through careful debugging, testing, and updates.

Our newer PCB designs use STMicroelectronics STM32 microcontrollers. STM32 experience is strongly preferred, and we also welcome candidates with solid production firmware experience on comparable 32-bit Arm platforms. We value strong embedded C/C++ fundamentals and the ability to learn new devices and development tools.

Alongside new development, you will help maintain existing Atmel-based products and Atmel Studio projects. This includes adapting firmware when PCB components change, resolving production bugs, and verifying that updates work with the supported hardware revisions.

**Responsibilities**

* **Develop new product firmware.** Write clear, maintainable embedded C/C++ for 32-bit Arm-based microcontrollers, including STM32-based products. Implement device interfaces, measurement and control functions, and communications, and work with electrical engineers during board bring-up.
* **Troubleshoot production problems.** Reproduce failures, trace root causes, and fix existing code. Use in-circuit debuggers, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and diagnostic logs to distinguish firmware, hardware, and interaction problems.
* **Support PCB revisions.** Work with electrical engineers when a component is replaced or a board is improved. Compare device behavior and update drivers, initialization, pin assignments, timing, calibration, or communications as needed. Support firmware ports when microcontrollers change.
* **Test changes thoroughly.** Verify fixes on actual hardware, test normal and failure conditions, and check for regressions. Confirm compatibility with each supported board revision and document the results.
* **Make releases reproducible.** Maintain source control, build instructions, firmware version records, hardware compatibility information, and production programming instructions so the correct tested code reaches each board.
* **Work closely with the team.** Collaborate with electrical engineers, software developers, scientists, technicians, and manufacturing staff. Explain findings clearly and balance new development with timely support for production.

**Experience**

* **STM32 development tools such as STM32CubeIDE or STM32CubeMX**, and familiarity with vendor peripheral libraries or register-level programming.
* **Bare-metal firmware, an RTOS**, bootloaders, firmware updates, or robust handling of persistent settings.
* **Maintaining Atmel/Microchip AVR or SAM** codebases and existing Atmel Studio or Microchip Studio projects.
* **Production test fixtures,** automated regression testing, or Python/PC-side tools that support firmware development and manufacturing.
* Scientific instruments, industrial controls, sensor interfaces, precision measurements, or serial communications.

**What You Will Bring**

* Demonstrated professional experience developing and maintaining firmware for released hardware products, including 32-bit microcontrollers.
* Experience developing firmware for Arm-based MCUs. STM32 experience is strongly preferred; comparable 32-bit Arm experience is welcome.
* Strong embedded C skills and the ability to work with C++ code as needed, including memory use, interrupts, timers, state machines, and timing-sensitive behavior.
* Practical experience with peripheral interfaces such as UART, SPI, I2C, ADCs, or PWM, and the ability to learn unfamiliar devices from their datasheets.
* Ability to read relevant schematics, follow signals through a circuit, and debug independently at the bench.
* Disciplined use of Git or comparable version control, code review, documented testing, and controlled releases.
* Clear communication, careful problem-solving, and a willingness to understand existing designs before changing them.
* A degree in computer engineering, electrical engineering, computer science, or a related field, or equivalent demonstrated professional embedded development experience.

**Why Join Ideal Vacuum**

Work alongside the people designing, building, and testing the hardware your code runs on. You will contribute to new products and see the practical results of improvements to equipment already in production.

**Compensation & Benefits**

Competitive, negotiable salary based on relevant experience.

* Health, dental, and vision insurance.
* 401(k) retirement plan.
* Paid holidays, vacation, and sick leave.

How to Apply

Email workwithus@idealvac.com with the subject **Embedded Firmware Engineer Application**.

Please include your resume and a brief, nonconfidential example of a microcontroller firmware problem you personally solved. Tell us which MCU and tools you used, what you changed, and how you verified the result on hardware. New product bring-up, a production bug, or a firmware update accompanying a PCB revision are all relevant examples.

Ideal Vacuum Products  
5910 Midway Park Blvd. NE  
Albuquerque, NM 87109

Pay: $50,000.00 - $100,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) 3% Match
* Dental insurance
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance

Experience:

* Embedded Firmware: 2 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

**Senior Electrical Engineer**

Design Review, PCB Electronics & Sustaining Engineering

**About Ideal Vacuum Products**

Ideal Vacuum Products develops and supplies vacuum equipment, components, systems, and technology for scientific and industrial applications. Our engineering work combines electronics, software, mechanical systems, and hands-on testing.

**Summary:**

Ideal Vacuum Products is seeking a senior, hands-on electrical engineer who can strengthen our engineering team and help keep successful products in production. Our engineers develop electronic controls and measurement devices for vacuum and spectroscopy applications, working alongside scientists, mechanical engineers, software engineers, and manufacturing staff.

This role has two clear priorities: improve new designs through thoughtful review and mentoring, and sustain released PCB designs when components become obsolete or difficult to obtain. We need the engineer colleagues turn to when a circuit is not behaving, a design needs experienced judgment, or a component shortage threatens production.

**Responsibilities:**

After completing on-job training, an engineer at Ideal Vacuum is:

* **Lead design reviews.** Review schematics, PCB layouts, and component selections across the electrical engineering team's projects before prototype orders and production release. Identify issues in grounding, noise, protection, derating, power distribution, thermal performance, and testability.
* **Mentor fellow engineers.** Work through difficult problems with the team, explain the reasoning behind your recommendations, and help engineers build stronger design and troubleshooting skills.
* **Keep production boards buildable.** Track component lifecycle status, manufacturer change/discontinuance notices, and approved alternatives. Identify supply risks early and help prevent avoidable redesigns and production interruptions.
* **Qualify replacement components.** Compare datasheets and application requirements, evaluate electrical and thermal behavior, and verify package, pinout, timing, and firmware implications. Determine whether a substitution is truly drop-in or requires circuit, layout, or software changes.
* **Validate and release changes.** Use circuit analysis, simulation, and bench testing to verify replacements and revisions. Maintain accurate board BOMs, approved alternatives, schematics, revision records, and clear production change instructions.
* **Solve difficult hardware problems.** Investigate prototype failures, production issues, and returned products. Find root causes and implement corrective actions that improve reliability.
* **Work closely with production and suppliers.** Coordinate with purchasing, PCB fabrication/assembly suppliers, and manufacturing staff to qualify available parts and put approved changes into production promptly.

**Education:**

* B.S. Electrical Engineering + 2 years of relevant electrical design experience
* or M.S. Electrical Engineering

**Skills and Experience:** \* Expertise in power electronics and power distribution

* Substantial hands-on electronic product development experience, typically 10+ years, including responsibility for hardware after production release.
* Strong circuit-analysis and PCB design skills, with sound judgment across analog, digital, power, and embedded-control interfaces.
* A demonstrated record of component replacement and sustaining engineering for commercial products, supported by practical verification and documented releases.
* Proficiency with a professional schematic/PCB tool such as Altium, KiCad, DipTrace, or comparable software, plus familiarity with SPICE or similar circuit simulation.
* Confidence troubleshooting at the bench with oscilloscopes, multimeters, and other appropriate test instruments.
* Clear, patient technical communication; constructive design feedback; and the ability to prioritize urgent production needs alongside longer-term improvements.
* A bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or a closely related discipline, or an equivalent combination of technical education and demonstrated electronics design experience.

**Pay & Benefits:**

* Competitive and negotiable salary
* Health Insurance, Life Insurance, FSA
* Short & Long Term Disability
* 401K Retirement package
* Dental & Vision Insurance
* Flexible work schedule
* Profit sharing bonuses
* Paid holidays, vacation, and sick leave

**Why Join Ideal Vacuum**

You will have a direct influence on the quality of our products and the growth of our engineers. This is an opportunity to contribute technical judgment across new development, manufacturing, and the ongoing support of products customers depend on.

**How To Apply:**

Email your resume to **workwithus@idealvac.com** with a brief note describing:

* A production-board component substitution or obsolescence problem you personally resolved: what you changed, how you verified it, and how it reached production.
* A design review or mentoring example where your contribution helped another engineer avoid or solve a significant problem.

High-level, nonconfidential examples are welcome.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will develop mission-system software and simulation infrastructure to support capability-based testing. Victor, NY - hybrid role (typically 1-3 days in office weekly)

**About REDCOM Laboratories:**
  
REDCOM Laboratories is a leader in the design and manufacture of advanced communications solutions for mission-critical applications. We are committed to delivering secure, reliable, and innovative products to our customers in defense, public safety, and commercial sectors.

**Position Overview:**

We are seeking a versatile design engineer to join our engineering team in the role of Systems Engineer / Architect to collaboratively guide the design and evolution of REDCOM’s software and hardware products. This individual will refine customer and operational requirements into effective designs and ensure REDCOM products meet the performance, reliability, security, interoperability, and compliance requirements of mission-critical environments.

The Systems Engineer / Architect will work closely with software engineering, hardware engineering, product owners, program management, development partners, and other product stakeholders throughout the product development lifecycle. The ideal candidate combines excellent communications skills, strong systems engineering fundamentals, and practical experience in software or hardware product development. REDCOM is open to considering a junior or senior level as well, for the right person. Knowledge of real-time communication systems design, secure IP networking, zero-trust architectures, and Modular Open Systems Approach (MOSA) is highly desirable.

**Key Responsibilities of a Systems Engineer / Architect at REDCOM Laboratories:**

* Gather and analyze requirements from internal and external stakeholders, including standards documents, to create actionable system specifications.
* Evaluate and assess design approaches, considering tradeoffs of usability, performance, interoperability, scalability, reliability, security, maintainability, and cost. Identify technical risks and architectural constraints. Research available technologies and solutions as needed.
* Collaboratively design and document system architectures to meet requirements, integrating hardware, software, system interface, and user interface components. Define new system interfaces as needed.
* Apply classical engineering principles and critical thinking to ensure all functional and performance targets are achievable.
* Ensure designs comply with relevant industry, quality, reliability, regulatory, and cybersecurity standards.
* Provide technical guidance and facilitate technical collaboration across internal and external multidisciplinary teams throughout the design, software/hardware integration, validation, and commercialization phases of product development.
* Act as technical point of contact and subject matter expert for customer and other stakeholder interactions regarding system requirements and design. Participate in customer and program technical reviews, providing architectural insight and recommendations.
* Act as a representative of REDCOM for participation in technical consortia and standards bodies.
* Develop and review system overviews, design justifications, validation plans, interface specifications, diagrams, and other technical documentation. Clearly communicate what/why/how technical details to diverse audiences.
* Participate in design reviews, risk assessments, and troubleshooting activities. Assist in diagnosing and resolving system-level issues throughout product development and deployment life cycle.
* Drive continuous improvement and innovation to products and internal processes by monitoring business needs, industry trends, and emerging technologies.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Proven experience in design engineering and multidisciplinary product development teams.
* Demonstrated understanding of systems architecture concepts for complex software and embedded products.
* Demonstrated high-level knowledge of software design, interface design, platform integration, networking, and security principles.
* Excellent listening skills, critical thinking skills, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including demonstrated ability to describe complex technical concepts in plain language to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience in systems requirement development.
* Experience in real-time communications system design and implementation.
* Familiarity with VoIP/RoIP/video/chat communications protocols and technologies such as SIP, RTP, and XMPP.
* Familiarity with secure communications protocols and standards, including zero trust security models and commercial cryptography.
* Familiarity with Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) tools and methodologies.
* Awareness of Modular Open Systems Architecture standards such as the Sensor Open Systems Architecture™ (SOSA®) or similar open standards.
* Experience in defense, public safety, or other mission-critical environments.
* Active Secret Clearance, verifiable through the Defense Information Systems for Security (DISS) or the ability to obtain secret clearance through REDCOM sponsorship.

**SPECIAL WORKING CONDITIONS:**

* Hybrid work environment (work-at-home and in-office)
* This position may require occasional extended work hours to meet project/customer goals and minimal travel (under 15%)

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:**

* The employee must be able to work on a computer workstation for extended periods of time requiring the ability to hear, have visual acuity, and have manual dexterity. This position is an office-based position with limited travel and lifting requirements that would be rare to the role.

**Linux Systems Engineer (Patching & Vulnerability Management)**

We are looking for a Linux Systems Engineer focused on patching and vulnerability management. You will lead security hardening and lifecycle management across on-premises and cloud Linux environments, helping ensure servers remain patched, secure, and compliant.

  
  

**Why this role is important to us**

The team you will be joining is a part of Globalink Systems Engineering Linux team, a function that is vital to the company as this role helps minimize the Linux environment’s attack surface through automated remediation, proactive vulnerability management, and disciplined lifecycle management. It supports secure and reliable production services while maintaining the documentation and reporting needed for audit requirements.

  
  

**What you will be responsible for**

* Design, implement, and automate patch deployment strategies for RHEL, CentOS, and Ubuntu environments.

* Manage kernel upgrades, firmware updates, and driver compatibility across hardware, virtual, on-premises, and cloud platforms.

* Maintain rigorous documentation and reporting to support audit and compliance requirements, including SOC 2 and PCI DSS.

* Coordinate production maintenance activities where uptime and maintenance windows are critical.

These skills will help you succeed in this role:

* Deep Linux administration expertise, including command-line operations, shell scripting, and package managers such as YUM, DNF, and APT.

* Proven experience using infrastructure-as-code and configuration-management tools to manage environments at scale.

* Strong troubleshooting and decision-making skills across diverse hardware and virtual platforms.

* A reliability-focused approach to production systems, change planning, uptime, and controlled maintenance windows.

* Demonstrated professional experience administering Linux production environments.

* Hands-on experience with RHEL, CentOS, or Ubuntu and package-management tooling.

* Experience with vulnerability platforms such as Tenable, Qualys, or Rapid7.

* Experience with automation and configuration-management tools such as Ansible, Puppet, or Chef.

* Working knowledge of security hardening, vulnerability remediation, kernel and firmware lifecycle management, and audit documentation.

jobs.description:
**Job Description**  

Thank you for your interest in BAE Systems! We are hiring systems engineers at all experience levels to grow our Engine Controls team within Controls and Avionics Solutions (CAS).

These positions will be located at our Endicott, NY and Austin, TX locations. If your background and skillset align with our hiring needs, we will be in touch with next steps. If selected for an interview, we will discuss specific opportunities that match your interests and skillset with the hiring team.
  
  
It’s about the journey! Whether it’s a bus ride or flight, our electronic systems help transport millions of passengers every day. Every second a plane takes off somewhere in the world, enabled by our flight-critical products. On the ground, our electric and hybrid solutions save more than 22 million gallons of fuel per year. Be part of our journey at BAE Systems where you’ll be among the brightest minds, working on the industry’s most difficult problems. Drawing strength from our differences, we’re innovating for the future. And you can, too.
  
  
At BAE Systems, we promote a strong, collaborative culture and provide our employees with the tools, skills and training they need to succeed. We are all about trust, camaraderie, and a shared mission on delivering world class products to our commercial and military customers. We offer a flexible hybrid work environment and 9/80 work schedule. Our company is part of the community and driven to improve our future and protect our freedom.
  
  
We are hiring systems engineers at the individual contributor, team lead, chief engineer and technical director levels to participate in Electronic Systems development programs at any of the locations listed above. As a Systems Engineer, you will be a member of a cross-functional, multi-disciplinary team to model, design, develop, integrate, debug, test, field, and support our innovative Electronic Systems.

  
  
**Required Education, Experience, & Skills**  

* Bachelor Degree in Technical discipline or equivalent and 6+ years of relevant Systems Engineering experience
* Experience in a requirements development tool such as DOORs, Jama
* Experience in SysML modeling tool such as Cameo, MagicDraw
  

  
  
**Preferred Education, Experience, & Skills**  

* Masters of Science Degree in Electrical Engineering or a related engineering discipline
* Team Leadership experience including project technical leadership and/or Systems functional leadership.
* Experience with engine controls, flight controls, mission systems, actuation control, cabin systems, aircraft electrification and battery/energy management systems.
* Experience performing requirements analysis, derivation and allocation, and translating requirements to viable concepts design solutions.
* Hands on experience with HW Integration and Test in a lab environment.
* Product development experience including requirement analysis, architecture, system design, integration and test.
* Experience applying any of the following security processes; DoD Risk Management Framework (RMF), DO-326A Airworthiness Security Process Specification or ISO-21434 Road Vehicle Security.
  

  
  
**Pay Information**
  
Full-Time Salary Range: $107359 - $182510
  
  
Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.
  
  
Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. Our leave programs include paid time off, paid holidays, as well as other types of leave, including paid parental, military, bereavement, and any applicable federal and state sick leave. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics.  
  
  
  
**About BAE Systems, Inc.**
  
BAE Systems, Inc. is a defense, aerospace, and security company headquartered in Falls Church, Virginia, with more than 40,000 employees worldwide. We serve, supply, and protect those who protect us. As one of the most geographically diverse international defense companies, we deliver a full range of products and services spanning air, land, maritime, space, and cyber, including advanced electronics, intelligence solutions, and dedicated customer support.
  
  
Our culture is performance-driven and values-led, built on curiosity, creativity, and collaboration. Purpose isn't a tagline here. It's what drives us. We're developing breakthrough technologies that defend national security and make a lasting impact on our communities and our planet. When you join BAE Systems, you're not just building a career. You're contributing to a mission that truly matters.
  
  
This position will be posted for at least 5 calendar days. The posting will remain active until the position is filled, or a qualified pool of candidates is identified.

jobs.description:
In accordance with Washington state law, we are highlighting our comprehensive benefits package, which is available to all eligible US based employees.

Benefits for this role include:  

* Health, dental, vision, life, disability insurance
* Retirement Benefits: 401(k) with company match
* Paid Time Off: 20 days of vacation per year, accruing at a rate of 6.15 hours per pay period for the first five years of employment
* Sick Time: 40 hours/year (increased to 69 hours/year for Seattle) including 5 discretionary sick days per instance
* Maternity Leave (Short-Term Disability + Baby Bonding): 28-30 weeks
* Baby Bonding Leave: 18 weeks
* Holidays: 13 paid days per year

  
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Mountain View, CA, USA; New York, NY, USA; Seattle, WA, USA**.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in software development.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience with Apache Spark, Flink, Beam, Airflow, or BigQuery/Snowflake or other similar infrastructure.
* Experience developing, debugging, and supporting large-scale data pipelines.
* Experience with distributed data processing frameworks and workflow orchestration tools.
* Experience in Go/C++.
* Experience in a technical Lead or similar role, ideally setting technical direction for a small group of executive and junior software engineer.
* Ability to address daily business data requirements, ensure that development obstacles are cleared to maintain the Gemini App's changing growth.

**About the job**
-----------------

As a part of the Gemini Apps Data Engineering team, you will architect and operate the data pipelines that deliver critical telemetry across all Gemini surfaces. You will combine deep technical expertise with Google-scale operating experience to solve the unique data issues inherent in building a transformative, global product during a time of massive growth!

Gemini’s user base is growing continuously and our traffic has sometimes even doubled just over the course of a week. In this role, you will provide the technical leadership necessary to scale our infrastructure. You will architect durable data products and drive critical engineering initiatives across multiple teams to ensure we continue delivering metrics and training data quickly, reliably, and accurately at a massive global scale.  
  
In this role, you will leverage your experience in building and running scalable systems, and utilize modern data warehouse infrastructure at Google, lead a small team of executive and junior engineers to scale the data pipelines that drive Gemini Apps’s analytics and power model and product improvement. You will work directly with key stakeholders, including our Data Science, model release, model quality, and feature teams, as well as teams across DeepMind, to identify and solve key problems to help make Gemini the next billion-user product.

Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority.

We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $207000 - $300000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Work closely with our Data Science counterparts in definition and driving the goals for a Modern Data Warehouse.
* Architect and build scalable batch and real-time pipelines that power experimentation, product analytics, and ML/AI training loops.
* Own data quality, reliability, and observability end-to-end, including defining and operating Service Level Agreements (SLAs)/ Service Level Objectives (SLOs) for critical production datasets.
* Mentor and grow other engineers, raising the technical bar through design reviews, code reviews, and actionable feedback.
* Drive cross-functional engineering initiatives that span multiple teams, translating ambiguous requirements into technical designs.

Everything we do directly drives millions of news consumers in our national and local markets, their experience with our services, and impacts our ABC newsrooms.

* Own and drive news features shipped to millions of users

* Join an inclusive culture that incorporates diverse perspectives and supports individual needs

* 10+ years of experience in mobile application development with expert knowledge of Swift, UIKit/SwiftUI, Apple frameworks or Java, Kotlin, Android frameworks
* Bachelor’s or Master degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Demonstrated ability to set team goals, manage toward OKRs, and hold team members accountable for outcomes
* Experience partnering with stakeholders in Product and Design to curate a roadmap that meets the needs of the business while ensuring the ongoing health of your teams and systems.
* Experience leading a team, including delegating responsibility and balancing competing priorities
* Hold high standards of quality for both the codebases you contribute to and the applications you build

* Experience composing and presenting thoughtful and implementable solutions to a variety of stakeholders (technical and non-technical)

We are seeking a hands‑on engineer with a strong background in low‑level software/firmware development, computer architecture, and PCI‑Express (PCIe) technology to join our team. * Design, develop, integrate, and maintain PCIe Switch firmware for servers.

* Develop specifications for link‑training, error handling, lane‑reconfiguration, and hot‑plug flows.

* Collaborate with validation and I/O teams to develop unit-test, and hardware-in-the-loop test plans.
* Conduct thorough testing and debugging of firmware to ensure high-quality and reliable solutions.
* Contribute to the improvement of our firmware development processes and tools.
* Produce clear design documents, guides, and release notes.
* Stay current with PCIe specifications (PCIe 5.0/6.0, CXL, etc.), emerging standards, and industry trends.

* BS degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or Computer Engineering
* 6 years' minimum experience in Embedded Firmware/Software Development
* Power user with Windows and Linux operating systems
* Experience with firmware programming and debugging
* Proficient with Git source version control system.
* Knowledgeable in Agile methodologies and tools.
* Proficient with scripting (bash and python)
* Familiarity with C for embedded environments; experience with real‑time OSes
* Proficient with building firmware from source
* Experience with translating schematics to firmware
* Experience integrating source code from external vendors
* Strong debugging skills – ability to isolate issues across silicon, firmware, and software stacks.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Background in PCIe, CXL, or other coherent interconnect technologies.
* Deep understanding of PCIe protocol layers, link‑training, flow control, error handling, and configuration register space.
* Proficient at recognizing complex problems related to functional objectives.
* Previous experience with hardware and firmware bring-up
* Automation CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing frameworks.
* Familiarity with debug/trace interfaces and tools (I2C-UART, logic analyzers, protocol analyzers).
* Familiarity with Docker containers and virtualization technologies
* Prior work in a data‑center or high‑performance computing (HPC) environment.

jobs.description:
**Automation Engineer**

FlexSeals | Tipp City, OH  
Travel: Approximately 25% to other company manufacturing locations

**Position Overview**

FlexSeals is seeking an experienced, hands-on Automation Engineer to improve manufacturing performance through equipment automation, controls, and process improvements.

This person will work closely with Engineering, Tool & Die Engineering, Operations, Maintenance, and Quality to develop practical solutions and carry projects from initial concept through installation, startup, and reliable daily operation. The role will support automation opportunities across extrusion, rubber and plastics processing, and related manufacturing and finishing operations.

We are looking for someone who brings practical manufacturing automation experience, enjoys working on the production floor, and can take ownership of technical projects. This person must understand how controls, equipment, tooling, and production processes work together to improve safety, quality, throughput, and cost.

The position is based in Tipp City, Ohio, and requires approximately 25% travel to support projects, equipment improvements, and implementation at other company manufacturing locations.

**Key Responsibilities**

Automation Development & Implementation

* Identify and evaluate opportunities to automate manual, repetitive, or inconsistent manufacturing tasks.
* Develop automation concepts based on production requirements, equipment capabilities, tooling needs, and expected return on investment.
* Design, specify, or coordinate controls, sensors, actuators, fixtures, and equipment needed to implement automation projects.
* Manage projects from requirements and concept development through equipment selection, installation, testing, and production handoff.
* Work with equipment builders, controls integrators, and suppliers to ensure solutions meet operating requirements.

**Tool & Die Engineering Collaboration**

* Work closely with Tool & Die engineers to develop tooling, fixtures, and production aids that support automation and repeatable manufacturing.
* Coordinate mechanical, tooling, and controls requirements so equipment and tooling function together reliably.
* Participate in design reviews to evaluate part positioning, material handling, tooling access, changeovers, and maintenance needs.
* Support tooling trials and equipment startup, helping troubleshoot issues involving tooling, controls, and process interactions.
* Incorporate feedback from Tool & Die Engineering and production teams to improve manufacturability, cycle time, consistency, and ease of operation.

**Controls & Equipment Troubleshooting**

* Develop, modify, and troubleshoot PLC programs, HMI interfaces, and related control systems.
* Diagnose equipment issues involving controls, sensors, drives, electrical systems, and mechanical interactions.
* Work with Maintenance, Tool & Die Engineering, and Operations to address recurring downtime and improve equipment reliability.
* Maintain clear program backups, equipment documentation, and records of control-system changes.

**Process Improvement & Manufacturing Support**

* Observe production processes and use operating data to identify bottlenecks, scrap drivers, and sources of variation.
* Implement improvements that increase throughput, reduce manual handling, improve consistency, and control manufacturing costs.
* Work with Engineering and Quality to ensure automation supports product requirements and process repeatability.
* Evaluate existing equipment for upgrades, retrofits, and improved integration with surrounding operations.
* Develop solutions that operators and maintenance personnel can use and support effectively.

**Project Coordination & Support Across Locations**

* Define project scope, timelines, costs, and acceptance criteria with the appropriate stakeholders.
* Coordinate internal resources, vendors, and contractors to keep projects moving.
* Support equipment trials, installation, startup, troubleshooting, and validation of performance.
* Travel approximately 25% to other company manufacturing locations to evaluate opportunities, support implementation, and resolve technical issues.
* Share successful automation approaches and lessons learned across manufacturing locations.
* Train operators and maintenance personnel on new equipment, controls, and operating procedures.
* Follow through after startup to resolve issues and confirm that improvements perform as intended.

**Safety & Documentation**

* Incorporate machine safety, guarding, safe access, and maintainability into automation designs and equipment changes.
* Coordinate with appropriate personnel to review safety requirements before equipment enters service.
* Maintain useful electrical drawings, operating instructions, troubleshooting guides, and technical records.
* Communicate project status, technical concerns, costs, and risks clearly.

**Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience implementing and supporting automation or industrial controls in a manufacturing environment.
* Demonstrated ability to program and troubleshoot PLCs, HMI systems, and related equipment controls.
* Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, equipment drawings, and technical documentation.
* Practical experience troubleshooting the interaction between electrical controls, mechanical equipment, and manufacturing processes.
* Ability to take ownership of projects, coordinate with others, and follow through from problem identification to a working solution.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with engineers, toolmakers, maintenance technicians, and production personnel.
* Willingness and ability to travel approximately 25% to other company manufacturing locations.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Three or more years of relevant manufacturing automation, controls engineering, or equipment integration experience.

Enovation Controls is a turnkey technology company that solves complex problems and delivers innovative electronic control and display solutions across diverse markets. People who find their place here tend to stay. Many of our team members have decades of tenure, evidence of a culture where people feel valued and want to build a career.

We’re proud to be recognized by Great Place to Work as one of the Best Workplaces in Manufacturing & Production for seven consecutive years, as well as by Mployer Advisor for our Top U.S. Benefits. **Description**

The SVE Electrical Engineer, within the Engineering department, primarily leads Value Analysis/Value Engineering (VAVE) initiatives for production electronics while providing secondary support for sustaining engineering activities. This role partners with New Product Development during product launch and electrical design-ownership handoff, then assumes ongoing responsibility for maintaining assigned products throughout production. The engineer works cross-functionally with Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, and Product Management to identify and implement improvements that optimize cost, manufacturability, electrical performance, component availability, product quality, and reliability.

* **Cross-Functional Execution:** Develop VAVE business cases and coordinate technical changes with Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, Product Management, and suppliers.

* Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or a related field.

* Electronic product-design experience with schematic capture and PCB design tools.
* Knowledge of analog and digital circuit design, troubleshooting techniques, component selection, and PCB fabrication and assembly processes.
* Experience with test instruments, electrical validation, DFM/DFT, and root-cause analysis.
* Ability to execute VAVE changes, qualify alternate components, and control product documentation and engineering changes.

* Familiarity with Altium Designer for schematic capture and PCB design.
* Experience using Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems for schematics, BOMs, configuration, and engineering changes.
* Knowledge of ruggedized electronics, embedded controllers, displays, power, CAN/J1939, Ethernet, and EMC/EMI.
* Background in environmental testing, component obsolescence, alternate-source qualification, or high-volume manufacturing processes.

**Why Enovation Controls**

We tackle complex work with high expectations and a learning mindset. Our culture is fun and rewarding, and we consistently rank among the best places to work in manufacturing. We back that culture with solid benefits: a strong 401(k) match, cost-effective healthcare options that meaningfully reduce out-of-pocket costs, wellness support, and profit-sharing that rewards collective success.

*We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity. All employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business need.*
