jobs.title: Systems Engineer, Data Systems
jobs.description:
Meta Reality Labs is seeking a Staff Systems Engineer to define and drive hardware systems architecture for next-generation ground truth data collection systems. In this role, you will own the end-to-end system architecture operating at the intersection of data systems, virtual and augmented reality platforms, custom sensor streaming platforms, custom synchronization platforms, calibration, and operations. You will partner with ML and CV feature teams—including Eye Tracking, Hand Tracking, Holograms, Silent Speech, and Health—to define requirements, design and build ground truth systems, and lead systems through integration, test, and transition to Operations.  
  
  

### **Systems Engineer, Data Systems Responsibilities:**

* Define and own end-to-end hardware system architecture for ground truth data collection systems, spanning sensor streaming, synchronization, calibration, and data pipeline subsystems
* Partner with ML and CV feature teams (Eye Tracking, Hand Tracking, Holograms, Silent Speech, Health) to translate data collection requirements into system-level specifications
* Develop system-level requirements and allocate performance budgets across custom sensor platforms, synchronization hardware, and data infrastructure to meet ground truth quality targets
* Lead architectural trade-off analyses across competing design dimensions including data throughput, synchronization precision, calibration accuracy, latency, and cost
* Drive alignment on data systems architecture decisions across hardware, firmware, software, and operations teams through written proposals and cross-functional reviews
* Establish and maintain system integration frameworks that enable early detection of cross-subsystem risks in data collection pipelines
* Define and oversee bring-up and validation strategies for complex multi-sensor data capture platforms
* Lead systems through integration, test, and transition to Operations, ensuring production readiness and operational sustainability
* Develop long-term data systems platform roadmaps that anticipate ML/CV feature requirements and inform hardware and infrastructure decisions
* Mentor other engineers on systems architecture methodology and contribute to raising the technical bar across the data systems organization
* Demonstrate a service mindset by staying hands-on with day-to-day work and supporting tasks at all levels—no task is too small or too senior for this role

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 8+ years of experience in hardware systems architecture or systems engineering for consumer electronics, wearables, or mobile computing platforms
* Experience defining system-level requirements and allocating performance budgets across heterogeneous hardware subsystems including compute, power, thermal, and sensing
* Experience leading cross-functional hardware architecture decisions from concept through mass production, including silicon bring-up and system validation
* Experience developing multi-generation hardware platform roadmaps and driving technical alignment across silicon, firmware, and mechanical engineering teams
* Experience communicating complex hardware architecture trade-offs in writing to both technical peers and non-technical leadership

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with AR or VR hardware platforms, including display pipelines, sensor fusion, or spatial computing subsystems
* Experience defining hardware-software interface specifications and collaborating with firmware or embedded software teams on system-level optimization
* Familiarity with low-power SoC architecture, mixed-signal integration, or high-speed interconnect standards relevant to wearable devices
* Track record of driving architectural decisions that influenced silicon tape-out or platform-level product outcomes

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

jobs.title: Senior Electronics Engineer
jobs.description:
Eaton’s ES AMER PCS division is currently seeking a Senior Electronics Engineer. This hybrid position that is based out of our Moon Township, PA Eaton location and offers benefits from day one as well as relocation from within the country.

The expected annual salary range for this role is $86000 - $126000 a year.

Please note the salary information shown above is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.

**What you’ll do:**
-------------------

The Senior Electronics Engineer will be part of the **Embedded Systems group** and will lead verification and validation (V&V) activities for Eaton’s circuit breaker and protection systems.

The primary responsibilities of this role include:

* Serve as the **technical and project lead** for verification and validation activities supporting new product development and existing product lines.
* Lead the **design, development, and implementation of test automation frameworks**.
* Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and training to **global V&V teams**.
* Lead and support **continuous improvement initiatives** related to V&V processes, methodologies, tools, and laboratory capabilities.

### **Essential Functions**

* Develop and execute verification and validation strategies, plans, and procedures for embedded firmware, hardware, and system-level testing.
* Analyze product requirements, functional specifications, and applicable industry standards to establish verification requirements and ensure complete requirements traceability.
* Design, develop, automate, and maintain test cases, test scripts, and test frameworks for embedded protection systems.
* Perform functional, integration, system, regression, performance, and release testing for electronic trip units and associated circuit breaker products.
* Validate communication interfaces, industrial communication protocols, interoperability, and configuration software.
* Develop and maintain automated test systems and laboratory equipment to improve test efficiency, repeatability, reliability, and coverage.
* Investigate and reproduce hardware, firmware, and system-level defects, and perform root cause analysis to support effective resolution.
* Review system and software requirements, architecture, and design documentation to ensure testability and verification completeness.
* Verify product compliance with applicable UL, IEC, CSA, and ANSI standards, as well as Eaton engineering processes and requirements.
* Maintain comprehensive V&V documentation, including test plans, procedures, execution records, defect reports, traceability matrices, and validation reports.
* Participate in design reviews, risk assessments, DFMEA activities, and technical reviews throughout the product development lifecycle.
* Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and guidance to V&V engineers and cross-functional engineering teams.
* Drive continuous improvement of verification methodologies, test automation, laboratory capabilities, and engineering best practices.
* Support field issue investigations, customer problem resolution, root cause analysis, and corrective and preventive actions.
* Collaborate closely with firmware, hardware, systems engineering, manufacturing, quality, product management, and program management teams throughout the product development lifecycle.

**Qualifications:**
-------------------

**Basic (Required) Qualifications:**

* Bachelor of Science degree in Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering from an accredited institution.
* Minimum of 2 years of working experience.
* Experience in testing automation framework design and development.
* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without company sponsorship now and in the future.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Strong knowledge of electronics devices, specifically in trip units, meters, and protective relays.
* Testing experience with full cycle of product development.
* Knowledge of electrical power systems and communication protocols.
* Experiences on embedded firmware and hardware testing.
* Experiences on developing automation scripts and validating electrical products, specifically with Python and Labview.
* Experience of working with global engineering teams.

**What makes you successful:**

* You are self-motivated, proactive, and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage priorities, take ownership of your work, and overcome technical challenges.
* You have strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to prepare clear, comprehensive test procedures, technical documentation, and reports.
* You are an effective collaborator who can build strong working relationships across global and cross-functional engineering teams.
* You stay current with firmware testing tools, technologies, and industry best practices, and proactively identify opportunities to improve testing processes and methodologies.
* You bring strong technical, analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills to complex engineering challenges.
* You demonstrate sound engineering judgment and design skills, with the ability to develop practical and effective technical solutions.
* You are willing and able to travel up to 10%.

----------------------------

The coolest jobs on this planet… or any other… are with Lockheed Martin Space." At the dawn of a new space age, Lockheed Martin is a pioneer, partner, innovator and builder. Our amazing men and women are on a mission to make a difference in the world and every day we use our unique skills and experiences to create, design and build solutions to some of the worlds’ hardest engineering problems. Our culture encourages employees to dream big, perform with excellence and create incredible products. We provide the resources, inspiration and focus and if you have the passion and courage to dream big, we want to build a better tomorrow with you. Within LM Space, the Echo Program Area is looking for a highly motivated individual to join the program area as a Software Engineer. This exciting position will fill a critical need in the new and emerging area of protecting space assets.

* You will be working with a custom built software framework and its baseline while integrating into new industry standard and development pipeline tools.
* As part of an Agile team, you will have the opportunity to work on a variety of tasks in various areas across the mission and collaborate with the development teams, contractors, customers, and subject matter experts.

This position provides the opportunity to be a part of the entire engineering life-cycle, where the candidate will be able to apply their Software Engineering background at the lowest level all the way up through full system functionality. The Echo Program Area provides a variety of development efforts and opportunities focused on meeting customer driven and operational needs. If you are looking for a new position in a fast paced team environment, where every day brings a new challenge, and you want to support a critical space security mission, the Echo Program Area is the place for you. Applicants selected will be subject to a government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information, and must maintain the required security throughout the course of employment.

Plans, conducts, and coordinates software development activities. Designs, develops, documents, tests, and debugs software that contains logical and mathematical solutions to business/mission problems or questions in computer language for solutions by means of data processing equipment. Applies the appropriate standards, processes, procedures, and tools throughout the development life cycle. Applies knowledge of computer hardware and software, subject matter to be programmed in business/mission applications, information processing techniques used, and information gathered from system users to develop software. Corrects program errors, prepares operating instructions, compiles documentation of program development, and analyzes system capabilities to resolve questions of program intent, output requirements, input data acquisition, programming techniques, and controls. Ensures software standards are met.

C/C++  
C#

Machine to Machine Communication: REST, gRPC, GEMS

Secure Programming and Authentication (JWT, TLS, OAuth 2.0)

jobs.title: Systems Engineer- Navy Submarine Combat Systems
jobs.description:
Arcfield Overview: Arcfield was purpose-built to relentlessly protect the nation and its allies from today’s national security threats. We have nearly 70 years of proven expertise and excel in space superiority, hypersonic defense and nuclear deterrence, digital transformation, and surface and undersea warfare domains. Our solution areas include space mission engineering, atmospheric science, digital engineering, mission assurance, and advances in modeling and simulation that together with our enterprise-wide adoption of artificial intelligence and machine learning, lead to better systems and timely, reliable decision-making. Headquartered in Chantilly, VA with 18 North American offices, Arcfield employs 2,200 engineers, scientists, analysts, IT specialists and other professionals who challenge the status quo to deliver an efficient technological advantage to our national security and defense partners. Responsibilities:

Arcfield is seeking a motivated, technically minded individual transitioning from the U.S. Navy to support the future development of the Navy’s AN/BYG-1 Submarine Combat Control System. This position is well suited for junior Sailors with experience in submarine Fire Control, SONAR, combat systems, weapons systems, or related technical ratings who want to apply their fleet experience in a civilian engineering environment.

You will work alongside experienced engineers, Navy veterans, and technical specialists to support the research, development, testing, and evaluation of submarine combat systems. Your firsthand understanding of submarine operations, equipment, maintenance, and fleet procedures will help the team develop and improve capabilities that support the warfighter. On-the-job training and mentorship will help you build your technical knowledge and grow your career in defense engineering.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Apply Navy experience and technical training to support the development and improvement of submarine combat systems.
* Assist engineering teams in evaluating system requirements, operational procedures, and potential improvements to submarine combat capabilities.
* Support testing, troubleshooting, equipment evaluations, and technical demonstrations in laboratory and operational environments.
* Help develop and review technical documents, test procedures, training materials, and operational guides.
* Participate in technical reviews, operational experiments, and test events alongside experienced engineers and fleet personnel.
* Share firsthand knowledge of submarine operations, equipment, and watchstanding procedures to help engineers understand fleet needs.
* Support evaluations of submarine weapons systems, sonar, combat control capabilities, and emerging technologies.
* Work with senior engineers, technical leads, and program personnel to track project activities, document results, and communicate findings.
* Learn engineering processes, system requirements, configuration management, and testing practices through hands-on experience and mentorship.
* Contribute to a team environment built on accountability, attention to detail, technical growth, and mission success.

At Arcfield, we understand that flexibility matters. While this position requires onsite support at our Newport, RI location, we offer flexible work schedules that allow employees to balance personal commitments with professional responsibilities. Candidates must be local or willing to relocate.

Qualifications:

* BS 0-2 Years of HS 6-8 additional technical training, military schools, or relevant certifications are a plus
* Must possess and maintain an active U.S. Government Secret security clearance.
* U.S. Navy experience in a submarine, combat systems, Fire Control, SONAR, electronics, weapons, or related technical field.
* Working knowledge of submarine operations, equipment, maintenance procedures, or combat systems gained through military training or fleet experience.
* Ability to follow technical procedures, identify problems, document findings, and work effectively as part of a team.
* Strong attention to detail, willingness to learn, and commitment to mission readiness and equipment reliability.
* Basic computer skills and the ability to learn new technical tools and systems.
* Ability to communicate clearly with teammates, engineers, and government personnel.
* This position offers transitioning Sailors an opportunity to turn their military training and operational experience into a long-term civilian career supporting the U.S. Navy. Successful candidates will gain hands-on exposure to engineering, system testing, technical documentation, and future submarine combat capabilities while learning from experienced engineers and former fleet personnel.

**About The Role:** Are you a responsive problem-solver who excels at helping users get back to work quickly? Kota Technology is hiring a Level 1 Service Desk Engineer to be the first line of support for our growing client base. You'll own ticket triage, first response, and resolution of routine IT issues—and you'll be measured on how effectively you resolve issues at your level, not on how many you pass up.

This is a full-time, in-office position with occasional onsite visits to client locations. Your work directly impacts client satisfaction and Kota's reputation for responsive, dependable support.

**About Kota Technology:** Kota Technology is a leading Healthcare Managed Services Provider and expanding into various commercial businesses. We serve over 50 medical and dental practices across South Dakota, North Dakota, Minnesota, and Nebraska.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Respond to incoming support tickets, calls, and emails within SLA targets; set correct Priority and Work Type at intake
* Resolve routine, documented issues end-to-end: password resets, account lockouts, printer troubleshooting, connectivity problems
* Execute user onboarding and offboarding tasks from checklist to completion
* Manage basic Microsoft 365 administration: create accounts, assign licenses, manage mailboxes and groups
* Keep clients informed throughout ticket resolution with clear, professional communication
* Document work thoroughly: what was done, who it was discussed with, troubleshooting steps, and resolution
* Perform onsite support at client locations when scheduled (hardware installs, equipment swaps, hands-on troubleshooting)

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING:**

* Strong customer service mindset—you genuinely want to help users solve their problems
* Attention to detail and disciplined documentation habits (this is critical at Kota)

* Comfort working independently and asking for help when an issue is beyond your scope
* Basic technical foundation in Windows, Active Directory, Microsoft 365, and network connectivity
* Reliable transportation and willingness to travel within our service area for onsite work
* Ability to lift and move IT equipment up to 50 lbs

**WHAT YOU'LL GET:**

* A clear career ladder: L1 → L1.5 (Field Support) → L2 → L2.5 → L3, with advancement based on demonstrated skills
* Mentorship and runbooks to help you grow
* A role where good work is recognized—strong L1 engineers resolve the bulk of issues cleanly at their level
* Full-time employment with a growing company

**THE OPPORTUNITY:**

This is an entry or intermediate-level IT support role ideal for someone who wants to build a career in managed services. Success here isn't about volume—it's about clean, complete ticket resolution, professional client interactions, and taking ownership of your work. L1 is the foundation of Kota's service experience, and strong performers move quickly into field-based roles and beyond.

**WORK ARRANGEMENT:**

In-office with occasional onsite visits to client locations. A valid driver's license and reliable transportation required.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Experience in healthcare IT environments
* Understanding of HIPAA compliance requirements
* CompTIA A+, Network+, or similar certifications
* Experience with remote support tools (TeamViewer, ConnectWise, etc.)
* Knowledge of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP)
* Experience with cable management and structured cabling
* Familiarity with antivirus and security software
* Experience with ticketing systems

**Physical Requirements:**

* Comfortable working with ladders, drills, and other power tools
* Ability to crawl under desks, climb ladders, and work in tight spaces
* Capable of bending, kneeling, and standing for extended periods
* Able to work in varying environments including server rooms, construction sites, and medical facilities

**Candidates with More Experience:** While this position is classified as Tier 1, we encourage candidates with more extensive experience to apply. Design, develop, integrate, test, and deliver embedded software for spacecraft flight and ground systems in support of the NASA Johnson Space Center Engineering Directorate. This position covers the full software development life cycle, from requirements definition and architecture through design, implementation, verification, deployment, and sustainment, for flight and ground hardware projects. The ideal candidate is a hands-on engineer who is comfortable owning software from concept to delivered hardware, working closely with hardware and electronics designers, and delivering high-quality, well-documented products.

**Texas Research Institute (TRI) Austin** is an established small business with more than 45 years of experience providing applied materials science research and development (R&D) services to government and commercial clients. Our work spans a variety of technical disciplines, requiring innovative engineering solutions to address complex research and testing challenges.

We are looking for an **Embedded Systems Engineer** to contribute to the design and development of integrated hardware and software solutions used to collect experimental data across a broad range of applications and physical environments.

The successful candidate will apply their knowledge of embedded hardware, firmware development, sensor integration, data acquisition, and electronic troubleshooting to support ongoing research and development projects. This position requires someone who can take loosely defined technical requirements and turn them into practical, reliable systems.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and prototype custom printed circuit boards (PCBs), including schematic design, component selection, assembly, and bench testing.
* Create embedded hardware and firmware solutions for sensor-based data acquisition and control applications, including bare-metal microcontroller programming and supporting software.
* Identify, integrate, and configure instrumentation for both existing data acquisition installations and newly developed systems.
* Develop customized sensing solutions using specialized components and commercially available technologies.
* Implement signal conditioning and digital signal processing (DSP) methods, including signal sampling, amplification, filtering, and sensor data analysis.
* Design and develop single-axis and multi-axis motion control systems, as well as modify existing equipment for specialized applications.
* Engineer electrical systems ranging from low-voltage DC power distribution to high-voltage AC applications used in materials characterization.
* Evaluate, troubleshoot, repair, and upgrade electronic equipment, including legacy and obsolete hardware.
* Assemble and evaluate engineering prototypes through laboratory testing, refining designs as needed before field implementation.
* Maintain technical documentation detailing development progress, engineering decisions, testing procedures, and results for customer reporting.
* Assist in the preparation and review of technical proposals, project reports, and other engineering deliverables.

Requirements:

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline.
* At least two years of professional experience in embedded systems or related engineering development.
* Proficiency in C/C++ and Python programming.
* Experience with PCB design software such as Altium or KiCad.
* Working knowledge of hardware communication protocols, including SPI, I²C, RS-232, and CAN.
* Hands-on experience with engineering laboratory equipment, including soldering tools, oscilloscopes, and logic analyzers.
* Ability to work collaboratively with engineers and researchers across multiple technical disciplines.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, particularly when documenting technical work.
* Exposure to analog, RF, or microwave circuit design.
* Experience with nondestructive evaluation (NDE) techniques, such as eddy current, ultrasonic, or terahertz inspection.

**Position Details**

* **Location:** Southwest Austin, Texas
* **Work Arrangement:** Full-time, on-site position
* **Compensation:** Salary based on qualifications and relevant experience

TRI Austin offers a competitive benefits package and the opportunity to work on diverse, technically challenging projects while enjoying the quality of life that Austin has to offer.

* Developing shared frameworks for our orchestration tools to ensure a consistent experience across all messaging channels

jobs.description:
Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

**Job Title**

**Senior Systems Engineer, Neuromodulation**

**Working at Abbott**
---------------------

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and your family, be your true self, and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:

* Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.
* Employees can qualify for free medical coverage in our Health Investment Plan (HIP) PPO medical plan in the next calendar year.
* An excellent retirement savings plan with a high employer contribution.
* Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program, and FreeU education benefit - an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor’s degree.
* A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries worldwide and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.
* A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as the best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

This position works out of our Plano, TX location in the Neuromodulation division. Our Neuromodulation business includes implantable devices compatible with mobile technology to help people who suffer from chronic pain and movement disorders. These non-opioid therapies allow us to provide interventional pain therapy to patients throughout the pain continuum.

In this individual contributor role, you will drive systems engineering activities for complex active implantable medical device systems, translating clinical, user, and business needs into robust, verifiable solutions. You will maintain a whole-system perspective across implants, leads and electrodes, external accessories, patient and clinician applications, and their interfaces while helping guide development from concept through commercialization.

**What You'll Work On**
-----------------------

* Develop and maintain system architectures, design documentation, and system requirements for implantable neuromodulation systems, external devices, and software applications.
* Translate patient, clinician, customer, and business needs into measurable system requirements, design inputs, acceptance criteria, and traceable engineering deliverables.
* Define system behaviors, interfaces, workflows, operating modes, and architecture models while identifying gaps, conflicts, and risks across multidisciplinary systems.
* Collaborate with electrical, firmware, software, mechanical, clinical, human factors, and business teams to evaluate concepts, resolve design tradeoffs, and support system integration.
* Support risk management, verification and validation, system characterization, regulatory documentation, design reviews, and commercialization activities.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Systems Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related engineering or scientific field.
* 6+ years of relevant R&D or product development experience, including systems engineering, system design, or requirements development for complex multidisciplinary products.
* Demonstrated experience defining or developing system architectures, requirements, subsystem allocations, interfaces, design tradeoffs, and verification approaches.
* Working understanding of how hardware, embedded firmware, software, mechanical components, and user interactions integrate to determine overall system behavior, performance, and safety.
* Experience working in a regulated development environment and applying risk management, design controls, and relevant industry standards.
* Strong analytical, communication, and collaboration skills with the ability to structure ambiguous problems, document technical decisions, and influence cross-functional teams without direct authority.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience with Class II or Class III medical devices, particularly active implantable devices, neuromodulation, cardiac rhythm management, or other electromechanical therapy systems.
* Experience taking one or more multidisciplinary products through the complete development lifecycle, from needs identification and concept development through system integration, verification, validation, and commercialization.
* Experience defining system requirements and interfaces for stimulation or sensing, implant-to-external-device communication, battery or charging systems, and patient or clinician software applications.
* Understanding of Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), SysML, or INCOSE-aligned practices, including experience using system models to support architecture, behavior, interface definition, and requirements analysis.
* INCOSE certification (such as CSEP) is a plus.
* Experience with requirements-management tools, user-centered design or human factors, and medical device standards such as ISO 13485, ISO 14971, ISO 14708, and IEC 60601, as applicable.

Apply Now

Follow your career aspirations to Abbott for diverse opportunities with a company that can help you build your future and live your best life. Abbott is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to employee diversity.

jobs.description:
GeoControl Systems, Inc. as a HUBZone company, is required to maintain a Federally mandated level of employees that reside (home residence) in a qualified HUBZone. ONLY applicants whose home address lies in a qualified HUBZone will be considered for this position.

You can verify whether you reside in a HUBZone by using the following website:

https://maps.certify.sba.gov/hubzone/map

Are you passionate about human space exploration, understanding the origins of the universe, and working with a passionate and diverse team to make a difference? If you are, we need you!

  

We need your talent, teamwork, and energy to help us achieve great things that inspire people all over the globe. We need you to bring creative ideas and diverse backgrounds to help us envision, shape, and deliver systems that will enable the exploration of space while benefiting people here on Earth. We are excited about what we do, and we need you on our team as we take on exciting challenges for NASA’s pursuits in deep space exploration. As NASA’s largest engineering solutions provider working together with NASA at centers across the United States.

  

We have an exciting opportunity for a **Embedded Software Engineer** to join the JETSII Contract with GeoControls, a teammate company!

  

Design, develop, integrate, test, and deliver embedded software for spacecraft flight and ground systems in support of the NASA Johnson Space Center Engineering Directorate. This position covers the full software development life cycle, from requirements definition and architecture through design, implementation, verification, deployment, and sustainment, for flight and ground hardware projects. The ideal candidate is a hands-on engineer who is comfortable owning software from concept to delivered hardware, working closely with hardware and electronics designers, and delivering high-quality, well-documented products.

  

The **Embedded Software Engineer** will:

* Perform full life cycle development of embedded software for spacecraft flight and ground systems, including requirements analysis, architecture, detailed design, coding, integration, test, verification, deployment, and operational support
* Develop, refine, and maintain software requirements derived from system and subsystem requirements, with bi-directional traceability through design, implementation, and verification
* Design and implement embedded C/C++ flight and ground software for functions such as subsystem monitoring and control, command and data handling, telemetry and commanding, and fault detection, isolation, and recovery
* Develop device drivers and hardware interfaces to flight and ground electronics, including sensors, ADCs, and serial and bus interfaces (e.g., SPI, I2C, CAN, UART, RS-422)
* Develop software using Core Flight System (cFS) where possible and applicable
* Collaborate with hardware and electronics design engineers on hardware/software interface definition, board bring-up, integration, and troubleshooting using lab equipment such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and JTAG debuggers
* Develop and execute unit, integration, and system-level tests, including simulation-based and hardware-in-the-loop testing; develop test automation, analyze results, and identify, debug, and resolve defects
* Author software life cycle documentation scaled to project needs, such as software management and development plans, interface control documents, design descriptions, test plans, procedures, and reports, and version description documents
* Ensure adherence to JSC standard software process practices and tailor NASA NPR 7150.2 requirements to the software classification and project scope
* Support software safety activities for safety-critical software in accordance with NASA-STD-8739.8, including software hazard analysis support and implementation of safety-related requirements
* Apply configuration management, defect tracking, static analysis, and code coverage practices to maintain software quality and traceability
* Support hardware/software integration and qualification testing, including test setup, data collection, and data analysis
* Participate as a key member of project teams, collaborating with systems engineers, hardware designers, and internal or outsourced development partners across multiple NASA programs and projects to deliver reliable, cost-effective, and high-quality solutions
* Lead or contribute to the resolution of complex technical issues, facilitating effective team decision-making
* Perform technical peer review of flight, ground system, and development software as well as the associated requirements and verification/validation plans
Perform other duties as assigned  

  
  

### **Requirements**

**Requisition Qualifications**

*This position has been posted at multiple levels. Depending on the candidate's experience, requirements, and business needs, we reserve the right to consider candidates at any level for which this position has been advertised.*

* EN2 Typically requires a bachelor's degree in Engineering and a minimum of 2- 5 years of experience in the field or in a related area.
* Must be a U.S. Citizen and must be able to complete a U.S. government background investigation
* Bachelor’s degree in Software, Computer, Electrical or Systems Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline
* Proficiency with the full embedded software life cycle, including requirements, design, implementation, testing, deployment, and operational support
* Proficiency in C and/or C++ for embedded systems
* Proficiency with scripting languages such as Python
* Experience with firmware development, embedded software, and hardware/software integration on microcontroller or embedded processor platforms
* Experience developing device drivers and interfacing with hardware using common serial and bus protocols
* Experience with software testing and verification, including unit and integration testing of embedded software
* Experience debugging

jobs.title: Senior System Software Engineer - Networking
jobs.description:
NVIDIA Networking is seeking an exceptional candidate to work with world-class technologies in the domains of High-Speed Communication and Virtualization for our most advanced markets and customers. Our products encompass Ethernet and InfiniBand protocols, delivering a wide range of cutting-edge networking, virtualization, and security services for cloud, complex compute, and AI workloads. As a Networking Software Engineer, you will play a crucial role in delivering high quality customer solutions for advanced networking use cases.

**What you’ll be doing:**

* Lead and own test strategies for advanced networking use cases end-to-end, collaborating with software developers, network engineers, architects, customer solutions engineers, and product managers to translate customer requirements into comprehensive verification plans.
* Design and execute functional, integration, regression, and performance test campaigns for software applications, firmware, tools, and networking protocols — driving coverage decisions and sign-off criteria.
* Architect and maintain test automation frameworks and infrastructure using Python and Bash, raising the quality bar for the team’s CI/CD pipeline and test reliability.
* Triage, root-cause, and drive resolution of complex software defects across multiple subsystems, working across team boundaries when needed.
* Lead release quality activities — own release indicators, track risk, and communicate readiness to stakeholders across engineering and product management.
* Mentor junior engineers through code reviews, providing constructive feedback and establishing best practices to improve code quality and maintainability.
Evaluate and improve test processes, methodologies, and tooling — proposing and driving adoption of improvements that increase team efficiency.  

  

**What we need to see:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* 5+ years of familiarity with Linux datacenter network engineering along with 1+ years of exposure to and comprehension of standard practices in software development.
* Familiarity with Linux datacenter network engineering along with exposure to and comprehension of standard practices in software development.
* Strong proficiency in Python/Bash scripting languages.In-depth knowledge of Linux operating systems, command-line tools and computer networking.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to debug and isolate software defects.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively both independently and collaboratively within a team environment.
Outstanding attention to details and a dedication to delivering top-quality software solutions.  

  

**Ways to stand out from the crowd:**

* Experience with network equipment (switches, network Cards) and understanding of network protocols (e.g., TCP/IP, Ethernet, RDMA).
* Experience with Linux Virtualization (KVM/QEMU), OVS, and network encapsulation technologies.
* Familiarity with Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines and tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD).
* Background with performance testing and analysis tools (e.g., wireshark, tcpdump, perftest, iperf).
Experience with system/network/CPU performance tuning in Linux OS environment.  

  

With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, we are widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us and, due to unprecedented growth, our best-in-class engineering teams are rapidly growing. If you're a creative and autonomous engineer with a real passion for technology, we want to hear from you!

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary ranges for this position are:
  
152,000 USD – 241,500 USD for Level 3; and 184,000 USD – 287,500 USD for Level 4.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits .

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 7, 2026.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

jobs.description:
**Position Summary**

Our client is seeking an experienced Senior Controls / Systems Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in Mitsubishi PLC programming and industrial automation systems, particularly in automotive manufacturing environments.

The successful candidate will be responsible for control system design, PLC/HMI programming, troubleshooting, commissioning, and technical support for automated manufacturing equipment and production lines.

Develop and modify Mitsubishi PLC programs using GX Works2 and/or GX Works3.

Develop, configure, and troubleshoot Mitsubishi GOT/HMI applications.

Interpret and review electrical drawings, control schematics, I/O lists, and equipment specifications.

Integrate PLCs with sensors, drives, safety devices, barcode readers, vision systems, and other industrial equipment.

Configure and troubleshoot industrial communication networks, including CC-Link, Ethernet-based industrial networks, and DeviceNet.

Strong ability to read, interpret, and troubleshoot electrical schematics, control wiring, and PLC I/O systems.

Working knowledge of industrial communication networks, particularly CC-Link and industrial Ethernet.

Ability to independently troubleshoot and resolve complex controls-related problems.

Experience communicating directly with customers regarding technical requirements and engineering issues.

Ability to manage assigned engineering activities with minimal supervision.

Strong problem-solving, organizational, and technical communication skills.

Ability to collaborate effectively with engineers and technical teams across different locations and countries.

Education

Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, Mechatronics, Automation Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.

Travel & Work Requirements

Ability and willingness to travel domestically and internationally, including Japan and China, as required by project assignments.

jobs.title: Robotics Hardware Engineer, Data Center Robotics
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensures our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we're looking for talented people who want to help.  
  
You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  
  
Within AIS, the DC Robotics team is driving game changing and rapid innovation used by AWS globally. Our products will fundamentally change our data centers, providing operational efficiencies and financial benefits that are critical to the success of AWS and its millions of customers. Our engineers solve challenging technology problems and take big bets on new concepts, enabling AWS services to continue to revolutionize the industry. This role provides the opportunity to be a technical lead driving the innovations being developed and deployed in the next generation data centers.  
  
AWS is seeking a Hardware Engineer to design, prototype, and bring to production the mechanical and thermal systems that enable robots to operate reliably in our data centers. You will own hardware from early-stage concept sketches and CAD models through FEA/CFD validation, prototype builds, manufacturing engagement, and production ramp. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable running a CFD simulation on a cooling manifold as they are on the shop floor reviewing first articles with a supplier. This role closely collaborates with robotics software engineers, electrical engineers, and ML engineers to ensure that mechanical designs meet sensor mounting requirements, thermal budgets, serviceability targets, and the harsh realities of a data center environment. You will be the bridge between design intent and manufactured reality — championing DFM/DFA throughout the development cycle and driving continuous improvement once hardware is in the field.  
  
As Amazon has a global presence, intermittent travel will be necessary and should be expected to be approximately 30% to AWS offices, data centers, suppliers, vendors, and product validation tests. While most travel will be domestic, some international travel may be required.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Lead the effective and efficient delivery of engineering efforts from product development through design, test and validation, to at scale deployment
* Apply demonstrated analytical and quantitative skills; use hard data and metrics to back up assumptions and develop business cases
* Effectively interact and collaborate with customers, project sponsors, engineers, and multiple internal teams to define and deliver complex solutions
* Proactively recognize and drive opportunities to simplify processes
* Drive effective teamwork, communication, collaboration, and commitment across multiple disparate groups with competing priorities
* Anticipate bottlenecks, provide escalation management, make trade-offs, and balance business needs with technical constraints
* Identify, assess, track, and mitigate issues and risks at multiple levels
* Create, maintain, and disseminate program information to stakeholders

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
\*Diverse Experiences\*  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  
  
\*Work/Life Balance\*  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  
  
\*Mentorship and Career Growth\*  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

jobs.title: Senior Silicon Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
At Atom Computing, we build quantum computers using arrays of optically trapped neutral atoms that will empower customers to achieve unprecedented computational breakthroughs. Join a world-class team of scientists, engineers, and business professionals to advance the state-of-the-art in quantum computing.

We are seeking a Senior Silicon Systems Engineer to bridge the gap between custom silicon and highly complex hardware integration within Atom’s research and product development programs. This role would be responsible for defining system requirements, architecture design, and system level testing across the chip, PCBs, and auxiliary hardware subsystems.

The ideal candidate can translate requirements into a coherent system architecture and has experience applying systems engineering best practices to emerging technologies.

### **Job Responsibilities**

### **Architecture & Design Integration**

* Develop and document system architecture, including subsystem interactions
* Produce system-level design documentation and interface control documents (ICDs), including the chip–PCB–controller boundaries
* Lead chip-level system specs with ASIC designers, analyzing trade-offs across silicon, PCB, and software

### **System Definition & Requirements Management**

* Develop specifications for ASICs, PCBs, controllers, and supporting hardware based on research goals maintaining clear traceability to system-level requirements.
* Work with engineers to translate measured performance, limitations, and operational experience into requirements for PCBs, controllers, RF/analog electronics, and auxiliary hardware.
* Manage change control processes for evolving architectures and requirements.

### **Risk Management & Technical Planning**

* Identify, quantify, and track technical risks, opportunities, and mitigations
* Engage in ASIC architectural reviews and tape-out readiness milestones, evaluating system-level implications of engineering modifications alongside silicon risks including respins, IP integration, and schedule impact.

### **Integration, Verification, and Validation (IV&V)**

* Link pre-silicon verification coverage and post-silicon bring-up and characterization results back to system-level requirements
* Plan system-level integration of the ASIC into PCBs and auxiliary hardware, including bring-up sequencing

### **Collaboration & Communication**

* Act as technical liaison between Theory, Quantum Engineering, Hardware, Software, Controls, ASIC Design and Verification, and Optical Engineering
* Support customer interactions, including government program reviews, technical interchange meetings, and milestone reporting.

### **Experience & Education**

* BS or higher in Systems Engineering, Physics, Electrical Engineering, Optical Engineering or a related field
* 5+ years of systems engineering experience in complex, multidisciplinary R&D or production environments (quantum, aerospace, defense, advanced computing, or similar)

### **Required Qualifications**

* Proven ability to lead requirements development, interface control, and V&V planning across engineering and science disciplines
* Experience with system architecture, requirements management tools, and configuration management systems
* Demonstrated experience with risk management frameworks
Experience with silicon integration  

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced degree (MS or PhD) in engineering, physics, or a related discipline
* Familiarity with quantum computing, atomic and optical (AMO) physics, or control system integration
* Experience preparing and presenting SRR/PDR/CDR artifacts
* Experience supporting government-funded research or procurement programs (DoD, DoE, DoC)

Atom Computing provides a wide variety of perks and benefits, including fully paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for our employees and their dependents. Additionally, unlimited paid time off, 401K company matching, short- and long-term disability, FSA, dependent care benefits, and life insurance. We also offer drinks, snacks, and catered team lunches in our offices, every day!

The base salary range for this position is between $140,000 - $160,000, commensurate with experience. In addition to salary, we offer an annual bonus and equity in the company.

Based in southwest Austin, **Texas Research Institute Austin (TRI Austin)** is an established research and development company with more than 45 years of experience delivering innovative contract R&D solutions. Our team of approximately 40 employees specializes in advanced materials development, sensor technologies, and materials testing.

To learn more about our work and capabilities, visit https://tri-austin.com/

**Position Overview**

TRI Austin is seeking a **Software Engineer** to support the development and improvement of software tools used to process, analyze, and manage complex scientific and engineering data.

In this role, you will collaborate with other software developers to enhance our existing internally developed engineering codebase, primarily written in Python, C, and C++. Much of your work will focus on improving code usability, maintainability, and deployment while supporting the software needs of ongoing research and engineering projects.

* Ability to develop and support applications in both Windows and Linux environments

* Works with customers and vendors to address technical and obsolescence issues.

* Works with team to assist in completing supplier surveys and answer customer audit findings.
* Collaborates with staff to identify and meet customer delivery and quality needs.
* Participates in continuous improvement projects such as redesign of customer product and internal process improvement to increase efficiency and quality.
* Participates in on-going training on production processes, procedures, and competencies.
* Ensures housekeeping is done on a daily and nightly basis.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical, electronic engineering or related required.
* 1 year of manufacturing or design engineering with project management skills and technical application required, 3 years preferred.
* Technical background and a working knowledge of electronic components and equipment.
* Advanced computer knowledge.
* AutoCAD; 2D & 3D programs similar to “Inventor”.
* Ability to read and understand customer supplied drawings in various formats – (CAD style) in order to identify parts, construction, etc.
* Microsoft Office products focusing in Word, Excel and Access.

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Manager - DAM Platform Engineering
jobs.description:
Overview:

**ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.**

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.

Responsibilities:

**THE ROLE:**

AMD is seeking a hands-on Digital Marketing Manager focused on DAM Platform Engineering to design, configure, and extend AMD Amplify, our enterprise digital asset management platform powered by Orange Logic. Embedded within the DAM team, this role owns technical implementation from requirements and solution design through configuration, testing, production release, and ongoing optimization. The role builds advanced configurations, workflow automations, API integrations, and reusable interface configurations.

**THE PERSON:**

You bring independent troubleshooting skills and disciplined change management practices to deliver reliable, maintainable solutions for content discovery, governance, and distribution. You can translate complex business requirements into technical solutions, manage competing priorities, and communicate implementation decisions clearly.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

*Orange Logic Configuration and Solution Design:*

* Configure Orange Logic metadata schemas, record relationships, taxonomies, security profiles, permissions, and asset lifecycle rules using authorized administrative and backend tools.
* Translate business requirements into technical specifications, configuration designs, dependency assessments, and acceptance criteria; evaluate implementation feasibility and tradeoffs.
* Configure conditional logic, metadata validation, search filters, navigation, and personalized views to support different audiences and access requirements.
* Build and maintain CMS pages, Guides, Spaces, templates, and reusable HTML/CSS components that meet accessibility, brand, and platform standards.

*Workflow Automation and API Integrations:*

* Build event-driven workflows, conditional actions, approval routing, and automations for content intake, metadata enrichment, localization, and distribution.
* Configure REST API calls, webhooks, and JSON data mappings to connect Amplify with other systems; implement authentication, error handling, and retry behavior appropriate to each integration.
* Develop JavaScript or Python utilities for API interactions, bulk metadata updates, data validation, and repetitive operational tasks.
* Validate asset identifiers, metadata mappings, and lifecycle changes across connected systems; troubleshoot synchronization failures and data inconsistencies.

*Testing, Troubleshooting, and Release Management:*

* Diagnose configuration, workflow, permission, and integration defects using application logs, API responses, browser developer tools, and reproducible test cases.
* Create and execute functional, regression, and permission tests; coordinate user acceptance testing and resolve defects before release.
* Manage configuration changes through testing and production release, documenting dependencies, deployment steps, rollback procedures, and post-release validation.
* Assess vendor upgrades for configuration and integration compatibility; investigate performance issues and implement fixes with AMD IT and Orange Logic.

*Technical Collaboration and Delivery:*

* Serve as the DAM team's embedded technical resource for solution design, implementation estimates, dependencies, and hands-on delivery of platform enhancements.
* Partner with DAM governance owners, marketing teams, IT, security, and Orange Logic to define implementation standards and resolve technical constraints.
* Maintain configuration inventories, integration mappings, technical documentation, and support runbooks; transfer knowledge to administrators and support teams.
* Prioritize the technical backlog with program leadership and measure delivery cycle time, automation impact, platform reliability, and search effectiveness.

**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:**

* Extensive experience in enterprise application implementation, platform configuration, technical consulting, or solutions engineering, including hands-on delivery in production environments.
* Hands-on Orange Logic implementation experience and advanced administrative configuration experience across metadata, permissions, workflows, search, and CMS capabilities.
* Demonstrated ability to independently design, configure, test, and troubleshoot complex platform solutions and explain their dependencies and limitations.
* Experience implementing and troubleshooting REST APIs, JSON payloads, webhooks, authentication, and data mappings using Postman or equivalent tools.
* Proficiency in HTML/CSS and working knowledge of JavaScript or Python for integrations, scripting, and automation.
* Experience with regression testing, controlled releases, root cause analysis, and technical documentation for enterprise applications.
* Ability to translate complex business requirements into technical solutions, manage competing priorities, and communicate implementation decisions clearly.

**ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Information Science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience with demonstrated technical implementation impact.

**This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.**

**Bring your curiosity and determination to make a positive impact on the future of transport, and we’ll help you go all the way.**

**Who are we looking for?**

We’re looking for a **Project Controls Engineer** to support transportation projects across roadway, transit and aviation. You’ll bring together scheduling, cost controls and construction-phase knowledge to give our project teams clear insight into project performance.

You’ll work alongside project managers, engineers and construction professionals, applying your technical experience to complex infrastructure assignments. The role combines detailed project controls work with opportunities to spend time in the field and see how projects are progressing firsthand.

**Working with an energetic and high-performing team, you will:**

* Develop project baseline schedules and perform schedule reviews, time impact analyses and cost impact analyses.
* Review construction contractor baseline schedules and monthly updates, providing clear technical recommendations.
* Perform critical path method (CPM) schedule analyses to identify, measure and report schedule performance.
* Develop and maintain monthly technical project monitoring reports.
* Review Time Impact Analysis (TIA) claims and develop alternative analyses, recommendations and negotiation positions related to schedule and cost claims.
* Visit construction sites periodically to observe and document project schedule performance.
* Develop Engineer’s Estimates and Independent Cost Estimates, including quantity take-offs and unit pricing.
* Support project managers with cost analysis, cost tracking, earned value management and change-management cost risk assessments.
* Perform inspection activities as part of construction-phase services.
* Support construction administration through reviews of requests for information (RFIs), submittals and change orders.
Contribute to other assignments and special projects based on project needs.  

**What you will bring to the team:**

* Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering, construction management or a related field.
* At least 5 years of relevant US experience in project controls, construction management and design supporting large-scale infrastructure projects.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary project teams.
* Experience managing competing priorities while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
* Demonstrated project and time management skills.
* Experience with scheduling, cost estimating or cost-management software such as Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, RSMeans and Bluebeam.
* Transportation project experience in cost estimating and scheduling is preferred.
* Professional Engineer (PE) licence in Texas Preferred
* Relevant certification through the Project Management Institute (PMI) or Association for the Advancement of Cost Engineering (AACE) Preferred
* TxDOT precertifications related to scheduling, estimating or construction Preferred

This role requires up to 20% travel.

jobs.title: Power Electronics Engineer
jobs.description:
Power Electronics Engineer Position at Tri Technology, Inc.

**Location:** Orem, Utah

**Schedule:** Full-Time | On-Site | Monday–Friday

Join an exciting, growing engineering company passionate about creating cutting-edge technology and bringing innovative products to life. If you're an experienced Power Electronics Engineer, a natural problem-solver, and a self-starter who enjoys tackling challenging designs in a collaborative, creative environment, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

We're seeking a talented and experienced **Power Electronics Engineer** to play a key role in designing, developing, and bringing innovative electronic products from concept to production for our clients.

In this hands-on position, you'll design and develop power electronics systems, including inverters, DC/DC converters, and isolated switched-mode power supplies (SMPS), with a focus on power conversion applications in the 1–20 kW range.

We're looking for a versatile, resourceful engineer with strong electrical engineering fundamentals who can independently take ownership of complex designs, solve technical challenges, and drive projects forward without relying on a large supporting engineering team.

This role offers opportunities for creativity, technical ownership, and professional growth while working on a diverse range of exciting products and technologies.

**This is a full-time, on-site position at our Orem, Utah facility, Monday through Friday. Applicants must currently reside in Utah.**

* **Independent Product Development:** Take ownership of electrical designs from initial requirements and concept development through prototyping, testing, refinement, and production readiness.
* **Analysis & Component Selection:** Perform circuit analysis, design calculations, simulations, and component selection to optimize performance, efficiency, reliability, and cost.
* **Prototyping & Testing:** Build, test, troubleshoot, and refine electronic prototypes using appropriate laboratory equipment and engineering methods.
* **Technical Problem-Solving:** Identify and resolve complex electrical design challenges, evaluate engineering tradeoffs, and develop practical, reliable solutions.
* **Cross-Disciplinary Collaboration:** Work with mechanical engineers, firmware developers, and other team members to integrate electrical designs into complete, functional products.
* **Client Collaboration:** Participate in technical discussions with clients, help define engineering requirements, communicate design decisions, and support product development efforts.
* **Documentation & Manufacturing Support:** Develop and maintain schematics, PCB design files, BOMs, test procedures, and other documentation necessary for prototyping and manufacturing.

What We're Looking For

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a closely related field, or equivalent demonstrated engineering expertise.
* 3–5+ years of professional experience in electrical engineering design, with significant hands-on experience in power electronics.

* Strong electrical circuit design skills, including component selection, circuit analysis, and PCB development.
* Experience designing and troubleshooting power electronics hardware, including power stages, gate drivers, control circuits, and protection systems.
* Strong understanding of analog and digital electronics, electrical engineering principles, and power system performance.
* Hands-on experience with oscilloscopes, power analyzers, electronic loads, multimeters, and other electronic testing equipment.
* Ability to independently manage complex electrical engineering tasks, troubleshoot challenges, and take designs from concept to functional prototypes.
* Familiarity with PCB manufacturing, assembly processes, and design for manufacturability.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues and clients.
* Self-motivated, resourceful, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a small, multidisciplinary engineering team.

Additional Experience We'd Value

* Experience with embedded systems, microcontrollers, and firmware integration.
* Experience with battery management, charging systems, and energy storage applications.
* Familiarity with high-frequency transformer and inductor design.
* Experience with motor control, three-phase power systems, or bidirectional power conversion.
* Knowledge of EMI/EMC considerations, thermal management, electrical safety, and relevant industry standards.
* Experience supporting product certification, manufacturing, and production.
* Broad electrical engineering experience beyond power electronics, including analog and digital circuit design.

What We Offer

* Competitive compensation based on experience and qualifications.
* Opportunities for professional development and technical leadership.
* The chance to work on a diverse range of innovative products and technologies.
* A collaborative, creative work environment where your ideas and contributions make a meaningful impact.
* Opportunities to participate in the full product development proce

jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer (Sentinel Future Capabilities Requirements)
jobs.description:
Overview:

Systems Planning and Analysis, Inc. (SPA) delivers high-impact, technical solutions to complex national security issues. With over 50 years of business expertise and consistent growth, we are known for continuous innovation for our government customers, in both the US and abroad. Our exceptionally talented team is highly collaborative in spirit and practice, producing *Results that Matter*. Come work with the best! We offer opportunity, unique challenges, and clear-sighted commitment to the mission. SPA: Objective. Responsive. Trusted.

The Strategic Division (SD) supports high-reliability organizations including Navy Strategic Systems Programs (SSP), Air Force Nuclear Weapons Center, and the Department of Energy (DOE), among others. Our support across our client base is expanding rapidly and encompasses important services, such as data analytics and visualization, threat analysis, risk management, modeling and simulation, cost estimating, earned value management, program management, system engineering, independent evaluation, and High Consequence Event prevention.

The Sentinel Intercontinental Ballistic Missile Group (SIG) supports the Air Force Nuclear Weapons Center in the acquisition of the LGM-35A Sentinel (GBSD) ICBM weapon system. SIG delivers program management, systems engineering, and subject matter expertise to ensure on-time delivery of a safe, secure, and reliable strategic nuclear weapon system. SIG is conducting an immediate hire for a Sentinel Future Capabilities Requirements Senior Systems Engineer.

Responsibilities:

This new ICBM program will design, develop, produce, and deploy new payload system suites (reentry vehicles and/or countermeasures). The key payload attributes include enhancements in accuracy, lethality, and ICBM Reentry System/Reentry Vehicle (RS/RV) interoperable operations. Program activities also include the employment of digital acquisitions through the application of digital engineering, agile software development, and open systems architectures.  
  
Senior Systems Engineer responsibilities include:

* Provide technical advice to Government leaders and engineers.
* Support requirements development, analysis of alternatives, verification and validation activities, and milestone preparation.
* Prepare/review engineering analysis reports and key acquisition documents, including RFP packages.
* Participate in technical interchange meetings, design reviews, program management reviews, certification working groups, and other technical meetings, as required.

The Senior Systems Engineer supports the Program Manager in the execution of program duties. The role provides highly technical expertise and guidance in solving complex hardware/software engineering problems. Additionally, this position provides technical leadership across all phases of hardware/software design analysis, development, integration, and implementation, and requires a candidate capable of determining the appropriate use of technologies to solve engineering problems.

Qualifications:

**Required Qualifications:**

* Ability to work at Hill AFB in Utah, full-time, 5 days per week.
* Active Secret with the ability to obtain a TS/SCI clearance.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or related technical discipline with 7+ years of Aerospace or Mechanical Engineering experience OR Master’s degree in engineering or related technical discipline with 5+ years of Aerospace or Mechanical Engineering experience.
* 3+ years of progressive responsibility in providing technical leadership.

**Desired Qualifications:**

* Experience as an engineer on a missile system or complex weapon system in an acquisition environment (especially ACAT I program or ICBM-related experience)
