jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend
jobs.description:
### **About Takt**

Takt is a warehouse intelligence platform that unifies labor, automation, and robotics data so 3PLs, retailers, and e-commerce companies can run more efficient operations. Warehouses generate enormous amounts of data and most of it never reaches the people doing the work. We build the software that closes that gap, giving supervisors and frontline employees the information they need, when they need it, on the floor where decisions actually get made. Our software runs every shift, every day, in real facilities for leading brands including Macy’s, Target, Stitch Fix, Flexport, ODW Logistics, and CarParts.com.

### **About the Role**

We’re hiring a senior backend engineer to design and build the distributed systems at the core of the Takt platform. Warehouses produce large, fast-moving datasets from labor systems, automation, and robotics, and our backend turns that stream into the real-time operational views our customers run their shifts on. Our services are written in Go, Python, and Node.js and run on Google Kubernetes Engine across multiple regions. You’ll work across all three, picking the one that fits the problem.

This is a senior role with real architectural ownership. Our engineering team is small and works together to solve problems; you’ll work directly with our CTO and Director of Engineering, shape how the platform scales, and mentor other engineers as the team grows. Security is top of mind in everything we build: our customers trust us with operational data from their facilities, and we design for that trust from the first line of code.

### **What You’ll Do**

* Design, build, and operate scalable backend services in Go, Python, and Node.js that power the Takt platform.
* Build integrations that bring in data from warehouse management, labor, automation, and robotics systems, and keep them reliable when upstream systems change or fail.
* Deploy and run services on Google Kubernetes Engine across multi-region environments, designing for availability, failover, and data locality.
* Model, store, and query data at scale with Google Cloud Spanner and Google BigQuery, working with large operational datasets from real warehouse systems.
* Design APIs and data pipelines that serve real-time views to web, TV, kiosk, and mobile experiences on the floor.
* Build with security top of mind: least-privilege access, safe data handling, and designs that hold up in SOC 2 and GDPR audits.
* Own services end to end, from design and documentation through deployment, monitoring, and incident follow-through.
* Mentor other engineers through design reviews, code review, and pairing as the team grows.

### **How We Build**

We’re an AI-forward engineering team. Every engineer gets a monthly AI tools budget for Claude, Cursor, and whatever else makes you better, and we expect you to use it. AI-assisted development isn’t a shortcut here; it’s how we work. As a senior engineer, you’ll help set the standard for using these tools well: reviewing generated code critically, understanding what ships under your name, and building guardrails so the whole team can move fast safely.

### **What We’re Looking For**

* 5+ years of professional backend engineering experience, or equivalent practical experience.
* Deep, hands-on experience building production services in at least one of Go, Python, or Node.js (TypeScript), and the willingness to work across all three.
* A track record of designing and operating scalable distributed systems, and reasoning clearly about consistency, latency, and failure modes.
* Experience running services on Kubernetes in a cloud environment, ideally GKE on Google Cloud.
* Strong SQL skills: writing, optimizing, and debugging queries against large production datasets is a must.
* Experience with large datasets and the databases that serve them; Spanner and BigQuery experience is a strong plus, as is depth in comparable systems.
* A security mindset applied by default: least privilege, safe handling of customer data, and pragmatic risk trade-offs.
* Ownership and drive: you take ambiguity and run with it, communicate clearly, and leave systems better documented than you found them.

### **Nice to Have**

* Production experience in more than one of Go, Python, and Node.js.
* Experience with multi-region architectures and the trade-offs of replication, failover, and data residency.
* Experience with streaming or batch data pipelines, such as Dataflow.
* Familiarity with Terraform, GitHub Actions, and infrastructure as code.
* Prior startup experience, or comfort owning a domain rather than a slice of one.
* Curiosity about logistics, warehousing, or how physical operations actually run.

### **Compensation & Benefits**

The base salary range for this role is $150,000 – $180,000, depending on experience. Benefits include:

* Health, dental, and vision insurance.
* 401(k) with employer match.
* Unlimited PTO.
* A monthly AI tools budget for every engineer.
* A top-of-the-line MacBook Pro, dual 4K monitors, and your choice of keyboard and mouse at your desk in the office.

### **Interview Process**

Two phone screens, followed by an onsite in our Reston office with four to five interviews. We’ll keep you informed at every step; no black holes.

### **Location**

Takt is based in Reston, VA, with our office located next to the Wiehle-Reston East Metro station on the Silver Line. We’re looking for local candidates who can be in the office at least four days a week; we build together.

Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

### **Our Commitment**

Ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace where we learn from each other is core to Takt’s values. We welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and perspectives. We are an equal opportunity employer and a supportive place to work. Takt will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the interview process, perform

jobs.title: Ground Systems Engineer II - Fluids
jobs.description:
**ABOUT ROCKET LAB**

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity's reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

**NEUTRON**

Neutron is a medium lift launch vehicle capable of delivering the mega constellations of tomorrow, high assurance payloads, and human spaceflight. As a highly reusable launch platform, Neutron will deliver a highly cost-effective and reliable launch solution leveraging Rocket Lab's proven execution history with the Electron program. If you're interested in joining a high performing team, pushing the boundaries with a clean sheet development of re-usable liquid launch vehicle, this is your opportunity!

**GROUND SYSTEMS ENGINEER II – FLUIDS**

As a Ground Systems Engineer II – Fluids, you will be the subject matter expert and technical decision-maker, responsible for design, build, and activation activities associated with critical systems that directly support the Neutron Launch Vehicle. You'll work on systems that operate in harsh and hazardous environments, ensuring that they meet the rigorous demands of space exploration.

This role is hands-on and collaborative, requiring you to work closely with suppliers, technicians, and cross-functional teams to deliver world-class solutions. From concept to commissioning, you will play a key role in ensuring Rocket Lab's Ground Systems are reliable, efficient, and ready to support our missions.

**WHAT YOU'LL GET TO DO:**

* Design of fluid systems including cryogenics, hydraulics, fuels, high pressure gases and HVAC.
* 2D and 3D modelling through the use of CAD software, specifically NX.
* System sizing and analysis by hand calculation and numerical methods
* Generate & maintain schematics of fluid/process systems e.g. P&IDs, connection diagrams.
* Component selection, development, and maintenance of BOMs
* Interact with suppliers and internal teams
* Support certification of launch pad fluid systems
* Support maintenance program development

**YOU'LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS AS A LEVEL II ENGINEER:**

* ABET accredited Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent.
* Strong engineering fundamentals and ability to perform required design calculations with limited guidance from senior level engineers.
* 2+ years of experience in directly applicable design, testing, and/or operations within the aerospace or industrial sectors.
* Knowledge of fluid systems, sizing calculations, and P&IDs.
* Proficiency in CAD software (NX, Solidworks)

**THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:**

* Advanced Degree in Mechanical Engineering or Equivalent
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, autonomous environment
* Professional Engineer License
* Experience with Piping systems (large or small)
* Experience with launch pad systems, engine test stand, or other similar industry experience
* Experience with rocket or payload conditioning systems
* Experience with equipment for use with Oxygen
* Experience with Nodal Analysis Tools (e.g. GFSSP, AFT)
* Experience with pipe stress software (e.g. Ceasar II)
* Experience with ASME, ASTM, NFPA, and/or NASA ground system standards would be an asset

***This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas.***

**WHAT TO EXPECT**

We're on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that's not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other's backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.

jobs.title: Software Engineer V
jobs.description:
Description:

We are seeking a Principal Software Engineer to join our Navy Programs team. In this role, you will serve as the technical authority for the architecture, development, integration, and fielding of mission-critical software systems supporting U.S. Navy submarines, aircraft carriers, and shore-based platforms. You will set technical direction across multiple teams while remaining hands-on in design, code, and the resolution of the hardest integration problems.

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in modern C++ on Linux, a record of architecting distributed systems that shipped and were sustained in the field, and the judgment to make long-term technical decisions that balance mission needs, cost, schedule, and risk. This position is well suited for an engineer with twelve or more years of experience who has led technical efforts across multiple teams, can represent the program's technical position to Navy customers and partners, and invests in growing the engineers around them. The work includes defining and driving the modernization of legacy applications onto a Kubernetes-based platform, and directly supports U.S. Navy submarine combat systems.

This is a full-time position based in Manassas, VA. The position requires U.S. citizenship and an active DoD Secret Clearance. The annual base salary is $179,000 – $209,000, with final compensation based on experience and skills.

In addition to a competitive base salary, this position is eligible for a sign-on bonus and a comprehensive benefits package including healthcare benefits (medical, dental, and vision), Flexible Spending Accounts, Life Insurance, 401(k) plan with matching company contributions, paid time off, holidays, and tuition and training reimbursement.

Requirements:

You’ll be responsible for:

* Serving as technical authority for the software architecture of U.S. Navy submarine combat systems, owning key design decisions and the rationale behind them.
* Defining the technical roadmap for modernizing legacy C++, Java, and Electron applications onto a Kubernetes-based platform, including the migration strategy, sequencing, and risk mitigation.
* Establishing architecture, interface, and coding standards across multiple development teams, and making sure designs stay consistent across application, middleware, and deployment layers.
* Leading the design of distributed, real-time, and service-oriented systems using gRPC, Protocol Buffers, DDS, AMQP, and data-driven interface models.
* Personally resolving the program's most complex software, concurrency, performance, networking, and integration problems in lab and Navy platform environments.
* Representing the program's technical position to Navy customers, prime contractors, and partner organizations in design reviews, technical interchange meetings, and integration events.
* Supporting program leadership with technical estimates, basis-of-estimate development, risk assessments, and proposal and capture activities.
* Mentoring technical leads and senior engineers, shaping the team's engineering culture, and helping identify and develop future technical leaders.

Required Skills:

* U.S. citizenship and an active DoD Secret clearance at time of hire.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, plus 12+ years of progressively responsible professional software development experience.
* Demonstrated experience as the lead architect or technical authority for a complex software system, across multiple teams or releases.
* Advanced proficiency in modern C++ (C++11 and newer), including concurrency, asynchronous design, memory management, and performance analysis.
* Deep Linux experience, preferably with Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) or a derivative.
* Proven experience architecting and troubleshooting distributed, event-driven, or real-time systems in production or fielded environments.
* Hands-on experience with gRPC, Protocol Buffers, and messaging middleware such as DDS or AMQP.
* Experience defining test strategy and CI/CD practices for a multi-team software program.
* Experience translating system requirements and interface definitions into software architecture, and defending design decisions in formal technical reviews.
* Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, including briefing technical strategy and risk to senior leadership and government customers.

Preferred Skills:

* Experience architecting or migrating applications onto Kubernetes, including operators, custom controllers, or Helm-based deployment.
* Experience with RTI Connext DDS or other real-time publish-subscribe middleware on mission-critical systems.
* Experience integrating software with tactical, combat, weapon-control, or other mission-critical Navy systems.
* Experience with observability architecture using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Loki.
* Experience supporting proposals, technical volumes, or basis-of-estimate development for DoD programs.
* Experience with DevSecOps, secure software development practices, and supporting system accreditation.
* Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

jobs.description:
Vantor is forging the new frontier of spatial intelligence, helping decision makers and operators navigate what’s happening now and shape what’s coming next. Vantor is a place for problem solvers, changemakers, and go-getters—where people are working together to help our customers see the world differently, and in doing so, be seen differently. Come be part of a mission, not just a job, where you can: Shape your own future, build the next big thing, and change the world.

To be eligible for this position, you must be a U.S. Citizen. This position requires an active U.S. Government security clearance, applicants who do not currently hold the required clearance will not be eligible for consideration. Employment for cleared roles is contingent upon verification of clearance status.

*Export Control/ITAR:* Certain roles may be subject to U.S. export control laws, requiring U.S. person status as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3).

**Please review the job details below.**

This position requires an active U.S. Government Security Clearance at the **TS/SCI** level.

We are seeking a Senior AI/ML Software Engineer to integrate secure chatbot and AI assistant capabilities into existing geospatial intelligence, analytics, visualization, and mission-support tools. You will help analysts discover data, navigate applications, and complete approved workflows using natural language. The role requires strong software engineering skills, practical LLM experience, and an understanding of secure, usable AI in mission environments.

  

**Responsibilities:**

* Integrate AI chatbots and assistants into existing geospatial, analytics, visualization, and mission applications.
* Build natural-language workflows for data discovery, application navigation, visualization generation, and approved actions.
* Implement LLM patterns such as prompt orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation, tool calling, and conversation context.
* Connect AI services to REST APIs, data catalogs, search platforms, knowledge graphs, geospatial services, notebooks, and dashboards.
* Develop reusable backend services and frontend components that make AI assistance simple for analysts to use.
* Enforce identity, entitlements, and data-access policies; provide citations, provenance, audit records, and clear system limitations.
* Test and evaluate AI quality, safety, latency, and usability, including protections against prompt injection, data leakage, and unauthorized actions.
Deploy and operate AI services in Kubernetes and Red Hat OpenShift, including restricted or disconnected environments, and collaborate with technical and customer teams.  

  

**Minimum Qualifications:**

Must be a U.S. Citizen with an active TS/SCI clearance (with willingness to obtain a CI poly)

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, artificial intelligence, or a related field with 8+ years of professional software engineering experience delivering production applications or services.
* Hands-on experience integrating generative AI or LLMs into production software applications using patterns such as RAG, embeddings, vector search, function calling, or agent workflows.
* Strong Python skills and experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, Java, Go, C++, or another modern language.
* Experience building REST APIs or microservices and using Git, automated testing, CI/CD, and Agile development practices.
Experience integrating enterprise data sources and applying secure identity, authorization, and data-protection controls.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience building chatbot interfaces with React, TypeScript, or comparable web frameworks and applying usability practices.
* Experience with AI orchestration frameworks, model gateways, MCP-compatible services, or agent-to-tool integration.
* Experience deploying commercial, open-source, or locally hosted LLMs in cloud, on-premises, classified, air-gapped, or disconnected environments.
* Experience with vector search, Elasticsearch, knowledge graphs, GIS, imagery, geospatial applications, or other mission-critical systems.
* Experience with AI safety controls, human-in-the-loop approvals, model monitoring, evaluation, GPU workloads, or model serving.
Experience with containers and Kubernetes; Red Hat OpenShift experience is preferred.

Through our **ISO 9001:2015** certification, we can accomplish the full range of contract services including financial, human capital, recruiting, procurement, security, and technical resources to achieve contract mission requirements. As a result, our ‘*small business – big capability’* dynamic benefits our clients through consistent communications and straight-lined workflows, ensuring our accountability to our clients for successful mission fulfillment.

In plain terms, our clients gain a team that’s on the same page to achieve and support the client’s mission. We vigorously respond to clients’ requests without additional costs, delays, or inefficiencies that are often experienced with larger, more cumbersome organizations. AO is eligible for sole source, direct awards up to $100M for DOD and up to $25M for other federal agencies, without J&A. Astraeus is the easy button for a client wishing to take advantage of the rapid, agile, and flexible sole source procurement option. Combined with the shared PMO services, Astraeus offers highly competitive labor rates to fulfill day-to-day contract operations.

The **Systems Engineer** provides on-site, 24/7/365 Tier 1 operations for Google Public Sector’s USG1 sovereign and classified cloud environments, initially supporting Google Distributed Cloud (GDC) Air-Gapped and expanding to additional sovereign infrastructure, appliances, and air-gapped products. The engineer monitors platform health, troubleshoots Linux and Kubernetes systems, executes approved runbooks, verifies network and circuit connectivity, and prepares diagnostic evidence for engineering consults. The role coordinates customer case management and communications with Customer Support Specialists and escalation review, shift continuity, and service improvements with the Senior Operations Lead. Overnight duties include frontline case response to meet service commitments.

* Partner with ML and CV feature teams (Eye Tracking, Hand Tracking, Holograms, Silent Speech, Health) to translate data collection requirements into system-level specifications
* Develop system-level requirements and allocate performance budgets across custom sensor platforms, synchronization hardware, and data infrastructure to meet ground truth quality targets
* Lead architectural trade-off analyses across competing design dimensions including data throughput, synchronization precision, calibration accuracy, latency, and cost
* Drive alignment on data systems architecture decisions across hardware, firmware, software, and operations teams through written proposals and cross-functional reviews
* Establish and maintain system integration frameworks that enable early detection of cross-subsystem risks in data collection pipelines
* Define and oversee bring-up and validation strategies for complex multi-sensor data capture platforms
* Lead systems through integration, test, and transition to Operations, ensuring production readiness and operational sustainability
* Develop long-term data systems platform roadmaps that anticipate ML/CV feature requirements and inform hardware and infrastructure decisions
* Mentor other engineers on systems architecture methodology and contribute to raising the technical bar across the data systems organization
* Demonstrate a service mindset by staying hands-on with day-to-day work and supporting tasks at all levels—no task is too small or too senior for this role

* 8+ years of experience in hardware systems architecture or systems engineering for consumer electronics, wearables, or mobile computing platforms
* Experience defining system-level requirements and allocating performance budgets across heterogeneous hardware subsystems including compute, power, thermal, and sensing

* Experience developing multi-generation hardware platform roadmaps and driving technical alignment across silicon, firmware, and mechanical engineering teams
* Experience communicating complex hardware architecture trade-offs in writing to both technical peers and non-technical leadership

jobs.title: Staff Technical Program Manager, Firmware Lifecycle and Release Management
jobs.description:
Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

**About the Role:**

Crusoe Cloud runs AI infrastructure at a scale where a single firmware or software baseline can determine whether thousands of GPUs deliver for our customers. As a Staff Technical Program Manager, you will own the end-to-end release lifecycle for versioned firmware and software baselines across our GPU fleet. That covers everything from scoping and qualification through phased rollout and production deployment. This is a builder role: you will run complex releases across Compute, Networking, Storage, Orchestration, and Operations, and you will design the release calendars, validation frameworks, and metrics that let Crusoe scale them predictably.

We’re looking for an engineer-rooted TPM who is comfortable in the white space between teams and who earns trust with engineers and vendors through technical depth and execution rigor. You’ll identify risks before they surface, drive alignment across engineering leads without direct authority, and give leadership clear, data-driven decision points. This is a full-time position.

**What You'll Be Working On:**

* **Own the Release Lifecycle End to End:** Lead versioned firmware and software baselines from scoping and definition through qualification, validation, phased rollout, and production deployment across a large GPU fleet.
* **Orchestrate Cross-Functional Releases:** Drive release programs across Compute, Networking, Storage, Orchestration, and Operations. Set entry and exit criteria, layered validation, domain sign-offs, and go/no-go decisions.
* **Lead Fleet-Wide Upgrade Campaigns:** Coordinate upgrades on live production clusters with Operations and customer-facing teams, including maintenance planning, rollback strategies, and risk mitigation.
* **Drive Security and CVE Response:** Partner with engineering leads to make fast, well-reasoned decisions on security patches and CVEs, and fold them into the release train.
* **Govern Vendor Relationships:** Work with OEMs, ODMs, and component and silicon suppliers on firmware fixes, validation timelines, and roadmaps. Escalate and resolve issues that put Crusoe’s schedule at risk.
* **Build the Machine:** Design lightweight, scalable release calendars, validation frameworks, Jira workflows, and metrics that make Crusoe’s release process predictable as the fleet grows.
* **Surface Risk and Drive Decisions:** Maintain real-time visibility into release health, map cross-team dependencies, and deliver crisp executive updates that spotlight decisions and trade-offs.
* **Improve Continuously:** Lead retrospectives after major releases and feed the learnings back into the process. Apply AI tools to improve tracking, risk detection, and communication across your programs.

**What You'll Bring to the Team:**

* **Program Leadership at Scale:** 10+ years as a Technical Program Manager in infrastructure, hardware, or platform engineering, including release or change management at fleet scale.
* **Server Firmware Expertise:** Working knowledge of the server firmware stack, including BMC, BIOS, GPU firmware and drivers, and NIC and switch firmware.
* **Influence Without Authority:** Proven experience running validation or qualification programs across many engineering teams without direct authority.
* **Risk and Dependency Management:** Ability to anticipate what will break before it does, then drive mitigation plans and rollback strategies for live production environments.
* **Process Builder’s Mindset:** Track record of creating fit-for-purpose frameworks, such as release calendars, validation gates, and metrics, rather than forcing programs into rigid templates.
* **Executive Communication:** Ability to translate complex technical status into clear, data-driven updates and decision-ready recommendations.
* **Educational Foundation:** Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.

**Bonus Points**

* Experience at a GPU cloud provider or hyperscaler managing large-scale fleets (thousands of nodes).
* A track record of driving firmware currency and compliance programs across a production fleet.
* Hands-on experience with vendor escalation management, including driving OEM/ODM and silicon partners to fix and validate firmware on tight timelines.
* Familiarity with AI accelerator platforms and the dependencies between firmware, drivers, and cluster networking.
* A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

**Benefits:**

* Competitive compensation and equity packages
* Restricted Stock Units
* Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs
* Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance
* Employer contributions to HSA account
* Paid parental leave
* Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability
* Professional development & tuition reimbursement

jobs.title: Mechatronics Engineer III
jobs.description:
***Mechatronics Engineer III - Scientific Instrumentation & Process Engineering (SIPE)***

The mission of the Allen Institute is to understand the principles that govern life, and to advance health. Our creative and multi-dimensional teams focus on answering some of the biggest questions in bioscience. We accelerate foundational research, catalyze bold ideas, develop tools and models, and openly share our science to make a broad, transformational impact on the world.

The Mechatronics Engineer III is a hands-on engineering role within the Scientific Instrumentation and Process Engineering (SIPE) team. This position designs, builds, and integrates robotic and automated systems for SIPE's custom scientific instruments, bringing together mechanical design, sensors, motion control, and software to deliver reliable, high-performance automation for neuroscience research.

The Mechatronics Engineer III works with minimal supervision and exercises independent judgment, leading defined subsystems and projects from concept through deployment. On any given week, this might mean tuning a control loop and integrating a force or vision sensor into a robot's motion routine, programming and validating tool paths for dissection automation, and updating CAD models and drawings for an end effector used in robotic wafer handling. This role works closely with the Principal System Design Engineer (robotics focus) on tissue processing and dissection automation. A successful candidate takes ownership of complex technical problems, contributes to engineering standards and documentation, and mentors less experienced team members. This role reports to the Hardware Engineering Manager.

At the Allen Institute, we believe that science is for everyone – and should be open to everyone. We are dedicated to combating biases and reducing barriers to STEM careers more broadly.

We also believe that science is better when it includes different perspectives and voices. We strive to make the Allen Institute a place where everyone feels like they belong and are empowered to do their best work in a supportive environment.

We are an equal opportunity employer and strongly encourage people from all backgrounds to apply for our open positions.

**Essential Functions**

**Robotics & Automation Integration**

* Implement, integrate, and commission robotic systems, such as robotic wafer handling to load and unload samples from imaging instruments
* Partner with the Principal System Design Engineer to develop robotic subsystems for tissue processing and dissection automation
* Program robot motion and tool paths; define, test, and validate trajectories, teach points, and coordinate frames for precision handling tasks
* Integrate sensors (e.g., force/torque, vision, encoders, proximity, limit and presence sensors) into robotic control and feedback systems
* Design, tune, and validate control loops for motors, stages, and actuators to meet positioning, speed, and repeatability requirements
* Perform kinematic and dynamic analysis, size motors and actuators, and evaluate accuracy and repeatability of motion systems
* Develop and execute calibration procedures for robots, cameras, and work cells (e.g., tool, frame, and hand-eye calibration), and verify positioning accuracy
* Develop firmware and control code for microcontrollers and motion controllers; implement communication between sensors, drives, and controllers (e.g., digital I/O, serial, CAN, EtherCAT, Modbus)
* Implement interlocks, e-stops, error handling, and recovery routines to protect samples, instruments, and operators; support safety reviews and risk assessments led by senior engineers

**Mechanical & Electrical Design and Build**

* Create parts, assemblies, and drawings in CAD (OnShape preferred) for end effectors, fixtures, mounts, and mechanisms; perform tolerance analysis and basic FEA as needed
* Specify, evaluate, and select motors, drives, actuators, sensors, controllers, and mechanical components
* Design power and signal wiring, wiring harnesses, and control enclosures; select motor drives and power supplies; develop simple circuit boards for sensor interfaces as needed
* Create and maintain bills of material (BOMs), system diagrams, and wiring schematics for assemblies and subassemblies
* Build, assemble, and debug prototypes and production instruments using the SIPE workshop (3D printing, laser cutting, hand tools, and bench electronics)

**Testing, Documentation & Collaboration**

* Work with scientists and engineers to capture requirements and translate them into specifications and test plans
* Plan and execute verification and validation testing; write reports and document processes, procedures, and SOPs
* Use source control (e.g., Git) and issue tracking to manage code, configurations, and design changes
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex hardware/software issues on deployed automated instruments with minimal guidance
* Mentor and provide technical guidance to less experienced engineers and instrument specialists
* Identify opportunities for continuous improvement and contribute to SIPE engineering standards and best practices

We combine comprehensive analysis, engineering, and program execution capabilities to deliver mission-tailored solutions that reduce lead times, lower costs, and simplify complex multi-vendor supply chains. Backed by decades of flight-proven and fielded performance, we design and build mission-critical technologies including launch systems, propulsion, payload integration solutions, UAV components, missile subsystems, and Safe & Arm systems.

In this role, you will provide technical leadership across aerospace system development efforts, guiding multidisciplinary engineering teams as they mature complex mechanical systems and structures. You will drive system architecture decisions, lead verification and validation activities, coordinate program‑wide technical efforts, and mentor less experienced engineers to ensure engineering rigor and alignment with system requirements.

* Assesses completeness of system requirements, verifies compliance, and documents results.

* Leads creation of engineering reports and presentations.

* Contributes to company engineering standards, training, and guidelines.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, or an equivalent field.

* Mastery of general aerospace engineering knowledge including structural analysis, finite element analysis (FEA), physics‑based modeling, dynamics, kinematics, advanced high‑strength materials, design, and test.

**Job Description Summary**
===========================

Systems engineering is a cross-functional engineering discipline centered on an approach, mindset, and process. All activities that consider both the business and the technical needs of the customers with the goal of providing a quality product that meets the users needs. The discipline that executes a robust process of design, creation, and optimization of systems, consisting of identification and quantification of system requirements, creation of alternate system design concepts, performance of design trade studies, selection and implementation of the best designs and verification that the design is properly integrated and executed. Process that proceeds from concept to production to operation.  
  
The Senior Architect Systems Engineer has the responsibility to design and develop photon counting CT products delivering customer workflow, feature functionality, product quality, reliability, serviceability, manufacturability, cybersecurity, regulatory, compliance, and cost. Activities include requirements development and flow down, architecture / system design and analysis, system and clinical feature development, modeling, FMEA, developing/executing system verification and validation test procedures, reliability testing, integration, data analytics, providing support to manufacturing and field issues, and managing customer clinical evaluation sites for new product programs.

**Systems Engineer - Performance Analyst**

**Why This is an Exciting Role:**

As a Systems Engineer at Boeing Intelligence & Analytics (BI&A), this position will be responsible for analyzing the performance of the Ground-based Midcourse Defense system in system-level simulations, supporting the assessment of performance capabilities and opportunities for potential system performance improvements. Efforts will include coordinating with other analysts and resident Subject Matter Experts to determine root cause of performance observations, supporting the development of analysis reports/briefings to be briefed to customers/leadership, and developing Python and Bash tools that support simulation data processing and analysis.

**Experience and Qualifications:**

To be eligible for this demanding position, the ideal candidate should demonstrate the following experience and qualifications:

**Required Education and Years of Experience:**

* Education/experience typically acquired through advanced technical education from an accredited course of study in engineering, computer science, mathematics, physics or chemistry (e.g. Bachelor) and typically 2 or more years' related work experience or an equivalent combination of technical education and experience (e.g. Masters). In the USA, ABET accreditation is the preferred, although not required, accreditation standard.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Active Secret Clearance
* Experience in systems engineering, systems analysis, or performance analysis.
* Experience applying statistical analysis, probability distributions, sampling methods, or Monte Carlo simulation techniques
* Experience reviewing system performance metrics and identifying potential root causes of performance issues
* Experience working in an aerospace, defense, or related engineering environment
* Demonstrated strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present technical information to diverse audiences
* Demonstrated organizational, collaboration, and leadership skills through professional, academic, or civic activities
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a dynamic, cross-functional environment

**Desired Qualifications:**

* Experience supporting the Ground-based Midcourse Defense program or other missile defense programs
* Experience evaluating system performance under multiple operational scenarios, architectures, or threat conditions
* Experience analyzing system quality factors, such as affordability, safety, reliability, survivability, vulnerability, susceptability, and systems integration
* Experience performing risk assessments and developing mitigation plans related to system requirements, technical performance, and customer capabilities
* Experience supporting software development, software integration, and test integration
* Experience developing, maintaining, or using modeling and simulation tools of varying fidelity to assess system performance
* Experience analyzing existing system architectures and evaluating new technologies and concepts for future system improvements
* Experience developing, refining, and documenting algorithms or algorithm capabilities for Department of Defense customers
* Experience coding or scripting in one or more of the following: MATLAB, Python, or C++
* Experience supporting interdisciplinary teams in the planning, design, development, integration, and verification of system solutions
* Familiarity with configuration, data, and workflow management for program-specific MBSE tools and processes

**Telework/Remote Availability:** Telework/Remote work currently not authorized; 100% on-site.

**Work Location(s):** Huntsville, AL

**Summary Pay Range:**

Please note that the information shown below is a general guideline only. Pay is based upon candidate experience and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.

$76,000 - $135,000

As a fully owned subsidiary of The Boeing Company, BI&A offers an optimal mix of a small company environment with exceptional opportunities supported by a large corporation.

**Standard Job Description**
----------------------------

**What We're Doing**  
Become a part of something IMPACT-ful! Ground Missile Defense (GMD) is the heart of the Missile Defense System and a key element of our nation’s defense against ballistic missile attacks.

The GMD Weapon System (GWS) processes data from multiple sensors to identify and characterize the inbound ballistic missile threat, plans the best defensive solution, and launches the intercepting missiles to negate the threat.

**Who We Are**  
Lockheed Martin is a global aerospace, defense, and security company dedicated to advancing scientific discovery and harnessing innovation to make the world a safer place. Our RMS business in Huntsville, AL is a hub of talented engineers, scientists, and professionals committed to shaping the future of defense technology. We value collaboration, excellence, and integrity in everything we do. As a part of our team, you will work alongside like-minded individuals dedicated to pushing the boundaries of what's possible.

**Why Join Us**  

* Your Health, Your Wealth, Your Life
* Our flexible schedules, competitive pay and comprehensive benefits enable you to live a healthy, fulfilling life at and outside of work.

**The Work**

This role is for a Systems Engineer to support the IFICS Data Terminal (IDT) product team on the Ground Based Mid-course Defense (GMD) Weapon System (GWS) program. In this role the candidate will perform Systems Engineering functions such as requirements decomposition, hardware fault analysis, and hardware to software interface definition as part of the IDT product team.

The GWS system provides missile defense capabilities that protect and defends the United States of America.

This team follows an Agile framework using Jira and Confluence to manage their backlog and document progress. This is not a telework/remote position.

Additional work the role may perform includes:

* Perform technical planning, system integration, verification and validation, cost and risk, and supportability and effectiveness analysis for total systems.
* Ensure the logical and systematic conversion of customer or product requirements into total systems solutions that acknowledge technical, schedule, and cost constraints.
* Perform functional analysis, timeline analysis, detail trade studies, requirements allocation and interface definition studies to translate customer requirements into hardware and software specifications.

**Standard Job Description**

Performs technical planning, system integration, verification and validation, cost and risk, and supportability and effectiveness analyses for total systems. Analyses are performed at all levels of total system product to include: concept, design, fabrication, test, installation, operation, maintenance and disposal. Ensures the logical and systematic conversion of customer or product requirements into total systems solutions that acknowledge technical, schedule, and cost constraints. Performs functional analysis, timeline analysis, detail trade studies, requirements allocation and interface definition studies to translate customer requirements into hardware and software specifications. For positions that perform IT responsibilities, use E646, Systems Engr-IT.

**Basic Qualifications**
------------------------

* General understanding of the Systems Engineering 'V' and be capable of performing engineering analysis, requirements allocation, and requirements decomposition with supervision from a senior engineer. Must also have a background in hardware to include experience with hardware to software interfaces, as well as, experience diagnosing hardware faults (fault detection and fault isolation).
* An active U.S. Government security clearance at the Secret level is required to start. Must be a US Citizen.
* Applicant must have current GWS IDT systems engineering experience

**Desired Skills**
------------------

* Prior experience working on Missile Defense programs
* Prior experience working using DOORS
* Prior experience using Atlassian Tools
* Familiar with Agile terminology and best practices
* Prior experience as a Product Owner
* Familiar with Model Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) and Cameo
* Familiar with automated software requirements testing and analysis
* Familiar with Software Containerization and Orchestration
* Familiar with DevSecOps

**Pay Information**

Full-Time Salary Range: $104900.00 - $194700.00

At Lockheed Martin, we know mission success starts with taking care of our people. Our Total Rewards program is designed to attract top talent, support your well-being, and help you grow—both professionally and personally.

The salary range for this position is as listed on the requisition. Please note that the salary information listed is a general guideline only. Lockheed Martin considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/ training, key skills as well as market(work location) and business considerations when extending an offer.

**Benefits offered:** Medical, Dental, Vision, Flexible work arrangements and schedules (e.g., 4x10), 401(k) match, Paid time off, Holidays, Parental Leave, EAP, Flexible Spending Accounts, Education Assistance, Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability.

* Annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs may be offered depending on the position. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and can vary from year to year and are tied to a range of performance metrics.

**Job Description:**
--------------------

We are seeking an expert Embedded Software / Firmware Contractor to design, implement, and optimize high-throughput multi-threaded software for embedded Linux on AMD Xilinx FPGA / MPSoC and RFSoc architectures (e.g., Zynq UltraScale+).
  
The contractor will be responsible for accelerating critical computational workloads (such as signal processing or array arithmetic) using ARM NEON SIMD instructions and interfacing custom C/C++ applications with hardware IP blocks in the FPGA logic. Scope of Work & Deliverables
  
High-Performance Multi-Threading: Architect and implement efficient C/C++ userspace applications utilizing POSIX threads (pthreads), thread isolation, CPU affinity, and lock-free synchronization routines to handle real-time streaming data on embedded Linux.
  
ARM NEON Optimization: Vectorize and optimize critical algorithmic loops using ARM NEON intrinsics and assembly to maximize SIMD throughput on ARM Cortex-A processor cores.
  
FPGA Hardware Integration: Develop robust software drivers/interfaces (e.g., Linux UIO, AXI DMA, memory-mapped registers) to exchange data between Linux software applications and custom IP blocks in the Xilinx Programmable Logic (PL).
  
Profiling & Performance Tuning: Utilize Linux profiling tools (perf, Valgrind, custom execution benchmarks) to diagnose bottlenecks, optimize cache usage, and ensure deterministic performance.
  
Technical Documentation & Code Hand-off: Deliver well-commented, productiongrade source code along with architectural notes, integration build scripts, and test procedures for internal engineering hand-off.

**Required Technical Expertise:**  
Core Programming: Expert-level C for embedded Linux environments.
  
Vector Acceleration: Hands-on proficiency with ARM NEON SIMD intrinsics and assembly-level optimization techniques.
  
Xilinx SoC Platform: Demonstrated experience with Xilinx Zynq UltraScale+ MPSoC/RFSoC platforms (PetaLinux).
  
Hardware Interfacing: Deep understanding of AXI4, PCIe, AXI DMA engines, and Linux memory management (DMA-BUF, /dev/mem, UIO).
  
Multi-Threaded Systems: Solid background in concurrent programming, memory synchronization, and real-time POSIX scheduling.
  
Tooling: Expertise with GCC/Clang cross-compilation toolchains, GDB, Vivado / Vitis, CMake, and Git.

*Candidates often screen themselves out of job applications if they do not meet all the qualifications. So, please apply if you're excited about a role at EUV Tech—we would love to see your application.*

At EUV Tech, we enable the frontiers of semiconductor manufacturing and material science through the development of world-leading extreme ultraviolet and soft x-ray instrumentation and techniques. EUV Tech stands at the forefront of the next era in advanced semiconductor manufacturing, delivering new and innovative solutions worldwide.

If you are looking to push the limits of cutting-edge technology in an impactful role with a talented team, we would love to hear from you!

The Senior Systems Engineer will refine hardware, software, and controls based on meticulously tested performance data, ensuring the reliability of integrated components in EUV Tech tools. The role extends to collaborating cross-departmentally, creating essential system level documentation and requirements packages, and contributing to complex system engineering projects that demand expertise in electrical, mechanical, physics, algorithms, and software design.

Reports to: Vice President, Product Development

###### **Your Role**

* Create system requirements documentation that will be used to drive the design and validation of new development projects.
* Install, troubleshoot, and test components and hardware.
* Refine hardware/software/controls based on tested performance.
* Test reliability of components and submodules integrated in EUV Tech tools. Generate documentation on the test results.

* Problem identification and troubleshooting of moderately difficult engineering problems in field of technical expertise, including serviceability and manufacturability.

###### **Qualifications (Required)**

* 8+ years of experience with a Bachelor of Engineering degree in Computer Science/ Electrical Engineering / Computer Engineering / Electronics / Electrical / Mechanical Engineering / Physics / Instrumentation, or equivalent.
* Ability to interpret schematics and proficiency in embedded hardware development
* Experience with mechanical, electrical of manufacturing design software, including extensive experience with complex parts and large assemblies
* Experience with revision control software (e.g., Enterprise PDM)
* Must be able to interact effectively with customers
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Excellent technical, conceptual, problem solving, and analytical skills
* Applicants should thrive in a dynamic start-up environment
* Ability to occasionally travel domestically and internationally for work

###### **Qualifications (Bonus to Have)**

* Experience in leading system architecture development, preferred.
* Experience working with multi-axis robots and motion controls
* Semiconductor manufacturing industry experience
* Experience using JAMA or other system requirements software
* Experience with SolidWorks, Eagle or Cadence, Labview, Jama

The annual base salary range for this full-time position is $150,000-$175,000 + bonus + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and EUV Tech's location. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the respective role. Within the range, individual pay is determined by the following factors: job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Joining EUV Tech means being part of an innovative start-up culture in Martinez, CA. We have a supportive environment and a convenient reverse commute from the Bay Area. We're a vibrant collective of individuals who celebrate our achievements while valuing each team member's unique contributions.

###### **Added benefits of joining us at EUV Tech:**

* Enjoy complimentary on-site lunches, coffee, drinks, and snacks as part of our commitment to a positive workplace experience

new_jobs.description:
#### **Who are we?**

Longshot Space Technologies is at the cutting edge of low-cost space access and hypersonics. We are developing a novel space launch system that accelerates mass over a long distance. Using our technology, we plan to provide affordable launch services for satellites, cargo, and future space infrastructure. Our mission is to enable a future where humans can reach for the stars.

#### **Position Overview**

We are hiring a Staff Electrical Engineer to own electrical engineering across Longshot, including the people, the architecture and the hardware. You will provide leadership and expertise in defining system architecture and electronics platforms for high-voltage pulsed ignition, firing and sequencing control, instrumentation and data acquisition, safety interlocks, vehicle avionics and power, and test site power. Deliverables include circuit card assemblies (CCAs), FPGA and microprocessor designs, harnesses, and the test procedures and scripts that verify them.

The electrical team is small and works across every program. You will set its technical direction, grow it, and be the accountable owner for electrical design at design reviews and test readiness. This is a hands-on lead role: you will design and review schematics, be in the bunker on test day, and sign your name to what goes on the launcher.

#### **Job Details**

* Role Type: Full-time
* Compensation: $180,000 to $220,000 per year
* Location: Alameda, CA Onsite with 25%-30% travel for campaigns

* Define and control interfaces with mechanical, software, test and facilities teams.

**Test, verification and documentation**

**Safety and reviews**

* Drive design for safety in high-energy systems: energy storage, safe/arm, fault tolerance, isolation, discharge and lockout/tagout.

new_jobs.description:
Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

**About the Role:**

Crusoe Cloud runs AI infrastructure at a scale where a single firmware or software baseline can determine whether thousands of GPUs deliver for our customers. As a Staff Technical Program Manager, you will own the end-to-end release lifecycle for versioned firmware and software baselines across our GPU fleet. That covers everything from scoping and qualification through phased rollout and production deployment. This is a builder role: you will run complex releases across Compute, Networking, Storage, Orchestration, and Operations, and you will design the release calendars, validation frameworks, and metrics that let Crusoe scale them predictably.

We’re looking for an engineer-rooted TPM who is comfortable in the white space between teams and who earns trust with engineers and vendors through technical depth and execution rigor. You’ll identify risks before they surface, drive alignment across engineering leads without direct authority, and give leadership clear, data-driven decision points. This is a full-time position.

**What You'll Be Working On:**

* **Own the Release Lifecycle End to End:** Lead versioned firmware and software baselines from scoping and definition through qualification, validation, phased rollout, and production deployment across a large GPU fleet.
* **Orchestrate Cross-Functional Releases:** Drive release programs across Compute, Networking, Storage, Orchestration, and Operations. Set entry and exit criteria, layered validation, domain sign-offs, and go/no-go decisions.
* **Lead Fleet-Wide Upgrade Campaigns:** Coordinate upgrades on live production clusters with Operations and customer-facing teams, including maintenance planning, rollback strategies, and risk mitigation.
* **Drive Security and CVE Response:** Partner with engineering leads to make fast, well-reasoned decisions on security patches and CVEs, and fold them into the release train.
* **Govern Vendor Relationships:** Work with OEMs, ODMs, and component and silicon suppliers on firmware fixes, validation timelines, and roadmaps. Escalate and resolve issues that put Crusoe’s schedule at risk.
* **Build the Machine:** Design lightweight, scalable release calendars, validation frameworks, Jira workflows, and metrics that make Crusoe’s release process predictable as the fleet grows.
* **Surface Risk and Drive Decisions:** Maintain real-time visibility into release health, map cross-team dependencies, and deliver crisp executive updates that spotlight decisions and trade-offs.
* **Improve Continuously:** Lead retrospectives after major releases and feed the learnings back into the process. Apply AI tools to improve tracking, risk detection, and communication across your programs.

**What You'll Bring to the Team:**

* **Program Leadership at Scale:** 10+ years as a Technical Program Manager in infrastructure, hardware, or platform engineering, including release or change management at fleet scale.
* **Server Firmware Expertise:** Working knowledge of the server firmware stack, including BMC, BIOS, GPU firmware and drivers, and NIC and switch firmware.
* **Influence Without Authority:** Proven experience running validation or qualification programs across many engineering teams without direct authority.
* **Risk and Dependency Management:** Ability to anticipate what will break before it does, then drive mitigation plans and rollback strategies for live production environments.
* **Process Builder’s Mindset:** Track record of creating fit-for-purpose frameworks, such as release calendars, validation gates, and metrics, rather than forcing programs into rigid templates.
* **Executive Communication:** Ability to translate complex technical status into clear, data-driven updates and decision-ready recommendations.
* **Educational Foundation:** Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.

**Bonus Points**

* Experience at a GPU cloud provider or hyperscaler managing large-scale fleets (thousands of nodes).
* A track record of driving firmware currency and compliance programs across a production fleet.
* Hands-on experience with vendor escalation management, including driving OEM/ODM and silicon partners to fix and validate firmware on tight timelines.
* Familiarity with AI accelerator platforms and the dependencies between firmware, drivers, and cluster networking.
* A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

**Benefits:**

* Restricted Stock Units
* Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs
* Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance
* Employer contributions to HSA account
* Paid parental leave
* Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability
* Professional development & tuition reimbursement

Job Title: Systems Hardware Design Engineer

**Experience:** 3+ years  
**Department:** Hardware Engineering / R&D  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Location:** On-site in Irvine, California  
**Salary Range:** $100,000 – $150,000 per year, based on experience

**About Omnitron**

Omnitron Systems Technology designs and manufactures fiber media converters, PoE switches, single pair Ethernet products, and network demarcation devices that keep critical networks running. Headquartered in Irvine, California, we design and manufacture all of our products in the United States, and they are trusted and used by government agencies, utilities, data centers, process automation, security surveillance, and service providers. As a focused, engineering-driven company, our hardware engineers see their designs through from concept to production, working closely with the various cross functional teams.

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a motivated and technically skilled Systems Hardware Design Engineer to design, develop, test, and validate electronic hardware systems. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in digital and analog circuit design, schematic capture, and supervising PCB layout. The engineer will be responsible for the complete hardware development lifecycle, from system-level requirements and circuit design through PCB layout, prototype bring-up, debugging, verification, and product release.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own hardware design from requirements to release. Define system architecture, design digital, analog, mixed-signal, and power supply circuits, and create schematics in industry-standard EDA tools.
* Select components such as microcontrollers, processors, interfaces, sensors, and power devices, using datasheet review and trade-off analysis.
* Supervise outsourced PCB layout. Set placement, stackup, routing, and impedance constraints; review layouts for grounding, power distribution, and signal integrity; and approve fabrication and assembly files.
* Lead board bring-up of prototype and production hardware using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and other lab equipment.
* Plan and run verification, validation, and qualification testing, including functional, electrical, and performance tests.
* Drive design-for-manufacturing and design-for-test (DFM/DFT), and support production through fabrication, assembly, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.
* Produce and maintain design documentation: schematics, BOMs, test reports, engineering change records, and production transition documents (assembly, test, and programming instructions).
* Work closely with firmware, FPGA, mechanical, systems, manufacturing, and test teams, including leading design reviews.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field.
* Strong fundamentals in analog and digital electronics, including circuit analysis, component behavior, signal conditioning, and power management.
* Experience with microcontroller-based designs and common interfaces such as SPI, I²C, UART, USB, and Ethernet.
* Hands-on schematic capture and a command of PCB layout principles (grounding, decoupling, impedance control, routing, EMI/EMC), plus experience managing external layout, fabrication, and assembly vendors.
* Proven hardware debugging skills with standard lab instruments, and the ability to own designs independently while working closely with a multidisciplinary team.
* Experience with EMC compliance testing, ESD protection, and electrical safety.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* FPGA development in Verilog or VHDL, including simulation, synthesis, and timing analysis.
* High-speed digital and mixed-signal design, including signal integrity, power integrity, DC-DC converters, LDOs, and power sequencing.
* Networking or ruggedized hardware, such as Ethernet PHYs and switches, fiber optic transceivers (SFP), PoE, or industrial-temperature electronics.
* EDA tools such as Altium Designer, Cadence Allegro/OrCAD, Siemens Xpedition, or KiCad.

**What We Offer**

* Salary range of $100,000 – $150,000 per year, based on experience.

new_jobs.title: Senior/Staff Hardware Design Engineer
new_jobs.description:
**What to Expect**
==================

Heron Power is a startup company building cutting-edge power electronics for the 21st-century grid. We aim to debottleneck the growth of electricity generation and consumption with scalable, innovative, and less costly hardware solutions, accelerating the electrification of everything.

Our first goal is to build better converters (inverters & rectifiers) to connect large-scale renewables, storage, and loads like datacenters to the grid. Heron Power’s leadership team is made up of seasoned veterans who have designed and shipped gigawatts of power conversion products over the past decade.

We understand that no one individual knows everything. We will all learn *a lot* together and from each other. We strive to build a collaborative, enriching environment conducive to personal, technical, and career growth. You can expect to work in a dynamic and collaborative environment, driven by first principles engineering, solving difficult problems.

**Job Overview**
================

As an Senior/Staff Hardware Design Engineer, you will be responsible for architecting, designing, and integrating the low voltage electrical system within high-performance power converters to meet reliability, EMC, and safety requirements. You will define cabinet-level electrical architecture, manage harnessing and interconnects, and ensure proper distribution of power, signals, and control across subsystems. Your work will span the full product lifecycle—from concept development and component selection to schematic capture, validation, and support through production.

**How You Will Contribute**
===========================

* *Own the full hardware development lifecycle—from requirements definition and modeling through schematic capture, PCB layout, prototyping, testing, validation, and manufacturing support.*
* *Define and implement the low voltage electrical architecture for cabinet-based systems, including cabinet microprocessors, power supplies, power distribution, interconnects, and signal processing and routing.*
* *Select appropriate LV components such as microcontrollers, interface circuits, fuses, relays, contactors, terminal blocks, and power supplies based on system requirements and reliability targets.*
* *Create system block diagrams, schematics, and harness documentation to support cross-functional development and manufacturing.*
* *Ensure electrical interface integrity across PCBs, sensors, actuators, and communication buses (e.g., CAN, RS-485, Ethernet, LV analog/digital I/O).*
* *Collaborate with mechanical teams on enclosure layout, cable routing, shielding, and grounding strategies for EMI/EMC performance.*
* *Support validation and bring-up of LV systems during prototype and production builds, including DVT and integration testing.*
* *Ensure compliance with safety and regulatory standards such as UL, CE, and IEC for low voltage systems.*
* *Coordinate with firmware, test, and manufacturing teams to ensure proper system behavior, integration, and serviceability.*

**What You Will Bring**
=======================

We’re open to candidates with both mid and senior-career experience. Scope and responsibilities will scale with the right candidate.

**Must-Have Requirements**
--------------------------

* *Degree in Electrical Engineering or related field.*
* *5+ years of experience in low voltage electrical system design, including cabinet-level LV system architecture and component designs, ideally in energy, automotive, or industrial control applications.*
* *Strong knowledge of cabinet-level LV power distribution and signal architecture.*
* *Experience selecting and integrating LV components (relays, fuses, terminal blocks, etc.) for multi-voltage systems (e.g., 12V, 24V, 48V).*
* *Familiarity with harness design, connector systems, and creating electrical schematics and wiring diagrams.*
* *Understanding of EMC best practices and grounding/shielding techniques.*
* *Proficiency with electrical CAD tools (e.g., Altium).*
* *Hands-on experience with debugging, testing, and validating electrical systems using oscilloscopes, multimeters, and similar tools.*
* *Experience with manufacturing processes, including design for manufacturability (DFM), volume production, and development of manufacturing test procedures and test equipment.*

**Nice-to-Haves**
-----------------

* *Experience with LV systems in high-voltage environments*
* *Familiarity with fieldbus communication protocols like CAN or industrial ethernet.*
* *Knowledge of control cabinet UL/IEC compliance and wire derating, spacing, and thermal considerations.*
* *Experience in creating wiring harnesses and managing cable assemblies with third-party suppliers.*
* *Exposure to cross-functional design with firmware and mechanical engineering teams.*
* *Experience with failure mode analysis and root cause investigations of LV electrical systems.*
* *Knowledge of safety-critical system design, including interlocks and redundant controls.*

If you are passionate about technology and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, we would love to hear from you. Join us in accelerating the electrification of everything at Heron Power.

Heron Power provides competitive compensation (salary and equity) and benefits. The base salary for this role ranges from $140,000 to $200,000 per year.

**About the Company**

Peak Energy is the first American venture to advance globally proven sodium-ion battery systems as the storage standard for the new era of renewable energy on a resilient grid.

Sodium-ion is cheap, readily available, and safe — making it the leading contender in a rapidly evolving market.

Our leadership team is powered by decades of expertise in scaling gigawatt-level innovation at world-class companies such as Tesla, Northvolt, Apple, Powin, Enovix, Zipline, Solid Power, SunPower, and Fluence. We recently announced America's first sodium-ion grid storage factory in Sacramento with production starting Q1 2027, and over $1B in signed customer commitments including Jupiter Power and Energy Vault.

  

**About the Role**

Peak Energy is looking for a Software Engineer, Backend to help improve and scale the software platform that manages, ingests, processes, and surfaces operational data from our grid-scale battery storage systems.

Our platform transforms raw telemetry from batteries deployed in the field into meaningful data and metrics that customers, operators, and engineers rely on every day. As Peak grows from pilot deployments to gigawatt-scale production, this software becomes increasingly critical to our operations.

This is a hands-on backend software engineering role focused on application development, API design, data processing, and system integration. You'll build and improve the services that connect our battery systems, manufacturing operations, and cloud applications, ensuring data is processed reliably and accessible across the organization.

You'll join a small software team with significant ownership over the systems you build, working closely with ESS Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, and Product.

  

**What You'll Do**

new_jobs.title: Director, Electrical Engineering
new_jobs.description:
Atomic Machines is building the Matter Compiler™, the first in a new class of AI-native, all-digital manufacturing systems that build working machines directly from code. The Matter Compiler (MC) is aimed at micro-machines: motors and gears the size of a grain of sand, robots small enough to work inside the body, cooling built directly into the chips that run AI, and the many devices like them that have been waiting on a way to build them. Its first product is PrimeSwitch™, an electromechanical power relay the size of a button battery that carries 150 amps continuous current and opens in 50 microseconds, about a thousand times faster than a conventional contactor. Founded by Jeff Holden — serial entrepreneur, ex-Amazon SVP and Uber's first Chief Product Officer — the company has raised $250 million to date.

Atomic Machines is based in the San Francisco Bay Area, with offices in Emeryville and Santa Clara.

### **About The Role:**

Atomic Machines is building autonomous manufacturing systems that combine a core robotics platform with a diverse set of manufacturing processes. As Director of Electrical Engineering, you'll lead Electrical Engineering in developing electronics and electrical architectures spanning core motion control hardware, sensor/actuator interfaces, and specialized manufacturing systems. You will also lead an Electrical Integration team in defining interconnect strategy and driving interconnect diagrams (ICDs), harness design and procurement, system bring-up, and integration.

You'll organize development across the core robotics platform and manufacturing process portfolio while building a cohesive, scalable electrical architecture. Working proactively with cross-functional partners, the CTO, and EE technical leaders, you'll uncover needs, align priorities, and balance shared platforms with process-specific designs.

### **What You'll Do:**

* Shape electrical engineering strategy across the core robotics platform and manufacturing process portfolio. Proactively uncover cross-functional needs and translate them into a roadmap, priorities, resource plans, and clear commitments.
* Build a cohesive, scalable electrical architecture across robotics and process systems. Work with the CTO and technical leaders to establish shared platforms and interfaces, balancing reuse with specialized requirements.
* Drive end-to-end delivery. Lead electronics development and electrical integration, including interconnect strategy, interconnect diagrams (ICDs), harness design and procurement, system bring-up, and verification; manage dependencies and adapt plans as requirements evolve.
* Provide deep technical leadership. Lead rigorous design reviews, challenge assumptions, and guide engineers through consequential tradeoffs and difficult technical problems.
* Set and enforce organization-wide EE standards. Establish consistent practices for design review, documentation, verification, and release, including work outside the core EE team.
* Ensure robust electrical systems. Address safety, protection, reliability, manufacturability, and serviceability throughout development, including specialized and high-voltage hardware.
* Build and develop the organization. Hire and coach strong engineers and leaders, delegate ownership, and establish clear expectations for quality and execution.

### **What You'll Need:**

* Deep electrical engineering expertise, with the ability to reason from fundamentals, evaluate architecture and detailed designs, and provide credible technical guidance on complex problems.
* Experience delivering complex electromechanical systems from design through bring-up, integration, validation, and operation.
* A track record of organizing development across varied systems, balancing specialized requirements with shared architecture, reuse, and scalability.
* Proactive cross-functional leadership: uncovering needs, shaping requirements, developing technical roadmaps, and securing alignment through execution.
* Experience building and leading strong engineering organizations, including hiring, coaching, developing leaders, managing performance, and delegating ownership.
* Experience establishing engineering standards across distributed teams and driving accountability beyond direct reporting lines.
* A bachelor's or master's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

### **Additional Experience We Value:**

* Electrical engineering leadership in autonomous machinery, robotics, advanced manufacturing, or similarly complex equipment.
* Design and validation of specialized electrical systems for manufacturing or other physical processes, including high-voltage or precision power applications.

Atomic Machines is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity and does not discriminate based on characteristics protected by applicable law. We are committed to an inclusive interview experience, including for individuals with disabilities. To request an accommodation, contact rc@atomicmachines.com. To help our recruiting team manage application volume and respond to candidates more efficiently, Atomic Machines may use AI-assisted tools.
