new_jobs.title: Staff Technical Program Manager, Firmware Lifecycle and Release Management
new_jobs.description:
Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

**About the Role:**

Crusoe Cloud runs AI infrastructure at a scale where a single firmware or software baseline can determine whether thousands of GPUs deliver for our customers. As a Staff Technical Program Manager, you will own the end-to-end release lifecycle for versioned firmware and software baselines across our GPU fleet. That covers everything from scoping and qualification through phased rollout and production deployment. This is a builder role: you will run complex releases across Compute, Networking, Storage, Orchestration, and Operations, and you will design the release calendars, validation frameworks, and metrics that let Crusoe scale them predictably.

We’re looking for an engineer-rooted TPM who is comfortable in the white space between teams and who earns trust with engineers and vendors through technical depth and execution rigor. You’ll identify risks before they surface, drive alignment across engineering leads without direct authority, and give leadership clear, data-driven decision points. This is a full-time position.

**What You'll Be Working On:**

* **Own the Release Lifecycle End to End:** Lead versioned firmware and software baselines from scoping and definition through qualification, validation, phased rollout, and production deployment across a large GPU fleet.
* **Orchestrate Cross-Functional Releases:** Drive release programs across Compute, Networking, Storage, Orchestration, and Operations. Set entry and exit criteria, layered validation, domain sign-offs, and go/no-go decisions.
* **Lead Fleet-Wide Upgrade Campaigns:** Coordinate upgrades on live production clusters with Operations and customer-facing teams, including maintenance planning, rollback strategies, and risk mitigation.
* **Drive Security and CVE Response:** Partner with engineering leads to make fast, well-reasoned decisions on security patches and CVEs, and fold them into the release train.
* **Govern Vendor Relationships:** Work with OEMs, ODMs, and component and silicon suppliers on firmware fixes, validation timelines, and roadmaps. Escalate and resolve issues that put Crusoe’s schedule at risk.
* **Build the Machine:** Design lightweight, scalable release calendars, validation frameworks, Jira workflows, and metrics that make Crusoe’s release process predictable as the fleet grows.
* **Surface Risk and Drive Decisions:** Maintain real-time visibility into release health, map cross-team dependencies, and deliver crisp executive updates that spotlight decisions and trade-offs.
* **Improve Continuously:** Lead retrospectives after major releases and feed the learnings back into the process. Apply AI tools to improve tracking, risk detection, and communication across your programs.

**What You'll Bring to the Team:**

* **Program Leadership at Scale:** 10+ years as a Technical Program Manager in infrastructure, hardware, or platform engineering, including release or change management at fleet scale.
* **Server Firmware Expertise:** Working knowledge of the server firmware stack, including BMC, BIOS, GPU firmware and drivers, and NIC and switch firmware.
* **Influence Without Authority:** Proven experience running validation or qualification programs across many engineering teams without direct authority.
* **Risk and Dependency Management:** Ability to anticipate what will break before it does, then drive mitigation plans and rollback strategies for live production environments.
* **Process Builder’s Mindset:** Track record of creating fit-for-purpose frameworks, such as release calendars, validation gates, and metrics, rather than forcing programs into rigid templates.
* **Executive Communication:** Ability to translate complex technical status into clear, data-driven updates and decision-ready recommendations.
* **Educational Foundation:** Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.

**Bonus Points**

* Experience at a GPU cloud provider or hyperscaler managing large-scale fleets (thousands of nodes).
* A track record of driving firmware currency and compliance programs across a production fleet.
* Hands-on experience with vendor escalation management, including driving OEM/ODM and silicon partners to fix and validate firmware on tight timelines.
* Familiarity with AI accelerator platforms and the dependencies between firmware, drivers, and cluster networking.
* A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

new_jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Platform CAM
new_jobs.description:
Atomic Machines is building the Matter Compiler™, the first in a new class of AI-native, all-digital manufacturing systems that build working machines directly from code. The Matter Compiler (MC) is aimed at micro-machines: motors and gears the size of a grain of sand, robots small enough to work inside the body, cooling built directly into the chips that run AI, and the many devices like them that have been waiting on a way to build them. Its first product is PrimeSwitch™, an electromechanical power relay the size of a button battery that carries 150 amps continuous current and opens in 50 microseconds, about a thousand times faster than a conventional contactor. Founded by Jeff Holden — serial entrepreneur, ex-Amazon SVP and Uber's first Chief Product Officer — the company has raised $250 million to date.

Atomic Machines is based in the San Francisco Bay Area, with offices in Emeryville and Santa Clara.

### **Why This Role Matters**

CAM connects geometric intent with physical processes. You'll build the software infrastructure that lets process experts express where an operation acts, what effect it should produce, and which constraints it must satisfy.

The challenge is to turn that knowledge into reusable representations, algorithms and interfaces. These must extend beyond familiar etching or 3D-printing workflows to support different ways of shaping, treating and assembling materials. Success means new processes can build on shared geometric capabilities while preserving the assumptions and behavior that make each process distinct.

You'll bring strong software engineering and deep interest in geometric reasoning, working with experts who bring the physics and process knowledge.

AI fluency is central: use agents throughout development while owning the decisions, code and results you accept.

### **What You'll Do**

* Build and evolve Go and Python software infrastructure for representing geometric intent and generating physical-process operations.
* Develop reusable geometric representations and algorithms for shapes, regions, coordinate frames, spatial relationships, and process planning.
* Work with process experts to turn their knowledge into explicit models, constraints, interfaces, and acceptance criteria, including effects that vary over space or time.
* Extend shared capabilities to new processes; keep process-specific behavior explicit and integrate with machine software and fab coordination.
* Test geometric and software correctness, make generated results reproducible, and validate assumptions with experts and physical measurements.
* Use AI throughout investigation, design, implementation, testing, and documentation; inspect changes and verify results.

### **What You'll Need**

* Production software ownership, typically 8+ years for the senior target; productive Python and strong in Go or C++, with readiness to work in Go. Level is based on demonstrated scope and ability.
* Experience in, or a demonstrated deep interest in, geometric reasoning: representing shapes and spatial relationships, choosing useful abstractions, and reasoning about their limits.
* Evidence of designing reusable software infrastructure, simplifying complexity, and testing and safely evolving systems with clear interfaces.
* Strong AI fluency: provide context, challenge proposals, inspect code and meaningfully test accepted work.
* Ability to work with domain experts, make assumptions explicit, and turn their knowledge into testable software behavior.
* Care with units, coordinate frames, tolerances and approximation; willingness to learn unfamiliar physical processes and work directly with fab equipment.
* BS in CS or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

We are committed to an inclusive interview experience, including for individuals with disabilities. To request an accommodation, contact rc@atomicmachines.com. To help our recruiting team manage application volume and respond to candidates more efficiently, Atomic Machines may use AI-assisted tools.

The TikTok Privacy and Security (PnS) R&D team creates privacy solutions that are intuitive for users, auditable for regulators, and sustainable for the company, making TikTok a platform where people can safely discover, create, and connect. We build user-facing privacy features, including privacy settings, consent management, data access and export, and age-appropriate experiences. We protect personal data across its full lifecycle, from collection and transfer through access, storage, retention, and deletion. We develop the platforms, technical controls, and governance tools behind privacy protection and regulatory compliance in global markets, and we bring privacy-enhancing technologies and research into production at scale. We tackle challenges unique to operating a platform at global scale: translating rapidly evolving laws and policies into reliable technical controls, providing transparency and auditability across highly complex data systems, supporting different regulatory requirements across regions, and making privacy protection work at the quality and speed production systems demand. You will work across product privacy, data lifecycle management, data protection and residency, privacy engineering platforms, AI governance, and privacy-preserving technologies, using techniques including automated compliance enforcement, data lineage and taxonomy, differential privacy, trusted execution environments, AI fairness, and privacy protection for generative AI. The systems you build will protect hundreds of millions of people, and the privacy decisions you make will reach every one of them. The TikTok Privacy and Security Product DSR team builds the platform behind data subject requests: the rights users exercise to access, delete, correct, or export their data. The team turns those rights into systems that run accurately, on time, and at global scale, across the products and data stores where that data actually lives. In this role, you will design and build core DSR systems, apply judgment where business goals and compliance meet, and take that work end to end with partner teams. Responsibilities As a Sr. Software Engineer on the TikTok Privacy and Security Product DSR team, you will: - Design, build, and evolve backend systems that improve privacy across TikTok, and help turn repeated requirements into shared platform capabilities. - Make sound business and compliance judgments in the systems you own, and carry the work end to end: problem framing, technical design, delivery, launch, and adoption. - Partner across product, legal, policy, data, and engineering teams. Align on requirements and tradeoffs, and land privacy capabilities in the products and data systems that depend on them. - Work with data and its lifecycle. Implement how data is collected, stored, used, shared, retained, and deleted, and connect those controls to how products operate. - Use data analysis and data processing to measure privacy coverage, risk, and business impact, and extend privacy capabilities into new scenarios and product lines. - Build and operate high-scale backend services, and take part in privacy incident response, including scope, root cause, and remediation.

This role is for someone who treats those constraints as the interesting part of the job. * Partner with backend teams to define and refine the microservice and BFF APIs that power the channel: catalog, playback authorization, entitlement, continue-watching, recommendations, and search.
* Implement and maintain Roku platform integrations: deep linking, Roku Search and content feeds, Continue Watching, Roku Pay / Instant Signup, and the Roku Advertising Framework.

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. The team is new and pulls together work from across the company, so you’ll shape both what we build and how we build it. You’ll report to the Bots & Fraud Engineering Manager.

* Design and build backend services for real-time abuse, fraud, and bot defense, including rate limiters, challenge flows (CAPTCHA, proof-of-work, 2FA), rules engines, and account enforcement APIs.

Urban Sky is a venture-backed aerospace startup on a mission to pioneer humanity’s routine, easy access to the stratosphere and the value locked within it. Our technology is also employed by government customers including the Department of War (DoW), NASA, and others. Urban Sky sends flight vehicles to the stratosphere on a weekly basis.

Our team consists of engineers, makers, developers, and doers who believe in the power of human potential when passion meets utility within a small, supportive team. At Urban Sky we strive to create a team culture grounded in candor, inclusion, respect and empowerment.

We aim to build the next chapter of stratospheric history in Denver and Texas and are seeking self-starting, open-minded, and hard-working team members.

**About the role**

This is a junior software engineering seat on Urban Sky's IT team. Most of the day is IT operations work: supporting employees, running the ticket queue, onboarding and offboarding, administering Microsoft 365, imaging devices, implementing CMMC 2.0 and NIST 800-171 controls. Alongside that, you will write the automations, scripts, dashboards, and internal tools that let a small IT team support an aerospace company launching to the stratosphere every day. IT works with every team in the company, from firmware engineers and mission control to atmospheric scientists and the manufacturing floor. You will know the whole company inside six months.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Electrical Engineer to lead the design and development of an advanced inductive power and data acquisition system for maritime applications.
  
This role will focus on developing a high-reliability, low-noise data acquisition system that operates through an air-gapped inductive power and communications interface.

The ideal candidate brings strong expertise in mixed-signal electronics, precision data acquisition, power electronics, magnetics, and embedded communications, with a proven ability to develop reliable hardware for harsh and mission-critical environments.

Working as part of a multidisciplinary engineering team, you will play a key technical role in advancing innovative technology targeted for U.S. Navy deployment.
  
This is an opportunity to take ownership of complex engineering challenges, influence system architecture, and work directly with engineers and customers in a collaborative, technically driven environment.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Lead the architecture, design, development, and validation of low-noise, high-reliability data acquisition systems operating through inductive power and communications links.
* Design analog front-end circuitry, including high-resolution ADC interfaces, filtering, clocking, signal conditioning, and noise reduction.
* Develop and optimize inductive power transfer systems, including coil and magnetic designs, driver circuits, rectification, voltage regulation, and DC/DC conversion.
* Design and validate digital communications over inductive interfaces, including modulation, encoding, error correction, and data integrity.
* Own analog and digital PCB development, including schematic design, component selection, layout reviews, and mixed-signal design practices.
* Integrate data acquisition, power, and communications subsystems into electromechanical assemblies for maritime and underwater applications.
* Conduct system-level testing, troubleshooting, and performance optimization using laboratory instrumentation and diagnostic tools.
* Collaborate with embedded software engineers to ensure proper firmware integration, timing, sequencing, configuration, and fault management.
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers while contributing to architecture discussions, design reviews, and prototype evaluations.
* Develop technical documentation, test plans, engineering analyses, and presentations for internal teams and customers.
* Support field testing and technology demonstrations, including occasional travel of up to 10%.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering with 5+ years of relevant experience; Master’s degree with 3+ years; or PhD with relevant academic experience.
* Strong background in mixed-signal design, power electronics, and/or precision data acquisition systems.
* Demonstrated expertise in low-noise analog circuit design, including sensor interfaces, ADC-based acquisition systems, grounding, and noise optimization.
* Experience designing high-efficiency power electronics, including DC/DC converters, magnetics, MOSFET/IGBT circuits, and power amplifiers.
* Proficiency in mixed-signal PCB design, component selection, schematic development, and layout considerations for noise-sensitive applications.
* Experience with microcontrollers, embedded processors, and digital communication protocols such as SPI, I2C, and RS-422.
* Understanding of EMI/EMC requirements and designing electronics for demanding environmental conditions.
* Strong hands-on laboratory skills, including troubleshooting complex electronic systems and validating hardware performance.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams and customers.
* Ability to obtain and maintain a Secret security clearance.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience developing electrical systems for underwater, maritime, defense, or other mission-critical applications.
* Background in inductive power transfer, magnetic coupling, or wireless power systems.
* Familiarity with Altium Designer for schematic capture and PCB layout.
* Experience with LTspice, MATLAB, or similar circuit simulation and engineering analysis tools.
* Previous experience providing technical mentorship or leading engineering design teams.
* Familiarity with electromechanical systems, acoustic sensors, or underwater transducer technology.

**Why This Opportunity?**

This is an opportunity for a technically strong electrical engineer to take ownership of sophisticated hardware development supporting advanced maritime and defense applications. You’ll work on challenging engineering problems, influence system architecture, collaborate across disciplines, and see your designs progress from concept through testing and deployment.

The position is particularly well suited for an engineer who enjoys hands-on design, solving complex mixed-signal and power electronics challenges, and contributing to technology with real-world mission impact.

We are seeking an Optical Systems Engineer with strong optics and photonics fundamentals and a hands-on approach to designing, building, and evaluating optical systems. The right candidate can connect optical theory and modeling with experimental results, translate evolving technical needs into practical designs and measurement approaches, and collaborate effectively across mechanical, electrical, controls, and manufacturing disciplines.

This role provides optical engineering expertise for emerging technologies, experimental platforms, and manufacturing capabilities. Work spans feasibility studies and optical architecture through prototype integration, performance characterization, and support for manufacturing implementation.

Opportunities span early-career through senior technical levels. The scope of independent design ownership and technical leadership will reflect demonstrated capability, with experienced engineers serving as optical subject matter experts and guiding system-level technical decisions.

Key Responsibilities:

* **Optical Requirements & Architecture:** Translate functional objectives into optical requirements, system concepts, and verification approaches. Identify critical unknowns, evaluate alternative architectures, and define interfaces with mechanical, electrical, and control systems.
* **Optical Design & Modeling:** Develop and evaluate optical designs using analytical methods and appropriate simulation tools. Apply ray optics, wave optics, or coupled physical models as needed to understand propagation, coupling, imaging, interference, polarization, and other performance-driving effects.
* **Performance & Sensitivity Analysis:** Develop optical performance budgets and evaluate sensitivity to component variation, alignment, source and detector characteristics, and environmental conditions. Translate these findings into actionable requirements for component selection, mechanical design, positioning, and control.
* **Experimental System Development:** Design, assemble, align, and troubleshoot optical experiments and prototype systems. Select and integrate sources, detectors, optical components, positioning hardware, and instrumentation appropriate to the application.
* **Optical Test & Measurement:** Develop characterization methods that establish whether components and systems meet functional requirements. Define test configurations, reference measurements, calibration needs, and acceptance criteria while accounting for measurement uncertainty and potential artifacts.
* **Multidisciplinary Integration:** Collaborate with mechanical and controls engineers on mounting, stability, motion, sensing, and feedback requirements. Understand how subsystem behavior affects optical performance and help resolve integration issues without losing sight of the overall system objective.
* **Data Acquisition & Analysis:** Develop or support instrument control, automated measurements, signal processing, and data-analysis workflows. Compare experimental results with model predictions, investigate discrepancies, and refine designs or test methods accordingly.
* **Component & Vendor Evaluation:** Specify optical components and instruments, assess supplier capabilities and technical data, and support make-or-buy decisions. Work with vendors and external specialists to clarify requirements and resolve optical performance issues.
* **Manufacturing & Environmental Support:** Identify optical performance drivers that must be controlled during assembly, inspection, and operation. Work with process, opto-mechanical, and reliability engineers to translate development findings into practical manufacturing tests and evaluate performance under relevant environmental conditions.

* **Technical Documentation & Leadership:** Prepare optical specifications, design analyses, test procedures, and technical reports. Communicate assumptions, limitations, and recommendations clearly. More experienced engineers may establish optical development strategies, lead technical reviews, mentor others, and identify when additional specialist expertise is needed.

The DevOps & Systems Engineer is responsible for the reliability, security, automation, deployment, monitoring, and ongoing administration of the company's cloud and internal technology infrastructure.  
This position serves as the primary technical resource for **Microsoft Azure infrastructure and DevOps operations**, while also supporting internal servers, networking, hardware, identity, backups, and other systems-engineering responsibilities.  
The role works closely with software development, data engineering, security, and business technology teams to ensure applications and infrastructure are deployed consistently, monitored effectively, secured appropriately, and designed for scalability and high availability.  
The position should emphasize automation and repeatability rather than manual administration. SafePoint's existing technical direction already incorporates Azure PaaS services, PowerShell automation, Infrastructure as Code, Azure DevOps/Git-based CI/CD, Azure Monitor, and Application Insights.

Administer repositories, branching strategies, service connections, deployment approvals, environment variables, secrets, and release processes. **AI Security Software Engineer**

**Location:** This role requires associates to be in-office 1 - 2 days per week, fostering collaboration and connectivity, while providing flexibility to support productivity and work-life balance. This approach combines structured office engagement with the autonomy of virtual work, promoting a dynamic and adaptable workplace. Alternate locations may be considered if candidates reside within a commuting distance from an office.

*Please note that per our policy on hybrid/virtual work, candidates not within a reasonable commuting distance from the posting location(s) will not be considered for employment, unless an accommodation is granted as required by law.*

*PLEASE NOTE: This position is not eligible for current or future visa sponsorship.*

The **AI Security Software Engineer** designs, develops, and implements AI-driven security solutions to assess enterprise applications, analyze source code, and identify vulnerabilities. This role combines software engineering, application security, DevSecOps, and large language model (LLM) technologies to strengthen security capabilities, automate assessments, and reduce enterprise risk.

**How You Will Make an Impact**
-------------------------------

* Design, develop, test, and maintain AI-enabled application security solutions and automated vulnerability assessment capabilities.
* Build and integrate security assessment pipelines that combine traditional security scanning tools with AI-assisted source code analysis and vulnerability identification.
* Develop integrations with source code repositories, security tools, vulnerability management platforms, enterprise workflows, and AI/LLM platforms.
* Lead the design and implementation of DevSecOps solutions, embedding security controls, automated testing, and secure coding practices into CI/CD pipelines.
* Define technical requirements, system architecture, and reusable integration frameworks supporting AI models, security tools, and assessment engines.
* Establish security guardrails for AI-generated code and AI-enabled applications, addressing risks such as prompt injection, insecure code, sensitive data exposure, and model misuse.
* Lead security risk assessments, vulnerability prioritization, and remediation strategies aligned with business, regulatory, and technical requirements.
* Develop security metrics and reporting to measure security posture, assessment coverage, and risk reduction.
* Collaborate with application security, penetration testing, software engineering, AI engineering, and platform teams to deliver scalable security solutions.
* Serve as a technical subject matter expert, providing guidance, troubleshooting complex issues, and supporting security incident response strategies.

**Minimum Requirements**
------------------------

Requires BS/BA in information Technology or related field of study and a minimum of 8 years experience in systems administration and security aspects of information systems, access management and network security technologies, network communications, computer networking, telecommunications, systems development and management, hardware, software, data, and people; experience with multiple technical and business disciplines required; or any combination of education and experience, which would provide an equivalent background.

**Preferred Skills, Experience, and Competencies**
--------------------------------------------------

* **Software Engineering:** Strong Python development skills, including experience building REST APIs using FastAPI, Flask, Django, or similar frameworks. Familiarity with asynchronous processing, concurrency, automated testing (pytest), and SQL databases.
* **AI/LLM Integration:** Experience developing AI-enabled or agent-based systems using commercial or open-source LLMs, prompt engineering, tool calling, structured outputs, context management, and enterprise AI platforms.
* **Application Security:** Strong knowledge of OWASP Top 10, CWE, SAST, DAST, SCA, API security, secrets detection, software supply chain security, and vulnerability assessment.
* **AI Security:** Experience securing AI/LLM applications and AI-assisted development workflows, including mitigating prompt injection, data leakage, insecure tool use, excessive agency, and untrusted code execution.
* **DevSecOps & CI/CD:** Hands-on experience integrating security into CI/CD pipelines using GitHub, GitLab, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, Bitbucket, or similar platforms.
* **Cloud & Container Security:** Knowledge of AWS, Azure, or GCP, container security, Kubernetes, and modern cloud deployment practices.
* **Security Tool Integration:** Experience integrating application security and vulnerability management platforms, including vulnerability correlation, deduplication, prioritization, risk scoring, and standardized formats such as SARIF.
* **AI Evaluation & Testing:** Familiarity with model evaluation techniques, including labeled datasets, precision/recall metrics, regression testing, and comparative model analysis.
* **Development & Observability:** Experience with Git-based development, code reviews, automated testing, logging, metrics, distributed tracing, and production monitoring.
* **Additional Technologies:** Familiarity with React, JavaScript, TypeScript, enterprise workflow platforms, and IT service management systems.
* **Enterprise Security & Communication:** Experience in regulated or security-sensitive environments, with strong technical documentation, architecture design, and stakeholder communication skills.
* **Certifications:** Security certifications such as CSSLP, OSWE, GWEB, cloud security certifications, or equivalent are strongly preferred.

Description:

**COMPANY BACKGROUND**

Epiq Solutions develops cutting-edge software-defined radio (SDR) products and processing solutions to enable spectrum dominance for maritime, land, air, and space domains. With 15 years serving government and commercial enterprise customers and 25K+ devices fielded to date, Epiq Solutions is a trusted partner with a proven heritage of delivering open architecture products in radically small form factors where time-to-market, cost, and performance are critical for mission success.

For more information, visit https://epiqsolutions.com.

**JOB SUMMARY**

The Principal Systems Engineer provides technical leadership in the development and evolution of SDR platforms. This is an emerging role within the organization and will play a key part in aligning customer needs, product strategy, and technical execution. The position will collaborate closely with product management, customers, and cross-functional engineering teams to define system requirements, guide architectural decisions, and support programs from early concept through prototype delivery and commercialization.

The role requires a broad technical understanding of SDR systems — including RF, hardware, firmware, and software — and the ability to translate customer and product needs into clear system definitions. Depending on project needs, the Principal Systems Engineer may also serve as a technical lead for SDR development efforts with defined scope and delivery timelines.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Collaborate with product management to develop and review technical content for proposals, statements of work, and customer engagements.

* Define and document system and feature-level requirements for new radio platforms and major capabilities, with primary ownership through initial definition and handoff to execution teams.

* Develop high-level system architectures, including block diagrams, interface definitions, and support for critical component selection.

* Define system-level acceptance and verification approaches, including how data should be acquired, structured, and reviewed to validate requirements.
* Guide troubleshooting of complex system-level issues, helping teams isolate problems to subsystems through structured analysis and test strategy guidance.
* Provide technical customer support related to integrating SDR products into larger customer systems.
* Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of Epiq’s systems engineering processes, templates, and best practices.
* Lead a cross-functional engineering team through SDR hardware and system development efforts.
* Identify technical risks and develop and implement mitigation plans.
* Work with engineering team members to define development tasks, dependencies, and priorities, and assist in removing technical blockers.
* Establish and track internal technical milestones to support delivery against contract and customer commitments.

**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or related discipline
* Minimum 15 years of engineering experience, including at least 5 years in radio or RF hardware development
* Broad technical understanding of SDR systems, including RF front ends, digital hardware, firmware, and software

Specter Aerospace is seeking an Embedded Software Engineer III to develop and implement flight software for custom vehicle avionics and ground support systems. * Experience writing test tooling/scripting to optimize test data analysis and build relevant workflows

* Experience establishing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for embedded projects
* Experience with Yocto

* Familiarity with flight software development, specifically using WOSA
* Experience developing/implementing motor control algorithms on microcontrollers

**Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as the technical lead for a software team, providing technical direction, mentoring, code reviews, and implementation support.

* Partner with the Product Owner, Scrum Master, program leadership, systems engineering, and SC&I to plan work, manage priorities, and align with coding and development standards.
* Support Agile execution, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, technical estimation, retrospectives, and delivery tracking.
* Develop, review, and maintain technical artifacts, including test plans, user manuals, administrator manuals, design documentation, and software-development documentation.
* Support financial and program-planning activities, including COCOMO estimates, Basis of Estimate (BOE) inputs, and Software Bill of Materials (SW BOM) development.
* Conduct and oversee code reviews, ensuring changes meet quality, security, maintainability, testability, and Definition-of-Done expectations.
* Assess and improve team maturity, code maturity, codebase size and stabilization trends, development efficiency, and scalability across a distributed environment supporting 3,000+ endpoints.
* Help mature CI/CD and DevSecOps capabilities, including automated unit testing, code-quality analysis, configuration management, and repeatable production builds.
* Establish, maintain, or support test beds on SWFPAC.
* Identify technical risks, dependencies, and architectural concerns early; communicate options, tradeoffs, and recommendations to leadership.

**The Role**
============

We’re looking for a Systems Engineer who lives where the subsystems meet. If you get excited about taking mechanical, electrical, and software pieces from different benches and making them work as one system, leading the bring-up campaigns that get it wet, and chasing down the cross-domain challenges that only show up at integration, this is your role.

**What You’ll Do**
==================

* Integrate maritime vehicles end-to-end: stand up new subsystems on the bench, wire them into the platform, and bring the full platform online
* Build and run hardware-in-the-loop rigs, test fixtures, and bench setups that let us shake out interfaces before we hit the water
* Lead test campaigns from bench to tank to sea trials: write the procedures, run the runs, capture the data, and close the loop with the team
* Debug across the stack; power, comms, sensors, mechanical, firmware, autonomy
* Work shoulder-to-shoulder with mechanical, electrical, and software engineers
* Own integration risk and readiness: know what’s tested and what we need to prove before each event
* Push the limits of what’s possible in subsea autonomy and robotics by getting things working, reliably in the real world

**What You Bring**
==================

* Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Aerospace, Robotics, Systems Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience
* 5+ years integrating real-world robotic, vehicle, or complex hardware/software systems
* Hands-on experience standing up subsystems on the bench: harnessing, power up, comms bring-up, sensor checkout
* Strong test instincts: you know how to design a test that and how to instrument it, so the data is useful
* Comfort moving across domains, reading a schematic, scoping a signal, sniffing a CAN/Ethernet bus, and reading enough firmware or autonomy code to find a bug
* Comfort working with a small team and wearing many hats
* U.S. citizen; eligible for DoD security clearance

**Nice To Haves**
=================

* Experience integrating and testing maritime systems other unmanned platforms
* Hands-on with lab and test gear: oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, bus sniffers, DAQs, environmental and pressure test setups
* Working knowledge of Python (or similar) for test automation, data capture, and log analysis
* Active DoD Secret clearance

**Who You Are**
===============

* You like to get your hands dirty, tracing a harness, scoping a signal, debugging on a boat, and you’d rather be in the lab than in a document
* Collaborative, but independent, driving your own workload but knowing when to pull the team together
* Passionate about robotics, autonomy, and building tech that matters

new_jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer
new_jobs.description:
At Emerson, we help the world run safer and smarter. As a global leader in automation, our Analytical Instruments organization develops advanced technologies and solutions that safeguard industries and keep critical systems running.

Join our Liquid Analysis team in Shakopee, MN, as a Senior Embedded Software Engineer — where you'll work on both new product development and sustaining engineering for process analytical equipment that protects water quality, supports life sciences, strengthens industrial safety, and serves industries worldwide.

If solving complex engineering problems with software excites you, this is an opportunity to build real embedded products, work closely with software, hardware, systems, and test engineers, and see your work come together in the complete product - become part of a team that’s growing, learning, and focused on delivering results!

**IN THIS ROLE, YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES WILL:**

* Design and develop embedded software solutions for new products and major product enhancements.
* Own significant software features and technical efforts, breaking down work and driving it through implementation, integration, and completion.
* Solve complex embedded software and hardware/software integration problems through hands-on development, debugging, and testing.
* Collaborate with global, cross-functional teams across software, test, systems, hardware, project management, and product management.
* Follow and strengthen engineering practices aligned with our SDLA and IEC 62443-4-1, including requirements, design, cybersecurity, implementation, testing, reviews, documentation, and release.
* Develop and maintain software requirements, architecture, interfaces, and traceability throughout the development lifecycle.
* Provide technical guidance and mentoring to other engineers and participate in meaningful technical and peer reviews.
Maintain and improve existing products while exploring new technologies, tools, and approaches that improve our products and engineering capabilities.  

**WHO YOU ARE** : You take on the challenge of unfamiliar tasks. You deal constructively with problems that do not have clear solutions or outcomes. You grow from hardships and negative experiences You partner with others to get work done. You admit mistakes and gain insight from experiences.

**FOR THIS ROLE, YOU WILL NEED:**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering or science from an engineering school
* 5+ years of applicable experience
* Experience developing using C/C++ for real-time, multi-threaded embedded systems and microcontroller-based products
* **Authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship now and in the future**
  + **Individuals with temporary visas such as E, F-1 (including those with OPT or CPT), H-1, H-2, L-1, B, J or TN, or who need sponsorship for work authorization now or in the future, are not eligible for hire.**

  

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS THAT SET YOU APART:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field; ABET-accredited engineering degree preferred
* Strong proficiency in C/C++, with experience in modular embedded software architecture, object-oriented design, design patterns, and UML
* Experience with embedded Ethernet and TCP/IP networking; industrial Ethernet protocols and stacks such as EtherNet/IP, Modbus TCP, and PROFINET are a plus
* Working knowledge of embedded communication interfaces and industrial protocols such as CAN, SPI, UART/SCI, I²C, HART, Modbus, and PROFIBUS
* Demonstrated ability to solve complex embedded software and system-level technical problems
* Experience with secure software development lifecycle practices; familiarity with IEC 62443-4-1 or similar product cybersecurity standards preferred
* Ability to communicate technical designs, decisions, and tradeoffs and work effectively with cross-functional teams
Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools to improve software development, testing, debugging, or engineering productivity  

  

**Our Culture & Commitment to You:**

At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where every employee is valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives because we know that great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe diverse teams, working together are key to driving growth and delivering business results.

We recognize the importance of employee wellbeing and know that to do your best you must have flexible, competitive benefits plans to meet you and your family’s physical, mental, financial, and social needs. We provide, a variety of medical insurance plans, with dental and vision coverage, Employee Assistance Program, profit sharing retirement, tuition reimbursement, employee resource groups, recognition, and much more. Our culture prioritizes work-life balance and offers flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave (maternal and paternal), vacation and holiday leave.

Our compensation philosophy is simple: we pay a competitive base salary, within the local market in which we operate, and reward performance during our annual merit review process. The salary range for this role is $110,000-$150,000 annually, commensurate with the skills, talent, capabilities, and experience each candidate brings to a role.

**About Carrier**

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Through cutting-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure safe transport of food, lifesaving medicines and more. Since inventing modern air conditioning in 1902, we lead with purpose: enhancing the lives we live and the world we share. We continue to lead because of our world-class, inclusive workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do. For more information, visit corporate.carrier.com or follow on Carrier social media at @Carrier.

**Staff Engineer, Systems Engineering**

**About this role**

In this role, you will be developing 75F’s next-generation IoT applications for Smart Buildings. You will collaborate with an interdisciplinary team of cloud and firmware engineers to develop and improve software products deployed in commercial buildings which aim to cut down significantly on energy consumption due to HVAC infrastructure while maintaining the highest level of occupants’ comfort and productivity.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Architect, develop, and deliver high-quality software, code, and algorithms for full-stack Java and Android-based solutions, ensuring end-to-end code quality.
* Design, implement, test, and deliver new features for the Android gateway application that runs Smart Building algorithms and connects to the cloud.
* Develop and integrate embedded platform services, middleware, device interfaces, and hardware abstraction components across Android and Embedded Linux systems.
* Analyze system performance using benchmarking, profiling, and instrumentation, and implement optimizations.
* Incorporate software quality attributes into architecture, design, development, and delivery activities.
* Contribute to and review software methodologies, product designs, models, and technical documentation.
* Collaborate with developers and architects across time zones and international sites in a scaled agile environment.
* Partner with the product manager and test lead to develop user stories, refine acceptance criteria, and define test designs.
* Investigate and resolve field issues in existing products through thorough system impact analysis, diagnostics, and debugging.
* Ensure secure coding practices are followed throughout development.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or Electrical or Electronic Engineering
* 10+ years of hands-on professional experience designing and developing applications and algorithms in Java and Kotlin for Android/Linux platforms, including 5+ years of Kotlin experience.
* 10+ years of embedded software development and platform architecture experience.
* 10+ years of architecture and development experience with Embedded Linux and Android, including Android OS root/system-level development, device drivers, and Android tablet hardware integration.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in the HVAC domain and Internet of Things (IoT) applications.
* Experience with embedded platform services, middleware, device interfaces, hardware abstraction, and cross-platform libraries.
* Experience in system performance analysis, benchmarking, profiling, instrumentation, and optimization.
* Practical experience with SDLC tools such as Git and Azure DevOps.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills in a global team environment.
* Self-motivated, committed to continuous learning, and able to adapt to a fast-paced startup environment
* Experience with the Android platform, middleware, framework, native services, HAL, NDK, JNI, and AIDL; working knowledge of Android architecture layers (Linux Kernel, HAL, Runtime, Framework, Applications).
* Experience with Linux internals, including processes, threads, IPC, scheduling, memory, storage, networking, and system services.
* Experience with embedded-device observability, telemetry, health monitoring, diagnostics, logging, and remote debugging.
* Experience with embedded platform security, including secure boot, keys, certificates, signing, TPM/TEE, secure updates, and network security.
* Experience with the Android SDK, different Android versions, Android UI design principles, patterns, and best practices.
* Experience with the open-source Android ecosystem and common libraries; familiarity with RESTful APIs connecting Android applications to back-end services.
* Experience with offline storage, threading, and performance tuning.
* Experience with Java build and package management tools such as Gradle and Maven.
* Experience with testing libraries and automation frameworks such as JUnit, Espresso, and Robolectric, including hands-on application testing across multiple devices and form factors.
* Experience with continuous delivery for mobile applications, including test-driven or behavior-driven development, code reviews, static analysis, continuous integration, automation, and functional testing.

**Job Title:****Staff Embedded Firmware Engineer - Power Electronics**
======================================================================

**Job Description**

Trystar’s team members are our most important asset. We are looking for a Staff Embedded Firmware Engineer – Power Electronics – to write, integrate, and verify the embedded real-time firmware of our power conversion products, including DC/DC converters, three-phase grid-tied inverters, and energy storage systems, from architecture through validation, certification, and production release. You will turn the control strategies that our controls engineers define and simulate into production-quality code on microcontroller- and FPGA-based control boards, and you will own the drivers, communications, memory, diagnostics, and update functions around that code. You will lead the firmware workstream of new product programs as a senior individual contributor, set the technical direction of the firmware code base, and mentor the engineers who build it with you.

**Location**

Merrimack, NH, or Pointe-Claire, QC, is preferred. Travel within North America up to 20%.

**In this role you will:**

* Develop, implement, test, and maintain embedded real-time firmware in C and C++ for power conversion systems, including DC/DC converters, three-phase grid-tied inverters, and energy storage systems.
* Implement in real-time code the control algorithms that controls engineers define and simulate, including current, voltage, and power regulation, pulse-width modulation, Clarke and Park transformations, phase-locked loops, protection, and grid-support functions, within sampling, timing, and computational-delay budgets.
* Integrate and verify code generated from MATLAB and Simulink models, and keep firmware behavior traceable to the control specification.
* Design the real-time software architecture of control boards, including task scheduling, interrupt service routines, bootloaders, board-support packages, and hardware abstraction layers.

* Design and develop embedded communication software, including TCP/IP stack integration, Ethernet-based communication, CAN, Modbus, and protocol-level diagnostics for connected power electronics products.
* Implement and debug external memory interfaces, including EEPROM, Flash, MRAM, and SD card, for data logging, configuration storage, field firmware updates, and fault-record handling.
* Test and debug firmware in-system and on processor-in-the-loop and hardware-in-the-loop platforms, using debuggers, emulators, oscilloscopes, and embedded instrumentation, and confirm with controls engineers that the code reproduces the simulated control performance.
* Support IEEE 1547 and UL 1741 grid-support inverter certification testing with firmware builds, parameter configuration, diagnostics, and defect resolution.
* Apply disciplined software practices, including version control, code reviews, static code analysis, automated unit testing, and release management.
* Write firmware requirements, software design specifications, and user documentation for embedded control software.
* Collaborate with controls, hardware, systems, tests, compliance, and manufacturing engineers on new system architectures, from concept through validation and commercial-scale manufacturing.
* Develop and manage detailed schedules for the firmware workstream of your projects.
* Mentor junior firmware and software engineers.

### **Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or a related technical field, with 10+ years of relevant industrial experience in embedded firmware for power conversion or other real-time control products.
* Expert proficiency in C, and working proficiency in C++, for real-time, microcontroller-based control systems.
* Demonstrated experience implementing power electronics control algorithms in production firmware, including regulators, pulse-width and space vector modulation, Clarke and Park transformations, and phase-locked loops, with attention to fixed-point scaling, sampling, timing, and computational delay.
* Working knowledge of power electronics control theory sufficient to read control specifications and MATLAB and Simulink models, and to diagnose differences between simulated and measured behavior.
* Extensive experience in digital design engineering for power and instrumentation systems.
* Experience with electrical hardware for power conversion and instrumentation, and the ability to read and understand mixed-signal electrical schematics.
* Experience in bootloaders, device drivers, interrupt service routines, real-time operating systems or bare-metal schedulers, and hardware abstraction layers for embedded control boards.
* Hands-on experience with embedded communication interfaces and protocols, including TCP/IP, Ethernet, I2C, SPI, UART, CAN, Modbus, or similar industrial protocols.
* Experience with external memory devices and data storage mechanisms, including Flash, EEPROM, FRAM, SD card, wear-leveling, memory partitioning, and field firmware update support.
* Strong background in microcontroller- and FPGA-based architectures.

new_jobs.description:
Job Description
  
  
We are a global biopharmaceutical leader with a portfolio of prescription medicines, oncology, vaccines and animal health products. We are driven by our purpose to develop and deliver innovative products that save and improve lives. With 69,000 employees operating in more than 140 countries, we offer state-of-the-art laboratories, plants and offices that are designed to inspire our employees as we learn, develop and grow in our careers. We are proud of our over 125 years of service to humanity and continue to be one of the world’s biggest investors in Research & Development.
  
  
In the Development Sciences and Clinical Supply (DSCS) organization, we believe digital is the force multiplier that enables faster experiments, smarter decisions, more robust supply chains, and is ultimately redefining how we bring medicines to patients.
  
  
Within DSCS, the DSCS Digital Technologies (DDT) team is building the next generation of data-rich, connected lab environments—where hardware, software, and AI-driven tools work together to accelerate pharmaceutical development. Our goal is simple but ambitious: embed advanced digital capabilities into the DNA of how we work. We believe this future starts with an effective foundation of laboratory tools: innovative robotics, process analytical technology (PAT), high-throughput technologies, reliable instrumentation, and integrated systems that seamlessly transition data from the physical labs to the digital world. We believe innovation is fueled by collaborative teams that come together to build technologies that truly impact how our scientists conduct research. We’re looking for a Scientist to help make this vision real.
  
  
In this role, you won’t just support experiments—you’ll transform how they happen. You’ll design and deploy cutting-edge automation solutions that enable scientists to move faster, generate higher-quality data, and focus on what matters most: discovery and innovation. You’ll work to augment the capabilities of our current laboratory systems, creating custom solutions that unlock new potential for our scientists. working closely with scientists, engineers, and digital technology specialists to build integrated systems that connect instruments, robotics, and data—turning complex workflows into seamless, intelligent processes. If you’re excited by the idea of combining science, engineering, and digital innovation— If you are a maker, a builder, a tinkerer —this is your opportunity to make a lasting impact and transform pharmaceutical research!
  
  
How You’ll Make an Impact
  
  

* Design the lab of the future by developing automation systems that integrate robotics, instrumentation, and software into cohesive, high-performing solutions
* Translate science into systems by partnering with researchers to understand experimental needs and convert them into scalable automated workflows
* Work at the intersection of disciplines, collaborating with experts in automation, data science, modeling, IT, and digital engineering
* Lead high-impact projects from concept through deployment, working across teams and stakeholders to deliver meaningful outcomes
* Continuously improve existing automation platforms to enhance performance, usability, and reliability
* Connect the ecosystem by integrating robotic platforms with laboratory equipment and data systems to enable end-to-end digital workflows
* Empower others by providing hands-on support, troubleshooting, and training to scientists using these systems

**Education Minimum Requirement:**  

* A M.S. in Engineering (i.e. Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical), Robotics, Mechatronics, Chemistry, Physics, Biology, Pharmaceutical Sciences or a closely related field
* A B.S. in in Engineering (i.e. Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical), Robotics, Mechatronics, Chemistry, Physics, Biology, Pharmaceutical Sciences or a closely related field with at least 2 years of relevant experience

**Required Experience and Skills:**  

* Experience in a lab-based setting, working with lab automation and equipment integration
* Experience with scripting/programming following accepted best practices (version control, design patterns, clean code)
* Understanding of (bio)pharmaceutical process research and development, drug product development, and/ or analytical development
* Demonstrated ability to work in an entrepreneurial and independent manner on cross-functional teams
* Efficient scientific collaboration and communication skills with the ability to navigate conversations with technicians and vendors

**Preferred Experience and Skills:**  

* Experience with scripting/programming in one or more of the following: Python, C#, VBA, JavaScript, R
* Experience with automation edge devices and controllers (PLC, microcontrollers, etc)
* Experience with industrial SCADA or orchestration software (DeltaV, Ignition, WinCC OA, etc)
* Experience with benchtop automated reactor systems such as Sartorius Ambr250
* Experience with laboratory automation software, firmware, hardware, and their integration into end-to-end solutions
* Experience in integrating laboratory instruments with custom or commercial software solutions
* Ability to recognize, design, prototype, and deploy innovative technologies in laboratory automation
* Understanding of data science and AI/ML concepts and their application to laboratory automation
* Wet lab experience in (bio)pharmaceutical drug substance, drug product, and analytical research and development
* Experience with commercial laboratory notebook software like Benchling or Signals
* Motivated to learn new skills, willingness to take on new challenges, and scientific curiosity
* Deep interest and desire to understand how systems work. Self-proclaimed maker, builder, tinkerer

#EligibleforERP

Analytical Chemistry, Automation Technology, Bioprocess Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, Data Analysis, Laboratory Automation, Laboratory Instrument

new_jobs.description:
We grow the world’s BEST Strawberries & that wouldn’t be possible without our super talented engineering team!

As part of our Engineering team, a **Controls Engineer** will be involved with the design, commissioning, ramp-up, and operations of our indoor vertical smart farms and will support Facilities and Maintenance teams in preparing preventative maintenance and standard operating procedures documentation. Our Controls Teamwork on everything from our PLCs, SCADA system development, process implementation, to optimization across multiple infrastructure systems.  
  
**What you’ll be responsible for**:

* Maintain existing controls systems; this includes checking programming settings and repairing/troubleshooting sensors.
* Perform updates to existing controls systems to meet the needs of our farm team; this includes, but is not limited to adding new components, changing HMI screens, and editing PLC programs.
* Continually improving the system by finding ways to increase resiliency in the system with hardware and software.
* Design and improve libraries for new and existing installations using AOIs.
* Create and update SCADA screens, alarms, and Historian.
* Develop models for prescriptive maintenance and anomaly detection using machine learning techniques on historical data.
* Work closely with cross functional partners throughout facilities to ensure a cohesive operation amongst different functions such as farming and facilities.
* Commission new facilities from IO checkout to start-up.

#### **Who will love this job:** *Individuals who identify with our Core Values and exhibit skills within those values will thrive at Oishii.*

* ***One Team, One Fight!***
  + *Ability to quickly shift priorities to meet deadlines and effectively communicate, both verbally and in writing, clearly, concisely and with purpose at various levels of the organization.*
  + *Ability to work cross functionally at all levels including across locations, and collaborate with a focus on supporting & understanding the evolving business needs of a startup environment.*
  + *Ability to lead through others and develop teams with a diverse level of experience to succeed.*
* ***Focus.***
  + *Ability to remove obstacles in order to prioritize which could include problem solving, working through ambiguity and using fact based or sound judgment in the absence of process or policy. We are building it, but need to manage through the process with good judgment and a bias for action.*
  + *Ability to synthesize information quickly to aid in the troubleshooting process.*
* ***GSD (Get Sh\*\* Done!)***
  + *Possessing an entrepreneurial mindset with the tenacity to develop ideas, process, and policy and implement them rapidly.*
  + *Capable of prioritizing tasks and considering the resources available when doing so.*
  + *A bias for action! Ability to hold yourself accountable and take ownership of driving results that impact company outcomes.*
  + *Track record of effectively handling complex employee relations issues, and addressing sensitive information and difficult situations with tact, discretion, and confidentiality.*

**What We Look for in a Controls Engineer**:

* Associate’s or Bachelor’s Degree in an Engineering discipline
* 3+ years of related professional Controls Engineering experience
* Experience in a farming, manufacturing, warehousing, production or similar environment.
* Experience and knowledge of multiple systems, areas and programing including PLCs (Allen Bradley), HMIs/SCADA (Panelview 5000 & Ignition Prefered), VFDs, PID control, analog & digital field components, Ethernet and Modbus communication protocols, Python programming, SQL, and AutoCAD.
* Comfortable with ambiguity with proven capabilities to provide/implement structure.
* Experience working with an organization during a time of expansion or scale is a plus!

**Shift & Schedule:**

* This is a 5 days a week onsite role
* The role does require on-call support/troubleshooting which may include some nights and weekends rotation

**Perks at Oishii:**

* Compensation: $75,000 - $90,000 and Equity
* Medical, dental, vision, 401(K)
* 100% Employer Paid Life Insurance + Long Term Disability Insurance
* Paid Parental leave, Paid Time Off, Paid Sick Time
* Paid Training
* Office social events including happy hours, events, and parties
* Employee activity groups for basketball players, Yoga Enthusiasts, runners…

#### **About Us:**

Oishii (which means “delicious” in Japanese) is the innovative company behind the world’s largest indoor vertical strawberry farm. On a mission to transform the agriculture industry through the power of smart farming, Oishii harmoniously marries nature with state-of-the-art technology to create the ideal elements—rain, air, heat, light, nourishment and natural bee pollination—for growing in-season produce all year round. Oishii’s beloved Omakase, Koyo and Nikko Berries are grown in pesticide-free vertical farms in the U.S. and proudly bear the Non-GMO Project Verified seal. Founded in 2016, Oishii’s investors include SPARX Group, NTT, Yaskawa, McWin Capital Partners, and Resilience Reserve. Oishii was recognized as one of Fast Company’s “World’s Most Innovative Companies” in 2022.

Today, Oishii operates farms and research facilities across the United States and Japan, bringing together expertise from both countries to advance the future of agriculture. As a Japanese-founded company with global ambitions, we are building a world-class team dedicated to transforming how premium produce is grown and delivered. For more information, visit www.oishii.com.

new_jobs.title: Embedded Firmware Engineer
new_jobs.description:
**Company Overview**

Ideal Vacuum is an established scientific and industrial vacuum equipment company whose products support universities, laboratories, research facilities, and aerospace customers. Its team manufactures environmental testing systems and contributes to research and technological advancement.

**Job Overview**

Ideal Vacuum Products is seeking an experienced embedded firmware engineer to develop and support firmware for vacuum, spectroscopy, and other scientific and industrial equipment. You will help build our next generation of products using 32-bit Arm-based microcontrollers, work closely with our electrical engineering team, and keep released products reliable through careful debugging, testing, and updates.

Our newer PCB designs use STMicroelectronics STM32 microcontrollers. STM32 experience is strongly preferred, and we also welcome candidates with solid production firmware experience on comparable 32-bit Arm platforms. We value strong embedded C/C++ fundamentals and the ability to learn new devices and development tools.

Alongside new development, you will help maintain existing Atmel-based products and Atmel Studio projects. This includes adapting firmware when PCB components change, resolving production bugs, and verifying that updates work with the supported hardware revisions.

**Responsibilities**

* **Develop new product firmware.** Write clear, maintainable embedded C/C++ for 32-bit Arm-based microcontrollers, including STM32-based products. Implement device interfaces, measurement and control functions, and communications, and work with electrical engineers during board bring-up.
* **Troubleshoot production problems.** Reproduce failures, trace root causes, and fix existing code. Use in-circuit debuggers, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and diagnostic logs to distinguish firmware, hardware, and interaction problems.
* **Support PCB revisions.** Work with electrical engineers when a component is replaced or a board is improved. Compare device behavior and update drivers, initialization, pin assignments, timing, calibration, or communications as needed. Support firmware ports when microcontrollers change.
* **Test changes thoroughly.** Verify fixes on actual hardware, test normal and failure conditions, and check for regressions. Confirm compatibility with each supported board revision and document the results.
* **Make releases reproducible.** Maintain source control, build instructions, firmware version records, hardware compatibility information, and production programming instructions so the correct tested code reaches each board.
* **Work closely with the team.** Collaborate with electrical engineers, software developers, scientists, technicians, and manufacturing staff. Explain findings clearly and balance new development with timely support for production.

**Experience**

* **STM32 development tools such as STM32CubeIDE or STM32CubeMX**, and familiarity with vendor peripheral libraries or register-level programming.
* **Bare-metal firmware, an RTOS**, bootloaders, firmware updates, or robust handling of persistent settings.
* **Maintaining Atmel/Microchip AVR or SAM** codebases and existing Atmel Studio or Microchip Studio projects.
* **Production test fixtures,** automated regression testing, or Python/PC-side tools that support firmware development and manufacturing.
* Scientific instruments, industrial controls, sensor interfaces, precision measurements, or serial communications.

**What You Will Bring**

* Demonstrated professional experience developing and maintaining firmware for released hardware products, including 32-bit microcontrollers.
* Experience developing firmware for Arm-based MCUs. STM32 experience is strongly preferred; comparable 32-bit Arm experience is welcome.
* Strong embedded C skills and the ability to work with C++ code as needed, including memory use, interrupts, timers, state machines, and timing-sensitive behavior.
* Practical experience with peripheral interfaces such as UART, SPI, I2C, ADCs, or PWM, and the ability to learn unfamiliar devices from their datasheets.
* Ability to read relevant schematics, follow signals through a circuit, and debug independently at the bench.
* Disciplined use of Git or comparable version control, code review, documented testing, and controlled releases.
* Clear communication, careful problem-solving, and a willingness to understand existing designs before changing them.
* A degree in computer engineering, electrical engineering, computer science, or a related field, or equivalent demonstrated professional embedded development experience.

**Why Join Ideal Vacuum**

Work alongside the people designing, building, and testing the hardware your code runs on. You will contribute to new products and see the practical results of improvements to equipment already in production.

**Compensation & Benefits**

Competitive, negotiable salary based on relevant experience.

* Health, dental, and vision insurance.
* 401(k) retirement plan.
* Paid holidays, vacation, and sick leave.

How to Apply

Email workwithus@idealvac.com with the subject **Embedded Firmware Engineer Application**.

Please include your resume and a brief, nonconfidential example of a microcontroller firmware problem you personally solved. Tell us which MCU and tools you used, what you changed, and how you verified the result on hardware. New product bring-up, a production bug, or a firmware update accompanying a PCB revision are all relevant examples.

new_jobs.description:
**Senior Electrical Engineer**

Design Review, PCB Electronics & Sustaining Engineering

**About Ideal Vacuum Products**

Ideal Vacuum Products develops and supplies vacuum equipment, components, systems, and technology for scientific and industrial applications. Our engineering work combines electronics, software, mechanical systems, and hands-on testing.

**Summary:**

Ideal Vacuum Products is seeking a senior, hands-on electrical engineer who can strengthen our engineering team and help keep successful products in production. Our engineers develop electronic controls and measurement devices for vacuum and spectroscopy applications, working alongside scientists, mechanical engineers, software engineers, and manufacturing staff.

This role has two clear priorities: improve new designs through thoughtful review and mentoring, and sustain released PCB designs when components become obsolete or difficult to obtain. We need the engineer colleagues turn to when a circuit is not behaving, a design needs experienced judgment, or a component shortage threatens production.

**Responsibilities:**

After completing on-job training, an engineer at Ideal Vacuum is:

* **Lead design reviews.** Review schematics, PCB layouts, and component selections across the electrical engineering team's projects before prototype orders and production release. Identify issues in grounding, noise, protection, derating, power distribution, thermal performance, and testability.
* **Mentor fellow engineers.** Work through difficult problems with the team, explain the reasoning behind your recommendations, and help engineers build stronger design and troubleshooting skills.
* **Keep production boards buildable.** Track component lifecycle status, manufacturer change/discontinuance notices, and approved alternatives. Identify supply risks early and help prevent avoidable redesigns and production interruptions.
* **Qualify replacement components.** Compare datasheets and application requirements, evaluate electrical and thermal behavior, and verify package, pinout, timing, and firmware implications. Determine whether a substitution is truly drop-in or requires circuit, layout, or software changes.
* **Validate and release changes.** Use circuit analysis, simulation, and bench testing to verify replacements and revisions. Maintain accurate board BOMs, approved alternatives, schematics, revision records, and clear production change instructions.

**What We’re Doing**

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join our team in Owego, New York, supporting the Launched Effects Family of Systems (LE FoS). You will play a key role in implementing technical solutions, developing mission-system software, defining software and hardware interfaces, supporting verification activities, and contributing to system checkout.

This role focuses on creating software solutions for complex, collaborative-autonomy-enabled small UAS applications, including Group 1 and 2 UAV development and airborne launch operations. You will work closely with systems, hardware, and integration and test engineers to develop reliable software that operates on real mission systems and supports flight-ready capabilities.

**The Work**

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will develop mission-system software and simulation infrastructure to support capability-based testing. You will also support system checkout, troubleshoot defects, and drive issues to closure. Your work will help make collaborative autonomy and autonomous teaming capabilities reliable, testable, and ready for operational use.

* Design, implement, and test embedded C/C++ mission-system software for small UAS and launch systems.
* Develop device drivers and interfaces for ARINC 429, MIL-STD-1553, RS-422, and Ethernet.

* Support laboratory and system checkout, troubleshoot defects, and drive them to closure.

**Please Note**

* U.S. citizenship is required.

You are comfortable with a scope, a serial console, and Wireshark. * Experience developing and debugging software that interfaces with hardware.
* Must be a U.S. citizen; this position will require a DoD government security clearance at the Secret level.

**Desired Skills**

* Familiarity with open-architecture initiatives and modular design standards, such as FACE, OMS, and SOSA.
* Familiarity with safety-critical software development processes, such as DO-178C.
