### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, or a related STEM field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in software development, systems programming, or applied ML engineering or equivalent education credit (e.g., internships, student research, pre-graduate working experience).
* 5 years of experience designing and launching large-scale production software products or foundation AI systems.
* 5 years of experience testing, and launching software products, and with full stack development, across back-end such as Java, Python, Golang, or C++ codebases.
* 3 years of experience leading software design and system architecture for high-throughput distributed systems, foundation model runtimes, or client applications.
3 years of experience with performance, system architecture, large-scale systems data analysis, visualization tools, debugging.  

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Robotics, or a related technical field.
* 5 years of experience in a technical leadership role setting technical direction and guiding project teams.
* 3 years of experience driving complex cross-functional initiatives across research, engineering, product management, and UX design in complex matrixed environments.
* Experience developing, evaluating, or serving large language models, agentic workflows, multimodal pipelines, or AI runtime APIs (e.g., PyTorch, JAX, Triton, vLLM, Gemini API).

**About the job**
-----------------

At Google DeepMind our mission is to build the world's first general-purpose learning agent. Central to this mission is the complex task of measuring the intelligence of our prototypes. As a Software Engineer, you will be working with the cutting edge AI agents developed by our exceptional team of Machine Learning and Neuroscience research scientists. Your responsibilities will include everything from creating systems for agent testing using 2D and 3D games to developing test problems within physics simulators. You will create graphical visualization of results, build competitive agent leaderboards and test new algorithms on robots. To succeed in this role you will need to have a strong foundation in software engineering and enjoy working on a wide range of challenging problems within a mission-driven team.

The Growth and Discovery team powers the Gemini app's growth engine and crafts discovery experiences for users. This mission blends traditional growth engineering—focused on acquisition, and activation —with the complex technical task of "Discovery," which involves engineering the systems that empower users to explore and maximize the potential of AI.

Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority.

We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort.

* Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Design, and Research teams to translate ambiguous requirements into concrete technical solutions.
* Develop simple, reusable, and scalable code libraries and frameworks to accelerate product development.
* Iterate rapidly on product prototypes and features, balancing development velocity with a high standard of code quality and craft.

new_jobs.description:
L3Harris is dedicated to recruiting and developing high-performing talent who are passionate about what they do. Our employees are unified in a shared dedication to our customers’ mission and quest for professional growth. L3Harris provides an inclusive, engaging environment designed to empower employees and promote work-life success. Fundamental to our culture is an unwavering focus on values, dedication to our communities, and commitment to excellence in everything we do.

L3Harris is the Trusted Disruptor in defense tech. With customers’ mission-critical needs always in mind, our employees deliver end-to-end technology solutions connecting the space, air, land, sea and cyber domains in the interest of national security.

**Job Title: Associate, Electrical Engineer**

**Job Code: 47145**

**Job Location: Rochester, NY**

**Job Schedule: 9/80: Employees work 9 out of every 14 days – totaling 80 hours worked, and have every other Friday off.**

**Job Description:**

* Prepare component drawings and specifications for highly complex products that may be electro-optical, opto-mechanical or electro-mechanical in nature
* Provide support to engineering and purchasing for procurement and selection of parts and materials, prepare nonstandard part and material submittals, interface and work with inside and outside labs to interpret test results and define testing for the purposes of assuring that parts are compliant to requirements
* Effectively communicate with program engineers, management, and customers on technical issues and status of work
* Present results of analysis to program engineers and customers on a regular basis to ensure proper interpretation and understanding
* Act as a technical consultant in areas of expertise and to perform technical reviews of material/component quality documentation including supplier data, test results, etc. to assure conformance to stated requirements.
* Follow established procedures and specific, detailed instructions and/or guidance from more senior functional staff

**Digital Engineering**

* Design, analyze, modify, test and evaluate FPGA and programmable hardware
* Design complex Circuit Card Assemblies to support Avionics and Space customer’s photonic subsystems and integrated communication systems
* Digital Design requires programmable logic, VHDL language and digital communications systems knowledge
* Modem Design (including SATCOM, wireless, cellular and software defined radios) requires knowledge of digital communications systems, waveform generation and signal processing, FPGA design (in VHDL) and familiarity with Digital Signal Processors chips
* DSP design positions require knowledge of digital signal processing techniques, algorithm development, software coding and simulation/modeling using MATLAB
* Microelectronics Design requires training in advanced electronics packaging and MEMS technology
  + Experience with high density interconnect and semiconductor packaging technology is desired
  + Determine design approaches and parameters
  + Perform system analysis to determine feasibility of design within time and cost constraints
  + Utilize modeling tools and equipment to establish operating data, conduct experimental tests, and evaluate results
  + Select components and equipment based on analysis of specifications and reliability
  + Perform simulations and present design reviews to peer engineers
  + Ability to write scripts to control synthesis and build tool

**RF Engineering**

* RF/Microwave Device testing and evaluation including s-parameter, large signal load pull characterization as well as modulated signal measurements
* Must have familiarity with common commercial RF design and analysis tools to design and analyze RF circuits and systems (i.e. ADS, HFSS, CST, MATLAB, etc)
* Determine design approaches and parameters. Analyze electrical requirements to determine feasibility of design within time and cost constraints. Analyze equipment to establish operating data, conducts experimental tests and evaluates results

**Photonics Engineering**

* Design, analyze, modify, test and evaluate optical communications systems and subsystem level components
* Design, analyze, modify, test and evaluate RF Photonic systems and subsystem level components

**Antenna Engineering**

* Design, analyze, modify, test, and evaluate antenna systems and subsystem level components. Utilize design tools such as HFSS, CST, MATLAB, and GRASP
* Evaluate antennas in anechoic chambers and use network analyzers

**Hardware Design Verification**

* Design and modify tests to verify the operational state of various L3Harris products and accessories
* Test, analyze, and evaluate the requirements compliance of L3 Harris hardware products
* Utilize tools such as network analyzers and LabVIEW

**Optical Engineering**

* Perform optical design and analysis on advanced telescopes, calibrators, unique optical test sets
* Develop optical budgets and sensitivities including wavefront error, MTF, line of sight, and throughput
* Perform analyses to show compliance to optical requirements and specifications for imaging systems, assemblies, component drawings, coatings, etc.
* Perform tolerancing analyses to assess manufacturability and optical alignment
* Provide optical modeling, analysis and metrology support during system alignment, integration and testing
* Perform other unique modeling tasks, such as: spectral tuning/splitting, polarization, phase retrieval, image simulation, etc.
* Support the development of optical technologies and architectural concepts to support the company’s current and new business opportunities

**Qualifications:**

* To be eligible, applicants must be pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical & Computer Engineering, Materials Engineering, Materials Science Engineering or related field or have completed their Bachelor’s degree within the last 12 months, regardless of age.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Kno

new_jobs.title: Principal Systems Engineer
new_jobs.description:
**Job Description**  

Thank you for your interest in BAE Systems! We are hiring systems engineers at all experience levels to grow our Engine Controls team within Controls and Avionics Solutions (CAS).

These positions will be located at our Endicott, NY and Austin, TX locations. If your background and skillset align with our hiring needs, we will be in touch with next steps. If selected for an interview, we will discuss specific opportunities that match your interests and skillset with the hiring team.
  
  
It’s about the journey! Whether it’s a bus ride or flight, our electronic systems help transport millions of passengers every day. Every second a plane takes off somewhere in the world, enabled by our flight-critical products. On the ground, our electric and hybrid solutions save more than 22 million gallons of fuel per year. Be part of our journey at BAE Systems where you’ll be among the brightest minds, working on the industry’s most difficult problems. Drawing strength from our differences, we’re innovating for the future. And you can, too.
  
  
At BAE Systems, we promote a strong, collaborative culture and provide our employees with the tools, skills and training they need to succeed. We are all about trust, camaraderie, and a shared mission on delivering world class products to our commercial and military customers. We offer a flexible hybrid work environment and 9/80 work schedule. Our company is part of the community and driven to improve our future and protect our freedom.
  
  
We are hiring systems engineers at the individual contributor, team lead, chief engineer and technical director levels to participate in Electronic Systems development programs at any of the locations listed above. As a Systems Engineer, you will be a member of a cross-functional, multi-disciplinary team to model, design, develop, integrate, debug, test, field, and support our innovative Electronic Systems.

  
  
**Required Education, Experience, & Skills**  

* Bachelor Degree in Technical discipline or equivalent and 6+ years of relevant Systems Engineering experience
* Experience in a requirements development tool such as DOORs, Jama
* Experience in SysML modeling tool such as Cameo, MagicDraw
  

  
  
**Preferred Education, Experience, & Skills**  

* Masters of Science Degree in Electrical Engineering or a related engineering discipline
* Team Leadership experience including project technical leadership and/or Systems functional leadership.
* Experience with engine controls, flight controls, mission systems, actuation control, cabin systems, aircraft electrification and battery/energy management systems.
* Experience performing requirements analysis, derivation and allocation, and translating requirements to viable concepts design solutions.
* Hands on experience with HW Integration and Test in a lab environment.
* Product development experience including requirement analysis, architecture, system design, integration and test.
* Experience applying any of the following security processes; DoD Risk Management Framework (RMF), DO-326A Airworthiness Security Process Specification or ISO-21434 Road Vehicle Security.
  

  
  
**Pay Information**
  
Full-Time Salary Range: $107359 - $182510
  
  
Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.
  
  
Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. Our leave programs include paid time off, paid holidays, as well as other types of leave, including paid parental, military, bereavement, and any applicable federal and state sick leave. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics.  
  
  
  
**About BAE Systems, Inc.**
  
BAE Systems, Inc. is a defense, aerospace, and security company headquartered in Falls Church, Virginia, with more than 40,000 employees worldwide. We serve, supply, and protect those who protect us. As one of the most geographically diverse international defense companies, we deliver a full range of products and services spanning air, land, maritime, space, and cyber, including advanced electronics, intelligence solutions, and dedicated customer support.
  
  
Our culture is performance-driven and values-led, built on curiosity, creativity, and collaboration. Purpose isn't a tagline here. It's what drives us. We're developing breakthrough technologies that defend national security and make a lasting impact on our communities and our planet. When you join BAE Systems, you're not just building a career. You're contributing to a mission that truly matters.
  
  
This position will be posted for at least 5 calendar days. The posting will remain active until the position is filled, or a qualified pool of candidates is identified.

new_jobs.description:
In accordance with Washington state law, we are highlighting our comprehensive benefits package, which is available to all eligible US based employees.

Benefits for this role include:  

* Health, dental, vision, life, disability insurance
* Retirement Benefits: 401(k) with company match
* Paid Time Off: 20 days of vacation per year, accruing at a rate of 6.15 hours per pay period for the first five years of employment
* Sick Time: 40 hours/year (increased to 69 hours/year for Seattle) including 5 discretionary sick days per instance
* Maternity Leave (Short-Term Disability + Baby Bonding): 28-30 weeks
* Baby Bonding Leave: 18 weeks
* Holidays: 13 paid days per year

  
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Mountain View, CA, USA; New York, NY, USA; Seattle, WA, USA**.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in software development.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience with Apache Spark, Flink, Beam, Airflow, or BigQuery/Snowflake or other similar infrastructure.
* Experience developing, debugging, and supporting large-scale data pipelines.
* Experience with distributed data processing frameworks and workflow orchestration tools.
* Experience in Go/C++.
* Experience in a technical Lead or similar role, ideally setting technical direction for a small group of executive and junior software engineer.
* Ability to address daily business data requirements, ensure that development obstacles are cleared to maintain the Gemini App's changing growth.

**About the job**
-----------------

As a part of the Gemini Apps Data Engineering team, you will architect and operate the data pipelines that deliver critical telemetry across all Gemini surfaces. You will combine deep technical expertise with Google-scale operating experience to solve the unique data issues inherent in building a transformative, global product during a time of massive growth!

Gemini’s user base is growing continuously and our traffic has sometimes even doubled just over the course of a week. In this role, you will provide the technical leadership necessary to scale our infrastructure. You will architect durable data products and drive critical engineering initiatives across multiple teams to ensure we continue delivering metrics and training data quickly, reliably, and accurately at a massive global scale.  
  
In this role, you will leverage your experience in building and running scalable systems, and utilize modern data warehouse infrastructure at Google, lead a small team of executive and junior engineers to scale the data pipelines that drive Gemini Apps’s analytics and power model and product improvement. You will work directly with key stakeholders, including our Data Science, model release, model quality, and feature teams, as well as teams across DeepMind, to identify and solve key problems to help make Gemini the next billion-user product.

Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority.

We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $207000 - $300000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Work closely with our Data Science counterparts in definition and driving the goals for a Modern Data Warehouse.
* Architect and build scalable batch and real-time pipelines that power experimentation, product analytics, and ML/AI training loops.

We are seeking a motivated individual with strong instrumentation and controls experience to join our team as a **Control Systems Engineer** at the **Drayton** factory. The purpose of this position is to identify, recommend, and implement control and instrumentation changes to increase factory throughput and sugar recovery in addition to reducing processing costs. Optimize current automation of factory operations and assist in needs assessment, analysis, recommendation, development, and installation of future factory automation capital projects.

**The principal accountabilities of these positions include, but are not limited to:**

* Lead and promote a positive work culture through Company Values of Safety, Integrity, Quality, Teamwork, and Accountability.
* Designs instrumentation and control systems; develops the electrical design for batch and continuous process controls, specifications for process instrumentation, VFD, and control valves. Develops control systems documentation, including Process and Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs), loop wiring diagrams, specifications, manuals, PLC programs, and HMI configuration. This position works with OPC communication between factory and business systems and industrial device networks.
* Researches and recommends methods to enhance the utilization of automation and computer control systems. Consults with the Factory Engineer and/or Process Engineer on capital process improvements and make appropriate recommendations and program changes. Also consults with the Maintenance Engineer and Electrical & Instrumentation Supervisor regarding the maintenance of control systems and Process Engineers to achieve optimum processing efficiency. Provides technical expertise in the maintenance of control systems.
* Oversees the optimization of current controls systems and ensures systems are finely tuned and working at optimum levels. The automation of factory operations involves participation in the needs assessment analysis, recommendation, development, and installation of future factory automation capital projects. These are key responsibilities.
* Oversees the support of PLC and process control systems.
* Works with the factory maintenance and other engineers to analyze, recommend equipment specifications and selection, install new equipment, recommend process improvements, and debug processes. Evaluates projects and equipment to determine life cycle benefits and return-on-investment.
* Provides general control systems and instrumentation training for factory employees to effectively prepare factory personnel to successfully operate electrical, instrumentation, and control equipment.
* Assists with the startup of the factories and often have involvement in numerous projects with multiple contractors and factory labor which finish just before factory startup.
Operates within budget and schedule; completing capital jobs on schedule to allow for factory start-up is critical.  

To be successful in this position requires knowledge of instrumentation and electronic controls typically gained through the completion of a Bachelor’s degree in electrical or control engineering or computer science. Knowledge and prior industrial experience in Delta V, industrial networking and device networks, AutoCAD and other computer drafting and design software, computer programming, process modeling, and control systems programming is desirable. Description:

Enovation Controls is a turnkey technology company that solves complex problems and delivers innovative electronic control and display solutions across diverse markets. People who find their place here tend to stay. Many of our team members have decades of tenure, evidence of a culture where people feel valued and want to build a career.

We live our core values every day in a collaborative, high-performance environment that balances complex technical work with real camaraderie, accessible leadership, and traditions that bring teams together.

**Description**

The SVE Electrical Engineer, within the Engineering department, primarily leads Value Analysis/Value Engineering (VAVE) initiatives for production electronics while providing secondary support for sustaining engineering activities. This role partners with New Product Development during product launch and electrical design-ownership handoff, then assumes ongoing responsibility for maintaining assigned products throughout production. The engineer works cross-functionally with Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, and Product Management to identify and implement improvements that optimize cost, manufacturability, electrical performance, component availability, product quality, and reliability.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **VAVE and Cost Reduction:** Identify, validate, and implement lower-cost circuits, components, PCB assemblies, manufacturing approaches, and sourcing alternatives without sacrificing performance or reliability.
* **Electrical Design Ownership:** Assume responsibility for assigned electrical designs after launch and maintain schematics, PCB records, specifications, BOMs, and product configuration.
* **NPI and Design Handoff:** Partner with New Product Development on launch readiness, design intent, component selections, validation history, and ownership transfer.
* **Electrical Design and Components:** Modify analog/digital circuits, schematics, PCBs, interfaces, and component selections, considering availability, lifecycle, cost, and derating.
* **Validation and Manufacturing:** Support prototypes, bench testing, DFM/DFT, electrical/EMC performance evaluation, and formal engineering changes.
* **Sustaining and Root Cause:** Resolve obsolescence, supplier substitutions, factory failures, field issues, and quality problems through investigation and corrective action.
* **Cross-Functional Execution:** Develop VAVE business cases and coordinate technical changes with Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, Product Management, and suppliers.

Requirements:

* Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or a related field.
* Minimum 5 years of electrical/electronic product-design and development experience; VAVE and sustaining engineering experience preferred.
* Electronic product-design experience with schematic capture and PCB design tools.
* Knowledge of analog and digital circuit design, troubleshooting techniques, component selection, and PCB fabrication and assembly processes.
* Experience with test instruments, electrical validation, DFM/DFT, and root-cause analysis.
* Ability to execute VAVE changes, qualify alternate components, and control product documentation and engineering changes.
* Strong ownership, project prioritization, communication, and cross-functional problem-solving skills.

**Preferred**

* Familiarity with Altium Designer for schematic capture and PCB design.
* Experience using Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems for schematics, BOMs, configuration, and engineering changes.
* Knowledge of ruggedized electronics, embedded controllers, displays, power, CAN/J1939, Ethernet, and EMC/EMI.
* Background in environmental testing, component obsolescence, alternate-source qualification, or high-volume manufacturing processes.

We tackle complex work with high expectations and a learning mindset. Our culture is fun and rewarding, and we consistently rank among the best places to work in manufacturing. We back that culture with solid benefits: a strong 401(k) match, cost-effective healthcare options that meaningfully reduce out-of-pocket costs, wellness support, and profit-sharing that rewards collective success.

*We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity. All employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business need.*

new_jobs.title: Systems Engineer- Navy Submarine Combat Systems
new_jobs.description:
Arcfield Overview: Arcfield was purpose-built to relentlessly protect the nation and its allies from today’s national security threats. We have nearly 70 years of proven expertise and excel in space superiority, hypersonic defense and nuclear deterrence, digital transformation, and surface and undersea warfare domains. Our solution areas include space mission engineering, atmospheric science, digital engineering, mission assurance, and advances in modeling and simulation that together with our enterprise-wide adoption of artificial intelligence and machine learning, lead to better systems and timely, reliable decision-making. Headquartered in Chantilly, VA with 18 North American offices, Arcfield employs 2,200 engineers, scientists, analysts, IT specialists and other professionals who challenge the status quo to deliver an efficient technological advantage to our national security and defense partners. Responsibilities:

Arcfield is seeking a motivated, technically minded individual transitioning from the U.S. Navy to support the future development of the Navy’s AN/BYG-1 Submarine Combat Control System. This position is well suited for junior Sailors with experience in submarine Fire Control, SONAR, combat systems, weapons systems, or related technical ratings who want to apply their fleet experience in a civilian engineering environment.

You will work alongside experienced engineers, Navy veterans, and technical specialists to support the research, development, testing, and evaluation of submarine combat systems. Your firsthand understanding of submarine operations, equipment, maintenance, and fleet procedures will help the team develop and improve capabilities that support the warfighter. On-the-job training and mentorship will help you build your technical knowledge and grow your career in defense engineering.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Apply Navy experience and technical training to support the development and improvement of submarine combat systems.
* Assist engineering teams in evaluating system requirements, operational procedures, and potential improvements to submarine combat capabilities.
* Support testing, troubleshooting, equipment evaluations, and technical demonstrations in laboratory and operational environments.
* Help develop and review technical documents, test procedures, training materials, and operational guides.
* Participate in technical reviews, operational experiments, and test events alongside experienced engineers and fleet personnel.
* Share firsthand knowledge of submarine operations, equipment, and watchstanding procedures to help engineers understand fleet needs.
* Support evaluations of submarine weapons systems, sonar, combat control capabilities, and emerging technologies.
* Work with senior engineers, technical leads, and program personnel to track project activities, document results, and communicate findings.
* Learn engineering processes, system requirements, configuration management, and testing practices through hands-on experience and mentorship.
* Contribute to a team environment built on accountability, attention to detail, technical growth, and mission success.

At Arcfield, we understand that flexibility matters. While this position requires onsite support at our Newport, RI location, we offer flexible work schedules that allow employees to balance personal commitments with professional responsibilities. Candidates must be local or willing to relocate.

Qualifications:

* BS 0-2 Years of HS 6-8 additional technical training, military schools, or relevant certifications are a plus
* Must possess and maintain an active U.S. Government Secret security clearance.
* U.S. Navy experience in a submarine, combat systems, Fire Control, SONAR, electronics, weapons, or related technical field.
* Working knowledge of submarine operations, equipment, maintenance procedures, or combat systems gained through military training or fleet experience.
* Ability to follow technical procedures, identify problems, document findings, and work effectively as part of a team.
* Strong attention to detail, willingness to learn, and commitment to mission readiness and equipment reliability.
* Basic computer skills and the ability to learn new technical tools and systems.
* Ability to communicate clearly with teammates, engineers, and government personnel.
* This position offers transitioning Sailors an opportunity to turn their military training and operational experience into a long-term civilian career supporting the U.S. Navy. Successful candidates will gain hands-on exposure to engineering, system testing, technical documentation, and future submarine combat capabilities while learning from experienced engineers and former fleet personnel.

Equal Pay Act: This is the projected compensation range for this position. There are differentiating factors that can impact a final salary/hourly rate, including, but not limited to, Contract Wage Determination, relevant work experience, skills and competencies that align to the specified role, geographic location (For Remote Opportunities), education and certifications as well as Federal Government Contract Labor categories. In addition, Arcfield invests in its employees beyond just compensation. new_jobs.description:
**Computer Systems Engineer - Tier 1**

**Company:** Kota Technology

**Location:** Sioux Falls, SD

**About The Role:** Are you a responsive problem-solver who excels at helping users get back to work quickly? Kota Technology is hiring a Level 1 Service Desk Engineer to be the first line of support for our growing client base. You'll own ticket triage, first response, and resolution of routine IT issues—and you'll be measured on how effectively you resolve issues at your level, not on how many you pass up.

This is a full-time, in-office position with occasional onsite visits to client locations. Your work directly impacts client satisfaction and Kota's reputation for responsive, dependable support.

**About Kota Technology:** Kota Technology is a leading Healthcare Managed Services Provider and expanding into various commercial businesses. We serve over 50 medical and dental practices across South Dakota, North Dakota, Minnesota, and Nebraska.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Respond to incoming support tickets, calls, and emails within SLA targets; set correct Priority and Work Type at intake
* Resolve routine, documented issues end-to-end: password resets, account lockouts, printer troubleshooting, connectivity problems
* Execute user onboarding and offboarding tasks from checklist to completion
* Manage basic Microsoft 365 administration: create accounts, assign licenses, manage mailboxes and groups
* Keep clients informed throughout ticket resolution with clear, professional communication
* Document work thoroughly: what was done, who it was discussed with, troubleshooting steps, and resolution
* Perform onsite support at client locations when scheduled (hardware installs, equipment swaps, hands-on troubleshooting)

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING:**

* Strong customer service mindset—you genuinely want to help users solve their problems
* Attention to detail and disciplined documentation habits (this is critical at Kota)
* Ability to troubleshoot methodically and follow procedures consistently
* Comfort working independently and asking for help when an issue is beyond your scope
* Basic technical foundation in Windows, Active Directory, Microsoft 365, and network connectivity
* Reliable transportation and willingness to travel within our service area for onsite work
* Ability to lift and move IT equipment up to 50 lbs

**WHAT YOU'LL GET:**

* A clear career ladder: L1 → L1.5 (Field Support) → L2 → L2.5 → L3, with advancement based on demonstrated skills
* Mentorship and runbooks to help you grow
* A role where good work is recognized—strong L1 engineers resolve the bulk of issues cleanly at their level
* Full-time employment with a growing company

**THE OPPORTUNITY:**

This is an entry or intermediate-level IT support role ideal for someone who wants to build a career in managed services. Success here isn't about volume—it's about clean, complete ticket resolution, professional client interactions, and taking ownership of your work. L1 is the foundation of Kota's service experience, and strong performers move quickly into field-based roles and beyond.

**WORK ARRANGEMENT:**

In-office with occasional onsite visits to client locations. A valid driver's license and reliable transportation required.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Experience in healthcare IT environments
* Understanding of HIPAA compliance requirements
* CompTIA A+, Network+, or similar certifications
* Experience with remote support tools (TeamViewer, ConnectWise, etc.)
* Knowledge of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP)
* Experience with cable management and structured cabling
* Familiarity with antivirus and security software
* Experience with ticketing systems
* Previous experience with onsite IT installations or project work

**Physical Requirements:**

* Ability to lift and carry equipment weighing up to 50 pounds
* Comfortable working with ladders, drills, and other power tools
* Ability to crawl under desks, climb ladders, and work in tight spaces
* Capable of bending, kneeling, and standing for extended periods
* Able to work in varying environments including server rooms, construction sites, and medical facilities
* Comfortable driving to multiple client locations daily, sometimes in adverse weather conditions

**Candidates with More Experience:** While this position is classified as Tier 1, we encourage candidates with more extensive experience to apply. Salary ranges and responsibilities will be adjusted accordingly based on skill level and experience. We're open to discussing how your background could fit within our team structure.

**What We Offer:**

* Competitive salary based on experience
* Paid time off

We have an exciting opportunity for a **Embedded Software Engineer** to join the JETSII Contract with GeoControls, a teammate company!

  

Design, develop, integrate, test, and deliver embedded software for spacecraft flight and ground systems in support of the NASA Johnson Space Center Engineering Directorate. This position covers the full software development life cycle, from requirements definition and architecture through design, implementation, verification, deployment, and sustainment, for flight and ground hardware projects. The ideal candidate is a hands-on engineer who is comfortable owning software from concept to delivered hardware, working closely with hardware and electronics designers, and delivering high-quality, well-documented products.

  

The **Embedded Software Engineer** will:

* Perform full life cycle development of embedded software for spacecraft flight and ground systems, including requirements analysis, architecture, detailed design, coding, integration, test, verification, deployment, and operational support
* Develop, refine, and maintain software requirements derived from system and subsystem requirements, with bi-directional traceability through design, implementation, and verification
* Design and implement embedded C/C++ flight and ground software for functions such as subsystem monitoring and control, command and data handling, telemetry and commanding, and fault detection, isolation, and recovery
* Develop device drivers and hardware interfaces to flight and ground electronics, including sensors, ADCs, and serial and bus interfaces (e.g., SPI, I2C, CAN, UART, RS-422)
* Develop software using Core Flight System (cFS) where possible and applicable
* Collaborate with hardware and electronics design engineers on hardware/software interface definition, board bring-up, integration, and troubleshooting using lab equipment such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and JTAG debuggers
* Develop and execute unit, integration, and system-level tests, including simulation-based and hardware-in-the-loop testing; develop test automation, analyze results, and identify, debug, and resolve defects
* Author software life cycle documentation scaled to project needs, such as software management and development plans, interface control documents, design descriptions, test plans, procedures, and reports, and version description documents
* Ensure adherence to JSC standard software process practices and tailor NASA NPR 7150.2 requirements to the software classification and project scope
* Support software safety activities for safety-critical software in accordance with NASA-STD-8739.8, including software hazard analysis support and implementation of safety-related requirements
* Apply configuration management, defect tracking, static analysis, and code coverage practices to maintain software quality and traceability
* Support hardware/software integration and qualification testing, including test setup, data collection, and data analysis
* Participate as a key member of project teams, collaborating with systems engineers, hardware designers, and internal or outsourced development partners across multiple NASA programs and projects to deliver reliable, cost-effective, and high-quality solutions

Perform other duties as assigned

Strong problem-solving, organizational, and technical communication skills.

new_jobs.description:
At Atom Computing, we build quantum computers using arrays of optically trapped neutral atoms that will empower customers to achieve unprecedented computational breakthroughs. Join a world-class team of scientists, engineers, and business professionals to advance the state-of-the-art in quantum computing.

We are seeking a Senior Silicon Systems Engineer to bridge the gap between custom silicon and highly complex hardware integration within Atom’s research and product development programs. This role would be responsible for defining system requirements, architecture design, and system level testing across the chip, PCBs, and auxiliary hardware subsystems.

The ideal candidate can translate requirements into a coherent system architecture and has experience applying systems engineering best practices to emerging technologies.

### **Job Responsibilities**

### **Architecture & Design Integration**

* Develop and document system architecture, including subsystem interactions
* Produce system-level design documentation and interface control documents (ICDs), including the chip–PCB–controller boundaries
* Lead chip-level system specs with ASIC designers, analyzing trade-offs across silicon, PCB, and software

### **System Definition & Requirements Management**

* Develop specifications for ASICs, PCBs, controllers, and supporting hardware based on research goals maintaining clear traceability to system-level requirements.
* Work with engineers to translate measured performance, limitations, and operational experience into requirements for PCBs, controllers, RF/analog electronics, and auxiliary hardware.
* Manage change control processes for evolving architectures and requirements.

### **Risk Management & Technical Planning**

* Identify, quantify, and track technical risks, opportunities, and mitigations
* Engage in ASIC architectural reviews and tape-out readiness milestones, evaluating system-level implications of engineering modifications alongside silicon risks including respins, IP integration, and schedule impact.

### **Integration, Verification, and Validation (IV&V)**

* Link pre-silicon verification coverage and post-silicon bring-up and characterization results back to system-level requirements
* Plan system-level integration of the ASIC into PCBs and auxiliary hardware, including bring-up sequencing

### **Collaboration & Communication**

* Act as technical liaison between Theory, Quantum Engineering, Hardware, Software, Controls, ASIC Design and Verification, and Optical Engineering
* Support customer interactions, including government program reviews, technical interchange meetings, and milestone reporting.

### **Experience & Education**

* BS or higher in Systems Engineering, Physics, Electrical Engineering, Optical Engineering or a related field
* 5+ years of systems engineering experience in complex, multidisciplinary R&D or production environments (quantum, aerospace, defense, advanced computing, or similar)

### **Required Qualifications**

* Proven ability to lead requirements development, interface control, and V&V planning across engineering and science disciplines
* Experience with system architecture, requirements management tools, and configuration management systems
* Demonstrated experience with risk management frameworks
Experience with silicon integration  

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced degree (MS or PhD) in engineering, physics, or a related discipline
* Familiarity with quantum computing, atomic and optical (AMO) physics, or control system integration
* Experience preparing and presenting SRR/PDR/CDR artifacts
* Experience supporting government-funded research or procurement programs (DoD, DoE, DoC)

Atom Computing provides a wide variety of perks and benefits, including fully paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for our employees and their dependents. Additionally, unlimited paid time off, 401K company matching, short- and long-term disability, FSA, dependent care benefits, and life insurance. **ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.**

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.

Responsibilities:

**THE ROLE:**

AMD is seeking a hands-on Digital Marketing Manager focused on DAM Platform Engineering to design, configure, and extend AMD Amplify, our enterprise digital asset management platform powered by Orange Logic. Embedded within the DAM team, this role owns technical implementation from requirements and solution design through configuration, testing, production release, and ongoing optimization. The role builds advanced configurations, workflow automations, API integrations, and reusable interface configurations.

**THE PERSON:**

You bring independent troubleshooting skills and disciplined change management practices to deliver reliable, maintainable solutions for content discovery, governance, and distribution. You can translate complex business requirements into technical solutions, manage competing priorities, and communicate implementation decisions clearly.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

*Orange Logic Configuration and Solution Design:*

* Configure Orange Logic metadata schemas, record relationships, taxonomies, security profiles, permissions, and asset lifecycle rules using authorized administrative and backend tools.
* Translate business requirements into technical specifications, configuration designs, dependency assessments, and acceptance criteria; evaluate implementation feasibility and tradeoffs.
* Configure conditional logic, metadata validation, search filters, navigation, and personalized views to support different audiences and access requirements.
* Build and maintain CMS pages, Guides, Spaces, templates, and reusable HTML/CSS components that meet accessibility, brand, and platform standards.

*Workflow Automation and API Integrations:*

* Build event-driven workflows, conditional actions, approval routing, and automations for content intake, metadata enrichment, localization, and distribution.
* Configure REST API calls, webhooks, and JSON data mappings to connect Amplify with other systems; implement authentication, error handling, and retry behavior appropriate to each integration.
* Develop JavaScript or Python utilities for API interactions, bulk metadata updates, data validation, and repetitive operational tasks.
* Validate asset identifiers, metadata mappings, and lifecycle changes across connected systems; troubleshoot synchronization failures and data inconsistencies.

*Testing, Troubleshooting, and Release Management:*

* Diagnose configuration, workflow, permission, and integration defects using application logs, API responses, browser developer tools, and reproducible test cases.
* Create and execute functional, regression, and permission tests; coordinate user acceptance testing and resolve defects before release.
* Manage configuration changes through testing and production release, documenting dependencies, deployment steps, rollback procedures, and post-release validation.
* Assess vendor upgrades for configuration and integration compatibility; investigate performance issues and implement fixes with AMD IT and Orange Logic.

*Technical Collaboration and Delivery:*

* Serve as the DAM team's embedded technical resource for solution design, implementation estimates, dependencies, and hands-on delivery of platform enhancements.
* Partner with DAM governance owners, marketing teams, IT, security, and Orange Logic to define implementation standards and resolve technical constraints.
* Maintain configuration inventories, integration mappings, technical documentation, and support runbooks; transfer knowledge to administrators and support teams.
* Prioritize the technical backlog with program leadership and measure delivery cycle time, automation impact, platform reliability, and search effectiveness.

**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:**

* Extensive experience in enterprise application implementation, platform configuration, technical consulting, or solutions engineering, including hands-on delivery in production environments.
* Hands-on Orange Logic implementation experience and advanced administrative configuration experience across metadata, permissions, workflows, search, and CMS capabilities.
* Demonstrated ability to independently design, configure, test, and troubleshoot complex platform solutions and explain their dependencies and limitations.
* Experience implementing and troubleshooting REST APIs, JSON payloads, webhooks, authentication, and data mappings using Postman or equivalent tools.
* Proficiency in HTML/CSS and working knowledge of JavaScript or Python for integrations, scripting, and automation.
* Experience with regression testing, controlled releases, root cause analysis, and technical documentation for enterprise applications.
* Ability to translate complex business requirements into technical solutions, manage competing priorities, and communicate implementation decisions clearly.

**ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Information Science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience with demonstrated technical implementation impact.

new_jobs.title: Power Electronics Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Power Electronics Engineer Position at Tri Technology, Inc.

**Location:** Orem, Utah

**Schedule:** Full-Time | On-Site | Monday–Friday

Join an exciting, growing engineering company passionate about creating cutting-edge technology and bringing innovative products to life. If you're an experienced Power Electronics Engineer, a natural problem-solver, and a self-starter who enjoys tackling challenging designs in a collaborative, creative environment, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

We're seeking a talented and experienced **Power Electronics Engineer** to play a key role in designing, developing, and bringing innovative electronic products from concept to production for our clients.

In this hands-on position, you'll design and develop power electronics systems, including inverters, DC/DC converters, and isolated switched-mode power supplies (SMPS), with a focus on power conversion applications in the 1–20 kW range.

We're looking for a versatile, resourceful engineer with strong electrical engineering fundamentals who can independently take ownership of complex designs, solve technical challenges, and drive projects forward without relying on a large supporting engineering team.

This role offers opportunities for creativity, technical ownership, and professional growth while working on a diverse range of exciting products and technologies.

**This is a full-time, on-site position at our Orem, Utah facility, Monday through Friday. Applicants must currently reside in Utah.**

Key Responsibilities

* **Power Electronics Design:** Design, develop, and optimize power conversion systems, including inverters, DC/DC converters, and isolated switched-mode power supplies (SMPS), particularly in the 1–20 kW range.
* **Electrical Engineering & Circuit Design:** Develop circuit architectures, schematics, and PCB layouts, including power stages, control circuits, gate drivers, protection circuits, and supporting electronics.
* **Independent Product Development:** Take ownership of electrical designs from initial requirements and concept development through prototyping, testing, refinement, and production readiness.
* **Analysis & Component Selection:** Perform circuit analysis, design calculations, simulations, and component selection to optimize performance, efficiency, reliability, and cost.
* **Prototyping & Testing:** Build, test, troubleshoot, and refine electronic prototypes using appropriate laboratory equipment and engineering methods.
* **Technical Problem-Solving:** Identify and resolve complex electrical design challenges, evaluate engineering tradeoffs, and develop practical, reliable solutions.
* **Cross-Disciplinary Collaboration:** Work with mechanical engineers, firmware developers, and other team members to integrate electrical designs into complete, functional products.
* **Client Collaboration:** Participate in technical discussions with clients, help define engineering requirements, communicate design decisions, and support product development efforts.
* **Documentation & Manufacturing Support:** Develop and maintain schematics, PCB design files, BOMs, test procedures, and other documentation necessary for prototyping and manufacturing.

What We're Looking For

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a closely related field, or equivalent demonstrated engineering expertise.
* 3–5+ years of professional experience in electrical engineering design, with significant hands-on experience in power electronics.
* **Demonstrated experience designing power conversion systems in the 1–20 kW range**, including inverters, DC/DC converters, or similar high-power applications.
* Strong knowledge and practical design experience with isolated switched-mode power supplies (SMPS), power conversion topologies, switching devices, magnetics, and control methods.
* **Proficiency in Altium**, including schematic capture, PCB layout, and design documentation.
* Strong electrical circuit design skills, including component selection, circuit analysis, and PCB development.
* Experience designing and troubleshooting power electronics hardware, including power stages, gate drivers, control circuits, and protection systems.
* Strong understanding of analog and digital electronics, electrical engineering principles, and power system performance.
* Hands-on experience with oscilloscopes, power analyzers, electronic loads, multimeters, and other electronic testing equipment.
* Ability to independently manage complex electrical engineering tasks, troubleshoot challenges, and take designs from concept to functional prototypes.
* Familiarity with PCB manufacturing, assembly processes, and design for manufacturability.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues and clients.
* Self-motivated, resourceful, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a small, multidisciplinary engineering team.

Additional Experience We'd Value

* Experience with embedded systems, microcontrollers, and firmware integration.
* Experience with battery management, charging systems, and energy storage applications.
* Familiarity with high-frequency transformer and inductor design.
* Experience with motor control, three-phase power systems, or bidirectional power conversion.
* Knowledge of EMI/EMC considerations, thermal management, electrical safety, and relevant industry standards.
* Experience supporting product certification, manufacturing, and production.
* Broad electrical engineering experience beyond power electronics, including analog and digital circuit design.

What We Offer

* Competitive compensation based on experience and qualifications.
* Opportunities for professional development and technical leadership.
* The chance to work on a diverse range of innovative products and technologies.
* A collaborative, creative work environment where your ideas and contributions make a meaningful impact.
* Opportunities to participate in the full product development proce

new_jobs.description:
### **About Takt**

Takt is a warehouse intelligence platform that unifies labor, automation, and robotics data so 3PLs, retailers, and e-commerce companies can run more efficient operations. Warehouses generate enormous amounts of data and most of it never reaches the people doing the work. We build the software that closes that gap, giving supervisors and frontline employees the information they need, when they need it, on the floor where decisions actually get made. Our software runs every shift, every day, in real facilities for leading brands including Macy’s, Target, Stitch Fix, Flexport, ODW Logistics, and CarParts.com.

### **About the Role**

We’re hiring a senior backend engineer to design and build the distributed systems at the core of the Takt platform. Warehouses produce large, fast-moving datasets from labor systems, automation, and robotics, and our backend turns that stream into the real-time operational views our customers run their shifts on. Our services are written in Go, Python, and Node.js and run on Google Kubernetes Engine across multiple regions. You’ll work across all three, picking the one that fits the problem.

This is a senior role with real architectural ownership. Our engineering team is small and works together to solve problems; you’ll work directly with our CTO and Director of Engineering, shape how the platform scales, and mentor other engineers as the team grows. Security is top of mind in everything we build: our customers trust us with operational data from their facilities, and we design for that trust from the first line of code.

### **What You’ll Do**

* Design, build, and operate scalable backend services in Go, Python, and Node.js that power the Takt platform.
* Build integrations that bring in data from warehouse management, labor, automation, and robotics systems, and keep them reliable when upstream systems change or fail.
* Deploy and run services on Google Kubernetes Engine across multi-region environments, designing for availability, failover, and data locality.
* Model, store, and query data at scale with Google Cloud Spanner and Google BigQuery, working with large operational datasets from real warehouse systems.
* Design APIs and data pipelines that serve real-time views to web, TV, kiosk, and mobile experiences on the floor.
* Build with security top of mind: least-privilege access, safe data handling, and designs that hold up in SOC 2 and GDPR audits.
* Own services end to end, from design and documentation through deployment, monitoring, and incident follow-through.
* Mentor other engineers through design reviews, code review, and pairing as the team grows.

### **How We Build**

We’re an AI-forward engineering team. Every engineer gets a monthly AI tools budget for Claude, Cursor, and whatever else makes you better, and we expect you to use it. AI-assisted development isn’t a shortcut here; it’s how we work. As a senior engineer, you’ll help set the standard for using these tools well: reviewing generated code critically, understanding what ships under your name, and building guardrails so the whole team can move fast safely.

### **What We’re Looking For**

* 5+ years of professional backend engineering experience, or equivalent practical experience.
* Deep, hands-on experience building production services in at least one of Go, Python, or Node.js (TypeScript), and the willingness to work across all three.
* A track record of designing and operating scalable distributed systems, and reasoning clearly about consistency, latency, and failure modes.
* Experience running services on Kubernetes in a cloud environment, ideally GKE on Google Cloud.
* Strong SQL skills: writing, optimizing, and debugging queries against large production datasets is a must.
* Experience with large datasets and the databases that serve them; Spanner and BigQuery experience is a strong plus, as is depth in comparable systems.
* A security mindset applied by default: least privilege, safe handling of customer data, and pragmatic risk trade-offs.
* Ownership and drive: you take ambiguity and run with it, communicate clearly, and leave systems better documented than you found them.

### **Nice to Have**

* Production experience in more than one of Go, Python, and Node.js.
* Experience with multi-region architectures and the trade-offs of replication, failover, and data residency.
* Experience with streaming or batch data pipelines, such as Dataflow.
* Familiarity with Terraform, GitHub Actions, and infrastructure as code.
* Prior startup experience, or comfort owning a domain rather than a slice of one.
* Curiosity about logistics, warehousing, or how physical operations actually run.

### **Compensation & Benefits**

The base salary range for this role is $150,000 – $180,000, depending on experience. Benefits include:

* Health, dental, and vision insurance.
* 401(k) with employer match.
* Unlimited PTO.
* A monthly AI tools budget for every engineer.
* A top-of-the-line MacBook Pro, dual 4K monitors, and your choice of keyboard and mouse at your desk in the office.

### **Interview Process**

Two phone screens, followed by an onsite in our Reston office with four to five interviews. We’ll keep you informed at every step; no black holes.

### **Location**

Takt is based in Reston, VA, with our office located next to the Wiehle-Reston East Metro station on the Silver Line. We’re looking for local candidates who can be in the office at least four days a week; we build together.

Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

new_jobs.description:
**ABOUT ROCKET LAB**

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity's reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

**NEUTRON**

Neutron is a medium lift launch vehicle capable of delivering the mega constellations of tomorrow, high assurance payloads, and human spaceflight. As a highly reusable launch platform, Neutron will deliver a highly cost-effective and reliable launch solution leveraging Rocket Lab's proven execution history with the Electron program. If you're interested in joining a high performing team, pushing the boundaries with a clean sheet development of re-usable liquid launch vehicle, this is your opportunity!

**GROUND SYSTEMS ENGINEER II – FLUIDS**

As a Ground Systems Engineer II – Fluids, you will be the subject matter expert and technical decision-maker, responsible for design, build, and activation activities associated with critical systems that directly support the Neutron Launch Vehicle. You'll work on systems that operate in harsh and hazardous environments, ensuring that they meet the rigorous demands of space exploration.

This role is hands-on and collaborative, requiring you to work closely with suppliers, technicians, and cross-functional teams to deliver world-class solutions. From concept to commissioning, you will play a key role in ensuring Rocket Lab's Ground Systems are reliable, efficient, and ready to support our missions.

**WHAT YOU'LL GET TO DO:**

* Design of fluid systems including cryogenics, hydraulics, fuels, high pressure gases and HVAC.
* 2D and 3D modelling through the use of CAD software, specifically NX.
* System sizing and analysis by hand calculation and numerical methods
* Generate & maintain schematics of fluid/process systems e.g. P&IDs, connection diagrams.
* Component selection, development, and maintenance of BOMs
* Interact with suppliers and internal teams
* Support certification of launch pad fluid systems
* Support maintenance program development

**YOU'LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS AS A LEVEL II ENGINEER:**

* ABET accredited Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent.
* Strong engineering fundamentals and ability to perform required design calculations with limited guidance from senior level engineers.
* 2+ years of experience in directly applicable design, testing, and/or operations within the aerospace or industrial sectors.
* Knowledge of fluid systems, sizing calculations, and P&IDs.
* Proficiency in CAD software (NX, Solidworks)

**THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:**

* Advanced Degree in Mechanical Engineering or Equivalent
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, autonomous environment
* Professional Engineer License
* Experience with Piping systems (large or small)
* Experience with launch pad systems, engine test stand, or other similar industry experience
* Experience with rocket or payload conditioning systems
* Experience with equipment for use with Oxygen
* Experience with Nodal Analysis Tools (e.g. GFSSP, AFT)
* Experience with pipe stress software (e.g. Ceasar II)
* Experience with ASME, ASTM, NFPA, and/or NASA ground system standards would be an asset

***This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas.***

**WHAT TO EXPECT**

We're on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that's not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other's backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.

Description:

We are seeking a Principal Software Engineer to join our Navy Programs team. In this role, you will serve as the technical authority for the architecture, development, integration, and fielding of mission-critical software systems supporting U.S. Navy submarines, aircraft carriers, and shore-based platforms. You will set technical direction across multiple teams while remaining hands-on in design, code, and the resolution of the hardest integration problems.

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in modern C++ on Linux, a record of architecting distributed systems that shipped and were sustained in the field, and the judgment to make long-term technical decisions that balance mission needs, cost, schedule, and risk. This position is well suited for an engineer with twelve or more years of experience who has led technical efforts across multiple teams, can represent the program's technical position to Navy customers and partners, and invests in growing the engineers around them. The work includes defining and driving the modernization of legacy applications onto a Kubernetes-based platform, and directly supports U.S. Navy submarine combat systems.

This is a full-time position based in Manassas, VA. The position requires U.S. citizenship and an active DoD Secret Clearance. The annual base salary is $179,000 – $209,000, with final compensation based on experience and skills.

In addition to a competitive base salary, this position is eligible for a sign-on bonus and a comprehensive benefits package including healthcare benefits (medical, dental, and vision), Flexible Spending Accounts, Life Insurance, 401(k) plan with matching company contributions, paid time off, holidays, and tuition and training reimbursement.

Requirements:

You’ll be responsible for:

* Serving as technical authority for the software architecture of U.S. Navy submarine combat systems, owning key design decisions and the rationale behind them.
* Defining the technical roadmap for modernizing legacy C++, Java, and Electron applications onto a Kubernetes-based platform, including the migration strategy, sequencing, and risk mitigation.
* Establishing architecture, interface, and coding standards across multiple development teams, and making sure designs stay consistent across application, middleware, and deployment layers.
* Leading the design of distributed, real-time, and service-oriented systems using gRPC, Protocol Buffers, DDS, AMQP, and data-driven interface models.
* Personally resolving the program's most complex software, concurrency, performance, networking, and integration problems in lab and Navy platform environments.
* Representing the program's technical position to Navy customers, prime contractors, and partner organizations in design reviews, technical interchange meetings, and integration events.
* Supporting program leadership with technical estimates, basis-of-estimate development, risk assessments, and proposal and capture activities.
* Mentoring technical leads and senior engineers, shaping the team's engineering culture, and helping identify and develop future technical leaders.

Required Skills:

* U.S. citizenship and an active DoD Secret clearance at time of hire.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, plus 12+ years of progressively responsible professional software development experience.
* Demonstrated experience as the lead architect or technical authority for a complex software system, across multiple teams or releases.
* Advanced proficiency in modern C++ (C++11 and newer), including concurrency, asynchronous design, memory management, and performance analysis.
* Deep Linux experience, preferably with Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) or a derivative.
* Proven experience architecting and troubleshooting distributed, event-driven, or real-time systems in production or fielded environments.
* Hands-on experience with gRPC, Protocol Buffers, and messaging middleware such as DDS or AMQP.
* Experience defining test strategy and CI/CD practices for a multi-team software program.
* Experience translating system requirements and interface definitions into software architecture, and defending design decisions in formal technical reviews.
* Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, including briefing technical strategy and risk to senior leadership and government customers.

Preferred Skills:

* Experience architecting or migrating applications onto Kubernetes, including operators, custom controllers, or Helm-based deployment.
* Experience with RTI Connext DDS or other real-time publish-subscribe middleware on mission-critical systems.
* Experience integrating software with tactical, combat, weapon-control, or other mission-critical Navy systems.
* Experience with observability architecture using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Loki.
* Experience supporting proposals, technical volumes, or basis-of-estimate development for DoD programs.
* Experience with DevSecOps, secure software development practices, and supporting system accreditation.
* Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

new_jobs.description:
Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

**About the Role:**

Crusoe Cloud runs AI infrastructure at a scale where a single firmware or software baseline can determine whether thousands of GPUs deliver for our customers. As a Staff Technical Program Manager, you will own the end-to-end release lifecycle for versioned firmware and software baselines across our GPU fleet. That covers everything from scoping and qualification through phased rollout and production deployment. This is a builder role: you will run complex releases across Compute, Networking, Storage, Orchestration, and Operations, and you will design the release calendars, validation frameworks, and metrics that let Crusoe scale them predictably.

We’re looking for an engineer-rooted TPM who is comfortable in the white space between teams and who earns trust with engineers and vendors through technical depth and execution rigor. You’ll identify risks before they surface, drive alignment across engineering leads without direct authority, and give leadership clear, data-driven decision points. This is a full-time position.

**What You'll Be Working On:**

* **Own the Release Lifecycle End to End:** Lead versioned firmware and software baselines from scoping and definition through qualification, validation, phased rollout, and production deployment across a large GPU fleet.
* **Orchestrate Cross-Functional Releases:** Drive release programs across Compute, Networking, Storage, Orchestration, and Operations. Set entry and exit criteria, layered validation, domain sign-offs, and go/no-go decisions.
* **Lead Fleet-Wide Upgrade Campaigns:** Coordinate upgrades on live production clusters with Operations and customer-facing teams, including maintenance planning, rollback strategies, and risk mitigation.
* **Drive Security and CVE Response:** Partner with engineering leads to make fast, well-reasoned decisions on security patches and CVEs, and fold them into the release train.
* **Govern Vendor Relationships:** Work with OEMs, ODMs, and component and silicon suppliers on firmware fixes, validation timelines, and roadmaps. Escalate and resolve issues that put Crusoe’s schedule at risk.
* **Build the Machine:** Design lightweight, scalable release calendars, validation frameworks, Jira workflows, and metrics that make Crusoe’s release process predictable as the fleet grows.
* **Surface Risk and Drive Decisions:** Maintain real-time visibility into release health, map cross-team dependencies, and deliver crisp executive updates that spotlight decisions and trade-offs.
* **Improve Continuously:** Lead retrospectives after major releases and feed the learnings back into the process. Apply AI tools to improve tracking, risk detection, and communication across your programs.

**What You'll Bring to the Team:**

* **Program Leadership at Scale:** 10+ years as a Technical Program Manager in infrastructure, hardware, or platform engineering, including release or change management at fleet scale.
* **Server Firmware Expertise:** Working knowledge of the server firmware stack, including BMC, BIOS, GPU firmware and drivers, and NIC and switch firmware.
* **Influence Without Authority:** Proven experience running validation or qualification programs across many engineering teams without direct authority.
* **Risk and Dependency Management:** Ability to anticipate what will break before it does, then drive mitigation plans and rollback strategies for live production environments.
* **Process Builder’s Mindset:** Track record of creating fit-for-purpose frameworks, such as release calendars, validation gates, and metrics, rather than forcing programs into rigid templates.
* **Executive Communication:** Ability to translate complex technical status into clear, data-driven updates and decision-ready recommendations.
* **Educational Foundation:** Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.

**Bonus Points**

* Experience at a GPU cloud provider or hyperscaler managing large-scale fleets (thousands of nodes).
* A track record of driving firmware currency and compliance programs across a production fleet.
* Hands-on experience with vendor escalation management, including driving OEM/ODM and silicon partners to fix and validate firmware on tight timelines.
* Familiarity with AI accelerator platforms and the dependencies between firmware, drivers, and cluster networking.
* A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

**Benefits:**

* Competitive compensation and equity packages
* Restricted Stock Units
* Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs
* Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance
* Employer contributions to HSA account
* Paid parental leave
* Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability
* Professional development & tuition reimbursement
* Mental health & wellness supp
